These devices will belong to military personnel and will play a critical role in our intelligence network.

You will have a limited amount of time to repair each device. If you are too slow, you will draw suspicion.

CORE GAMEPLAY

The devices you receive will have multiple layers and require different methods to fix. Identify the correct approach for each one and complete the repair.

During this process, you will encounter minigames with various puzzle mechanics. These minigames include an error margin—making too many mistakes will affect the status of your mission.

INTELLIGENCE SYSTEM

Each day, you must plant a listening device in one of the units. Every evening, we will inform you which device to target.

You will plant the bug and, later at home, tune your radio to its frequency and record what you hear.

Transmit any valuable information to us using Morse code.

DECISIONS AND CONSEQUENCES

Work with precision during repairs and avoid drawing suspicion.

There will be moments when you must make critical decisions—make the right ones and minimize errors. Analyze the situation and act in our favor.

RISK AND OUTCOME

The information you provide is vital to our position in the war.

Remember, you are alone. You are responsible for your actions and your mistakes.
store_data.short_description: You will operate as an agent in enemy territory. Your cover: repairing items. While working, gather intelligence and relay it to us. Every action and decision will shape your fate. The question is… will you make the right ones?

store_data.about_the_game:
Capybara Bingo is a fast-paced, cozy party bingo game where up to 8 players manage 1–6 bingo cards simultaneously, racing to stamp called numbers and claim bingo before anyone else.

But call it wrong? You pay the price.

Classic Bingo. Cozy Chaos.

Numbers fly, cards pile up, and the good panic of scanning 6 cards at once is exactly the kind of chaos that makes everyone at the table laugh. Stamp any square at any time — bingo is only yours if you can prove it.

Key Features

  • Single-player vs 7 unique NPC capybaras, or online multiplayer for 2–8 players
  • Manage 1–6 bingo cards simultaneously
  • 9 round types: Regular, Double, Four Corners, Full Card, X-Shape, T-Shape, Postage Stamp, Outside Frame, and Blackout Speed
  • Chaos ability system — disrupt other players with power-ups earned by stamping
  • Earn Capy Tokens and unlock capybara characters, dotters, table skins, and more

How to Play

Numbers are called automatically. Stamp squares as they're called across all your cards. When you've got a winning pattern, hit your bingo key.

One More Round

Short sessions, low stakes, high laughs. Capybara Bingo is the bingo game that's actually fun to play with friends.

Drive & Collect

Navigate a grid-based world and hoover up the never-ending trash avalanche that humanity left behind. 

Recycle & Upgrade

Every piece of trash collected feeds into upgrades that make your robot faster, smarter, and hungrier for more. Unlock collection features, new bots, automation, and watch your tiny operation grow into something humanity would have found deeply impressive — if any of them were still around.

Clean the universe.

Explore different worlds and discover new biomes with new kinds of waste. Volcanoes that spew trash, magnetic waste, humanity's ingenuity in producing litter knows no bounds!

Features

  • Grid-based robot movement with satisfying incremental collection loops

  • Numbers go up and up and up

  • Deep upgrade tree for your bot - and then your fleet

  • Active incremental with automation upgrades — you get to automate things, but this is not a full idler!

store_data.about_the_game:
[Master the Void, Defy the Gravity]

Alpha Star blends classic arcade shoot-'em-up thrills with a dynamic physics-based environment. It's not just about dodging bullets—it's about surviving the space-time distortions of massive black holes that pull everything into their grasp.

🚀 Key Features

  • Dynamic Space Battlefield: Experience a battlefield that reacts to physics. Encounter Black Holes that warp the trajectory of every projectile. Use their gravitational pull to your advantage or fight to stay outside the event horizon.

  • Evolving Threat Levels: Progress through 10 distinct mission phases. Face the "Red Storm" of high-velocity Super Bullets and dodge relentless volleys of seeker missiles as the sector's difficulty spikes.

  • Strategic Ship Upgrades: After every wave, choose from 3 randomized upgrade cards. Will you boost your Photon Engine for speed, deploy a Chrono Field to slow enemies, or prioritize the Rapid Recharge of your shields?

  • Dual-Layer Defense: Master the synergy between your ship’s hull and its Auto-Regenerating Shields. Knowing when to engage and when to retreat for a shield recharge is the key to survival.

  • Atmospheric Sci-Fi Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in the void with a haunting 80s-inspired dark synth-wave soundtrack that evolves with the intensity of the combat.

✨ Special Thanks & Credits

[ SOUND & MUSIC ]

  • Universfield - Dark 80s Sci-Fi Atmosphere

  • AtlasAudio - Ambient Cinematic

  • NastelBom - Cinematic Ambient

  • SLD Audio - Sci-Fi and Cyberpunk Music Pack

[ VISUAL ASSETS ]

  • NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center / Jeremy Schnittman (Special thanks for the scientific visualization of black hole environments)

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Start with a small, worn-down roadside motel and turn it into a profitable business. Manage rooms, serve guests, repair damage, clean up messes, and invest your earnings into upgrades that increase value and attract better customers.

Built as a solo passion project from scratch, this motel management simulator combines hands-on tasks, progression systems, and business management in one experience.

Manage Your Motel

Take control of the full guest experience from check-in to checkout.

Assign customers to available rooms, set prices based on room quality, upgrades, and cleanliness, then collect payments after their stay. Keep rooms in top condition to earn better rewards and tips.

Poorly maintained rooms lose value over time and are more likely to become damaged or dirty.

Clean, Repair, Repeat

Every room needs attention. After guests leave, inspect the damage and restore everything before the next booking.

Handle tasks such as:

  • Cleaning trash and messes

  • Replacing light bulbs

  • Repairing switches

  • Fixing damaged devices

  • Cleaning toilets

  • Restoring room condition

The better you maintain your motel, the more money you can earn.

Upgrade Every Room

Improve your rooms with furniture, appliances, and useful add-ons to permanently increase rental value.

Each room supports multiple upgrade slots, allowing you to customize layouts and create higher-tier accommodations.

Possible upgrades include:

  • Television

  • Microwave

  • Game console

  • Intercom

  • Coffee maker

  • Water dispenser

  • Towels

  • Air conditioner

  • Stove

Shop & Expand

Buy supplies and upgrades in physical stores early in the game, then unlock remote ordering through your phone or laptop for faster management later. Plan purchases carefully and keep your motel stocked with everything needed to stay operational.

Upgrade Your Character

Use the special reception TV to unlock player bonuses and improve your efficiency.

Possible upgrades include:

  • Higher room rental income

  • More inventory space

  • Faster movement speed

  • Extra rewards for repairs

Build Storage & Organize Supplies

Use the warehouse behind reception to build shelves and organize your growing business.

Create better storage systems to hold cleaning products, spare parts, furniture, and more.

Optional Side Income

Take a break from motel work and grow potted plants in the warehouse for extra profit.

A small optional system for players who enjoy additional progression and cozy side activities.

Solo Passion Project!

This is my first game, fully created solo from scratch. Every system is being built with care, with the goal of delivering a polished and rewarding management experience.

I hope all of you will have at least a little fun playing it. And if there are things you don’t like, or something you feel could be better, I hope you’ll give me the chance to improve it and make the game better with your feedback.

store_data.about_the_game:
SIT OR DIE is a 3D multiplayer party game with a dark and suspenseful twist. As prisoners trapped by a mad warden, you are forced to play a deadly game of musical chairs.

Core Game Mechanics:

Music stops, time to grab a chair.Sitting does not necessarily mean you are safe.There's a chance to turn things around even while standing.

Every round is different
Over 30 game modes are randomly combined in each match. You never know what comes next—react fast, trust your luck, or outplay others.
(Demo includes 10 modes.)

NEW Skill: Push and Kick.

We listened to the players' feedback and decided to add more interactivity to the musical chairs phase. You can push away your fellow inmate competing for a chair, or kick them down.

Note that both actions have a limited number of uses, so use them carefully to maximize your chances of survival.

Not enough players? Add AI
Supports 1–12 players. If fewer than 6 players join, you can add AI prisoners up to 12. They compete, eliminate, solve tasks… and can be even more cunning than real players.

More Modes.

From the basic "musical chairs" game, there are over 30 different modes, so you can never guess what you'll face in the next round.

Don't let your guard down; the situation could turn around at any time.

FAKE chair or TRUE chair ？

Faced with a mix of real and fake chairs, do you try them one by one, or wait for your fellow inmates to finish?

More modes will be revealed soon!

Try your best to survive.

Become a ghost after elimination (Feature under development).
Once eliminated, you turn into a ghost. Take revenge on those who defeated you—or prank your friends and drag them down with you.

Can you survive to the end and claim the throne of thorns?

store_data.about_the_game:
“Detective R and Prophet J” is a mystery adventure game in which you uncover the truth behind a case by gathering evidence and engaging in strategic exchanges with a variety of characters.

Players take on the role of the protagonist, pursuing the case through investigation and conversation. With character customization, dramatic cut-in scenes, Live2D character portraits, and a wide range of dialogue choices, the game offers an immersive experience that makes you feel as if you were a character in a drama or movie.

Characters’ reactions and dialogue change depending on the player’s actions, allowing you to influence their emotions as you draw closer to the truth behind the case.

■ Story

It was supposed to be nothing more than a bit of entertainment at a college Halloween party.

Anyone who found the mark of “Prophet Jack” and recited the spell would receive a “wonderful gift.”

Six years later, the protagonist receives a message hinting at murder from a classmate who disappeared that very night.

Realizing that the murders are real, the protagonist begins investigating alongside Rory, a college friend who has since become a detective.

The events of the past and the murders in the present become increasingly entangled, and the hidden truth gradually comes to light.

■ Relationships with Characters Change Based on Your Actions

In this game, the protagonist has a status that represents how they are perceived by others.

This status changes according to the player’s actions, and even in the same situation, characters’ reactions and dialogue may vary.

The impression you create gradually changes the way the story unfolds.

■ Uncover the Truth Through “Communication”

  • The game consists of three main parts:

  • Story segments, where the narrative progresses

  • Investigation segments, where you gather evidence

Persuasion segments, where you pressure others to reveal the truth

In persuasion segments, you push your opponent closer to the truth by filling a gauge through conversation and presenting evidence.

It is important to consider what kind of attitude to take based on your current status.

Each chapter also features a deduction segment at its climax, but even if you fail, the story will continue, allowing players who are not confident in deduction games to enjoy the experience without frustration.

store_data.about_the_game:
Game Overview

Did I wake up too fast? I'm seeing stick figures falling in love inside a video game!

Beyond the "Lewd Stuff," We Have a Hundred Other Ways to Make You Grind Until You Drop

Who says cultivation is just about sitting in meditation? In *Nirvana Bonsai*, if you don't go out scavenging for junk, you won't even have enough money to buy clothes for your wife!

She: The Ember Witch • Emotional Nexus • Crimson Demonic Flames • Aloof Beauty • Fated Bond • Cold Exterior, Warm Heart • Tragic & Broken • Enduring & Ascetic (Not Really) • The Heroine — Li Wanxing

You: Sole Heir of the Sword Sect • Sword Sect Saint • Clad in Pure White • A Sense of Brokenness • Fated Tragedy • Ascetic (Not Really) • The Hero — Yun Che

Just a single spark is all it takes to ignite a romance that spans the ends of the earth.

Exactly who you end up entangled with—and what kind of "flames" you fan into existence—depends entirely on how you choose to add fuel to the fire in this vast, grand universe.

Sow Melons, Reap Melons; Sow Maidens, Reap Maidens: Utilize the Demonic Sect's "Dark Tech"—the "Fertilizer of Desire"—to crossbreed and cultivate Demonic Flame herbs in your medicinal garden.

Absurd Yields: If you're lucky, you might grow a "Lao Gan Ma Spirit Mushroom" that boosts your stamina for dual cultivation; if you're unlucky, you might end up with "Cthulhu Tentacles" crawling all over the ground (though Li Wanxing seems to quite enjoy those).

[/p]

Automated Harvesting: Send those two male lackeys off to haul manure and water the crops, while you simply kick back in the pavilion, discussing life and dreams with the beautiful maidens.

Tactical Dungeon Crawling: Employ the classic "six-person roster, four-person active squad" rotation. Leverage Yun Che's signature "Dual Ice and Fire" elemental system to utterly obliterate—and pixelate—those curators made of pure white geometric shapes.

Roguelike Randomness: "Sage Mode" causes your Attack Power to plummet, but boosts your Defense to the absolute max (for, as the saying goes: he who desires nothing fears nothing).

Talent Tree Divergence: You can raise her to become a "Champion of Pure Love," or—by utilizing forbidden demonic arts—steer her down the path of "Yandere Corruption."

In this "Harem Survival & Management Sim," you must strike a delicate balance between: the stamina cost of gathering resources, the seasonal cycles of farming, the drop rates within mystical dungeons, and—most critically—the "Possessiveness" meters of your various wives.

Don't let the home front catch fire...

store_data.about_the_game:
Model Kit Shop Simulator: Prologue is a first-person store management game where every sale starts with a Model Kit.

Build and grow your own hobby shop by ordering master boxes, unpacking deliveries, stocking shelves, setting prices, and serving collectors and enthusiasts.

But running a successful model kit shop is not just about selling boxes. To maximize profits, you need to keep the right matching paints in stock, increase basket value through the Hobby Basket System, and create a store that supports both shopping and building.

Core Systems

Hobby Basket System

Customers do not just buy a single kit — they start a project. When a customer picks a model kit, they may also look for the matching paints needed to complete it. If you keep those paints on your shelves, they can add them to their basket, increasing the total value of each sale. If the paints are missing, they may still buy the kit, but your basket value and profit will be lower.

Build Table System

Customers who complete the right kit-and-paint combination can use a Build Table after shopping. There, they sit down and start assembling their kit, bringing their project to life inside your store and making the shop feel more dynamic.

Features

  • Run your own first-person model kit shop

  • Order and unpack products from master boxes

  • Stock shelves and organize your store layout

  • Set prices and manage your profits

  • Use the Hobby Basket System to increase basket value

  • Keep matching paints in stock to support model kit sales

  • Let customers use Build Tables to assemble their kits

  • Unlock theme licenses and expand your product variety

  • Grow from a small shop into a larger hobby business

Build a store that hobby fans love and turn your small shop into a thriving model kit business.

store_data.about_the_game:
Rusted Hills: Welcome to the Wilderness is a single-player and co-op survival sandbox set in a fallen America after an economic collapse and a civil war.

America has fallen. Its cities are silent, its roads are empty, and the wilderness has become a dangerous refuge for the last survivors.

Scavenge ruined places, craft tools, build shelter, manage hunger and thirst, and unlock doors and containers in search of valuable resources. By day, you prepare. By night, everything becomes more dangerous.

Hacked military droids, hostile survivors, bandits, and other threats still roam the land. Avoid them, outsmart them, or fight when there is no other choice.

Survive alone or team up with other players. Build, repair, upgrade, and defend your shelter as you face a broken America one day at a time.

When night comes, every decision matters.

Key Features

Survive Alone or in Co-op
Play solo or team up with other survivors.

Explore a Fallen America
Travel through silent cities, empty roads, ruined locations, hostile military zones, and dangerous settlements.

Scavenge, Craft, and Build
Search for valuable resources, craft useful tools, unlock doors and containers, and build shelter to survive.

Build, Upgrade, and Defend
Create a shelter, repair and upgrade your base, reinforce your defenses, and protect your supplies from the dangers of the wilderness.

Deep Survival Systems
Manage hunger, thirst, weight, health, and status effects while fishing, farming, mining, digging, and cutting wood to gather resources.

Fight or Avoid Danger
Use melee weapons, ranged weapons, projectiles, traps, explosives, and the environment to survive.

Beware of Hacked Military Droids
Deadly machines patrol the land and hunt anything that moves.

Hostile AI and Factions
Face smart enemies, hostile survivors, bandits, and dangerous factions fighting for control of the wilderness.

Quests and Dialogue
Follow objectives, discover stories, and interact through dialogue.

Prepare for the Night
Use daylight to gather resources, reinforce your shelter, and prepare for greater danger after dark.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a different mage every run in a fast-paced action roguelite about spell combinations, escalating enemy waves, and dangerous choices.

Survive in a magical arena, choose new spells as you level up, combine different schools of magic, defeat bosses, and shape your build into something powerful, strange, and unstable.

Every run gives you a new path. Burn enemies with fire, freeze them with frost, drain them with blood magic, summon undead allies, control the battlefield with holy power, spread chaos, command nature, chase gold, or take on brutal challenge rules that make the game more dangerous in exchange for new ways to play.

Your mage identity is shaped by the tags and spells you choose. Focus on one school for a pure build, combine two or three schools for hybrid effects, or chase rare combinations that completely change how your run feels.

Features:

- Fast-paced single-player action roguelite gameplay

- Many spells, passives, items, boons, and stat choices

- Mage identities built from single, dual, and triple magic paths

- Bosses, minibosses, special events, shrines, lootboxes, and gold rewards

- Permanent progression, unlockable mages, and shop upgrades

- Challenge modes with unusual and dangerous run rules

- Endless mode for pushing late-game scaling as far as possible

- Run history, damage breakdowns, and build snapshots for testing your strongest builds

Survive the waves, break the rules of your own build, and find out how far your mage can go before the screen collapses under your choices.

In Cold Engine you are assigned to a train, a debt, and a quota. Choose routes, deliver cargo, manage heat and energy, and keep moving through a frozen system that values the process more than the operator.

Complete the delivery and move forward. Debt can shrink, quotas return, and the next route is already waiting.

Rolling Front is a Classic RTS. You pick a faction from across human history and fight each other on a big map. Build up a small base, get your economy running, manage your population, raise an army. Do some politics. Eventually total war erupts. 12 playable factions across all epochs Greeks, Romans, Vikings, Teutons, Ottomans, French and more.

Factions and Races are core game mechanics, not just stats or visuals.

Your units are all unique people.

You assign them roles warrior, worker, scientist, etc.

It's funny.

Politics runs in real time alongside battle.

Bribe people, send spies, incite rebellions, declare war. Stuff happens while other stuff is happening. Economy and base building is simple and intentional. No complex city building.

store_data.about_the_game:
Rogue Quest is a roguelike deckbuilder where every attack is a poker hand. Build a Pair to chip, a Flush to crush, a Royal Flush to end fights. Pick a class, draft a deck, and ascend a cursed spire that gets meaner every floor.

This isn't a puzzle. It's a dungeon. Every hand is a fight, every floor a new threat.

How Combat Works

Draw five cards. Read the board. Decide which hand to play and which to hold.

A Pair scratches. A Two Pair stings. A Flush crushes. A Straight Flush devastates. Suits, ranks, and hand types each shape damage differently, and the right Power Cards can turn a modest hand into a killing blow.

Power Cards Break the Math

Five passive ability slots. 88 cards to fill them. Every Power Card listens for a trigger and fires an effect, and the right five turn poker into something stranger.

  • Vampiric. Heal 1 HP for every 10 damage you deal.

  • First Strike. +30 damage on the first hand of every fight.

  • Last Stand. Deal 50% more damage while below 30% HP.

  • Rainbow Aura. +3 mult when your scored cards include all four suits.

  • Chaos Engine. At the start of each turn, a random card gains a random enhancement.

  • Overkill. +3 permanent damage every time you kill an enemy.

  • Loan Shark. Pay 5 HP at combat start, gain 20 gold.

  • Midas Touch. All gold rewards are doubled.

Layer a Vampiric on a Last Stand build and dying makes you stronger. Run Midas Touch with Loan Shark and the spire pays you to bleed. Stack First Strike with a Straight Flush class fantasy and bosses lose half their HP before they swing.

One Power Card is a perk. Five Power Cards stacked is a build.

Each Floor, a New Path

Between fights, the spire branches. Shop with a wandering merchant. Rest at the healer. Forge your cards at the blacksmith. Read your fate at the mystic. Risk a random event. Every node is a choice, and every choice changes the deck you bring to the next fight.

Five Classes, Five Playstyles

  • Warrior. Built for sustained combat. Pairs and Full Houses hit harder, and every kill grows your block.

  • Rogue. Fast and precise. Draws an extra card each turn, with a 30% crit chance and a piercing opener.

  • Wizard. Rewards high-value hands. Straights and Flushes deal double damage and raise a ward.

  • Paladin. Durable and self-sustaining. Full Houses restore HP, and every win heals you back up.

  • Warlock. A frail pact-bearer. Heals 25% of damage dealt, with Three of a Kind and Four of a Kind as signature hands.

Each class unlocks its own mastery track, starter deck, and a private pool of class-only Power Cards. Berserker Rage stacks permanent damage every time a warrior takes a hit. Dark Pact pushes a warlock's life drain harder at the cost of max HP. Divine Wrath rewards a paladin who never lets the spire touch them.

Forge and Transmute

The blacksmith doesn't sell cards. He changes them. Enhance a card with burn, gold bonus, or extra damage. A few visits in, your deck stops looking like a deck of cards and starts looking like a weapon.

A Town That Remembers

Death is permanent, but progress isn't. Spend gold between runs to upgrade your town, unlock new classes, and improve your starting conditions. Every run teaches. Every run leaves the next one stronger.

Features at a Glance

  • Poker hand combat with damage scaling across ten hand ranks

  • 5 character classes, each with class-only Power Cards and a mastery track

  • 88 Power Cards. Slot up to 5 per run. Synergies stack.

  • Card forging and transmutation at the blacksmith

  • Procedurally generated floors with combat, shop, rest, forge, mystic, event, and elite nodes

  • Persistent town upgrades that carry across runs

  • Painterly dark fantasy art with torch-lit dungeon environments

The Spire Is Waiting

Climb high enough and the rules start bending back. Find out how far one good hand can take you.

store_data.about_the_game:
The LORD OF CATASTROPHE has returned once again to bring misery to the land! Create your party of four CHOSEN HEROES, mixing and matching between six different classes. Battle the forces of evil across more than a dozen unique chapters, each with their own obstacles. But do not despair, for you possess the blessing of the GODDESS OF TIME. Defeat simply means a chance to tell the story again... 

*

*

Your quest is a battle of attrition. Manage your HP, MP, and HUNGER as you chart a path through each chapter of the story. Encounter monsters, random events, treasure, and sometimes blissful nothing! The more battles you win, the more XP you gain, but face too many enemies and you may find yourself too weak for the BOSS. Spend your GOLD wisely, and don't forget to use those ITEMS!

*

*

Every point of damage matters in this simple, yet deep combat system. Plan your turns out carefully and CHECK the enemy's capabilities, or you may meet a swift end. Choose whether to LEVEL UP your party members evenly, or focus on a few favourites. Acquire dozens of powerful SKILLS as you progress towards your inevitable destiny. 

*

*

Evil is never truly vanquished, only forestalled. Explore new chapters and alternative routes through this ENDLESSLY REPEATING odyssey. Create synergistic builds and PLAN YOUR PATH carefully in order to reach the toughest areas. Watch as the world is afflicted by MADNESS time and time again. Wonder whether anything can truly last FOREVER.  Search in vain for SALVATION. Catch a fleeting glimpse of FREEDOM.

*

*

FEATURES:

  • 13 varied stages, six classes, hundreds of items                                                             No two stories are quite so alike

  • Six different endings, depending on your path                                                               Your choices determine our fate

  • Catchy chiptune soundtrack, inspired by the classics                                                      Her song descends from Heaven

  • Zero endings, an endlessly replayable adventure                                                           A true saviour would never rest

  • Colourful pixel art with a minimalist, abstract flair                                                         My world; perfect, simple, small

  • One ending.

You lost everything!

Your money. Your home. Your dignity.

Welcome to a city where gambling is illegal, everyone does it anyway and no one plays fair.

In Going All In, the system is rigged, the odds are fake, and the only way out… is to cheat better than everyone else.

CHEAT THE CHEATERS

Everyone’s cheating. Badly hidden. Poorly disguised. Sometimes impressively.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Will you carry hope, or a crushing weight?"

Tomorrow’s Coins, Pig’s Back is a roguelike action RPG where you explore ever-changing, perilous maps and transform your hard-won loot into both the prosperity of the town and your own burgeoning strength.

[Game Cycle: Explore and Exchange]

Step into unknown territories, defeat fierce enemies, and gather precious items. The loot you bring back can be exchanged for "Coins" in town. Use these coins to purchase powerful weapons from the shop and prepare yourself to plunge into even deeper reaches of the abyss.

[Key Features]

  • Ever-Changing Procedural Maps: The structure of the world shifts with every run, ensuring a constant sense of tension. As you ascend floors, the maps expand and the enemies grow exponentially stronger, standing as lethal obstacles in your path.

  • Strategic Level-Up System: Gain experience and evolve according to your own playstyle:

    • Vitality, Attack, and Movement Speed: Bolster your base stats to maximize your survival rate.

    • Unique Weapon Upgrades: Hone the distinct traits of your weapons to annihilate enemies with overwhelming firepower. The path of your evolution is entirely in your hands.

  • Risk and Reward Management: The deeper you venture, the more valuable the treasure becomes—but the difficulty spikes just as fast. Deciding when to push your luck and when to retreat safely to town will determine your ultimate fate.

[The Shop: The Key to Growth]

Acquire new weapons with the coins you’ve amassed. Fine-tune your gear, temper your stats, and leave your mark on the uncharted depths.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the minimalist world of Lightfold, the key to unraveling puzzles lies at the border of light and dark. Playing as a little cat in this purely geometric space, you will move light sources and obstacles to shape shadows, engaging in a satisfying mental workout of visual and spatial logic.

Core Gameplay: Sokoban Meets Silhouette Puzzles

In Lightfold, your ultimate goal is the "shape." You must simultaneously manipulate two distinct elements: illuminating light sources and light-blocking blocks. By precisely controlling the distance and angle between them, you will use the principles of projection to piece together and overlap specific target shadow patterns on the ground or walls.

Game Features

  • Dual Puzzle-Solving Mechanics: You must carefully plan the cat's path to avoid dead ends, while simultaneously visualizing how shadows will stretch, shrink, or merge as the relative positions of the lights and blocks change.

  • Intuitive Shadow Puzzles: There are no complex text tutorials. Observe the target silhouette and reverse-engineer the correct positions for the light sources and blocks. Every step you take provides immediate and realistic visual feedback from the dynamically shifting light and shadow.

  • Pure Minimalist Aesthetics: Clean geometric shapes, high-contrast lighting, and tranquil ambient sounds. Free from cluttered UI elements, the game allows you to fully immerse yourself in a state of pure puzzle-solving flow alongside the little cat.

store_data.about_the_game:
An instant to learn. A lifetime to master. You have to play it to understand.

WinBolo is a multiplayer top-down tank game for up to 16 players. Pilot your tank across the island, capture bases and pillboxes, fortify your position, and battle for control of the map.

Two play styles, one battlefield

Drop into a freeform game where alliances shift hour by hour and a well-timed betrayal is a perfectly respectable move. Or run it tournament-style: teams locked in before the match, no diplomacy, two sides fighting for the island until one holds every base.

Both share the same simple rules and the same surprising depth.

Capture. Build. Win.

Bases are your lifeline — the only place to refuel, rearm, and repair your tank. Pillboxes hold key terrain and rip through anyone foolish enough to cross open ground; capture them, reposition them, turn them on their former owners. Harvest trees to fuel your build orders. Lay down roads to move faster than your enemies. Wall off chokepoints. Mine the approaches.

The world is dynamic Detonated mines leaves a crater. Craters fill with water. Water becomes rivers, rivers reshape the lines of attack, and the battlefield you started on isn't the one you're fighting on an hour later. Trees slowly regrow. Use too many of them and risk being deforested and unable to repair your pillboxes

A 1987 classic, rebuilt

Bolo was created by Stuart Cheshire in 1987 and became one of the defining multiplayer games of the early Macintosh era. In 1998, John Morrison began developing WinBolo — a faithful Windows reimplementation, and the only Bolo port Cheshire ever officially endorsed. Through a decade of active development, WinBolo grew a Linux port, a thriving online community at , and a player base that ran tournaments, shared maps, and shared strategies in the forums.

WinBolo 2.0 carries that work forward — same gameplay you remember, modernized for today's platforms.

What's new in 2.0

  • Cross-platform play — Windows, Mac, Linux, Steam Deck, iOS, Android, and the web, all on the same servers

  • Modern netcode — authoritative server, lag compensation with position-history rewind, client-side prediction, adaptive jitter buffer. Shells hit where you aimed.

  • Easy self-hosting — UPnP and NAT-PMP open ports automatically; UDP hole punching reaches servers behind most home routers

  • Built-in map editor — pencil, fill, magic wand, mazes, four procedural generators (Tournament, Natural, Maze, Fractal), text-as-terrain, image import, full symmetry tools, and a stamp library

  • A new AI Brain — NewAutopilot uses goal priorities, threat trajectories, and territory influence maps. Brains are written in Lua. Train your own with the machine learning tools and export them as in-game opponents. Tools provide to help build them as well.

  • 17 languages including in-game chat and player names

  • Embedded replay viewer with WBN integration — review games, leave rankings, watch other people's matches without leaving the client

Free, open source, and built to last

Bolo was shareware. WinBolo carried that spirit forward. WinBolo 2.0 keeps it going — freely available on Steam, the App Store, and Google Play, with an optional supporter purchase for anyone who wants to help fund development (including, perhaps, the players who never quite got around to sending in their shareware fee back in 2001!)

The full source code will be on GitHub shortly after launch under GPL v2, continuing with when WinBolo first went open source in 2008.

store_data.about_the_game:
A fast paced bullet heaven FPS played with just the mouse where your speed is your fire rate.

As a member of the Hypervibers you will complete missions for the Hypervibers fighting against inhuman hordes in the Dronelord's Domain to ultimately take down the Dronelord.

Accelerate, glide and surf across procedurally generated zones. Ramp off of the terrain to fly through the air raining down bullets from above, leveling up to fill the screen with bullets.

Features

  • Mouse only control scheme so you can sit back and enjoy a snack while you play.

  • Automatic weapons triggered by movement conditions such as landing from the air.

  • A new fast paced take on the movement and positioning gameplay of the bullet heaven genre.

  • A choice of characters to play, each starting with one weapon and a unique movement ability triggered by the scroll wheel.

  • Fight waves of drones across a variety of procedurally generated levels.

  • Automatic targeting so you can focus on movement.

  • In game guide with detailed explanations of mechanics and controls.

  • Complete runs across 3 zones lasting roughly 8 minutes each.

  • Level up to choose between weapons, stat upgrades from cyberchips and upgrades to your existing loadout.

  • Find the cargo crate in each level to unlock bonus stat upgrades or add additional weapons and cyberchips to your loadout.

Story

In a distant future in a distant place there lived a man who ran a simple delivery business. One day he decided to amass a fleet of drones to make the job easier for himself and lower his operating costs. As he amassed drones he became more isolated, never traveling far from his warehouse, anything he needed he could deliver to himself. Over time he grew to see his automatons as companions, then friends and finally equals. He'd begun manufacturing them himself, learning about robotics and even cybernetics until one day he took the plunge turning himself into a cyborg, losing sight of his initial motivations in the process and yearning only to cover the surface of the planet with as many of his friends as possible. Humans no longer mattered to him and so his drones were fitted with mechanisms to erase them from existence.

Cyborgs weren't uncommon in this time and place and as the Dronelord's horde grew a small resistance force of augmented humans grew. They were more selective than the Dronelord choosing to optimise their bodies instead of replacing the vital parts that made them human. They installed cyberchips in a special interface port they had designed and created a wireless connection to the hoverboards that were the common mode of transport. When the Dronelord began to attack humans these cyborgs known as Hypervibers entered the lands around his warehouse. Most regions had been bled dry, left barren, covered in metal plating or exposed wastes of lava where mining processes had weakened the planet's crust. Few areas had grass and even those were devoid of living beings.

Join the Hypervibers to embark on reconnaissance missions, scouting new zones in the dronelords domain. As you progress you will slowly make progress destroying key Dronelord infrastructure and creating a path to finally take down the Dronelord in the fortress that was once his warehouse.

Controls

This game can be played entirely with Mouse movement and left and right click.

There is also controller support using the left and right trigger and left analogue stick to match the mouse controls.

store_data.about_the_game:
One day, a storybook began to be consumed by the Void.

Rising to fight the encroaching nothingness are tiny knights

who leaped from a stationery drawer—

"Ink and Void" is a tower defense game set inside the pages of

a picture book.

■ A World Where Stationery Becomes Warriors

Pencil swordsmen, eraser monks, ballpoint gunners, fountain

pen mages, utility knife berserkers—

Units from your pencil case each bring unique skills to defend

the pages of the storybook.

Unlock class changes to evolve your units and craft the

ultimate formation.

■ Four Chapters, Each a Story

"The Beginning Forest," "The Candy Town," "The Clockwork Magic

Tower," "The Eroded Blank Pages"—

Progress through all four chapters as if turning the pages of

a picture book.

Each chapter features distinct maps and formidable foes,

culminating in a battle against "The Void" itself.

■ Strategic Deck Building

Earn cards after each stage to build your own custom deck.

Harness the power of Mythic cards to overcome the waves of

nothingness.

■ Supported Languages

Japanese / English / Chinese

store_data.about_the_game:
The so-called H-Virus has swept through the population, turning the masses into predatory Succubi, Helen is the adult forced into a nightmare she never asked for. As one of the last humans left standing after the initial outbreak, her only goal is to stay alive in a world that has already been won by the succubus.

The hunt appears to be constant, no matter if you are moving through cities at night or taking a dive in the swamp. An unknown entity planned this plague, but their identity is a mystery for another time. Look for hidden facts scattered around the maps while surviving the waves!

The Succubi sense your movements, predicting the best way to track you down. It doesn't matter where you are, you are never truly safe. Success requires mastery over your arsenal and a deep understanding of the terrain. Don't forget that H-Virus comes with rare mutations once in a while...

Key Features:

  • Three Locations: Battle for survival across City (Night), City (Overcast), and the Wetlands.

  • Realistic Graphics: Perfect blend of realism and stylish graphics.

  • Advanced Gameplay Loop: Eliminate various succubus types that follow you while travelling across the map in order to upgrade your weaponry.

  • Visceral Gunplay: Experience various combat weaponry and movements designed for precision.

  • Dynamic Wave Survival: Test your limits against escalating numbers of succubi in a struggle for life.

  • Achievements & Leaderboards: Compete against players within global leaderboards when it comes to kills and waves.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Upper Echelons.

Nova Impact is an adrenaline-fueled 2D Space Shooter RPG (SSRPG) where survival is your only path to glory. You are a Zenith, an elite licensed pilot taking part in humanity’s ultimate combat simulation. But in this arena, you are the ultimate prize.

Relentless waves of unlicensed challengers, known as the Trackers, will hunt you down like a pack to steal your license. Your mission? Outmaneuver the swarm, rack up kills, and prove you are the #1 champion.

UNINTERRUPTED ACTION: PRE-PLAN YOUR BUILD

Say goodbye to menus that break your flow. In Nova Impact, the action never stops! Plan your ship's upgrade path before you enter the arena. As you destroy Trackers and gain XP, your ship automatically levels up and deploys your pre-selected enhancements. Focus entirely on dodging, shooting, and surviving the swarm.

EARN CREDITS & V.O.I.D. POINTS

Every single kill in the arena is tracked. At the end of each run, your combat performance is converted into two crucial resources: Credits and V.O.I.D. points. Spend your hard-earned Credits to purchase powerful modules that permanently reinforce your ship's capabilities. Meanwhile, accumulate V.O.I.D. points (Virtual Orbit & Interstellar Duels) to climb the division leaderboards and prove your worth to the League.

CLIMB THE LEAGUE & DUEL THE ELITE

You start at the bottom of the Zenith ladder, but your ambition doesn't stop there. As you survive longer and push your limits, you will unlock new routes in the League. Once you reach the top of the ranks, prepare for the ultimate challenge: intense, 1-on-1 boss fights against rival Zeniths to claim their spot.

A LIVING, EVOLVING COSMOS

Fight over a sleek, tactical Hex-Grid while the universe comes to life beneath you. Thanks to a stunning multi-layered parallax system, watch breathtaking nebulas form and massive planets materialize in the deep space background as the simulation intensifies.

  • Fast-Paced SSRPG Gameplay: A perfect blend of classic arcade space shooting and deep RPG progression.

  • Zero-Pause Leveling: Pre-plan your build and enjoy uninterrupted combat as your ship upgrades automatically.

  • The Tracker Swarm: Survive against massive, diverse waves of desperate challengers hunting you down.

  • Deep Customization & Ranking: Convert your arena kills into Credits to buy permanent ship modules, and accumulate V.O.I.D. points to climb the competitive ladder.

  • Epic 1v1 Boss Duels: Climb the division ranks and defeat rival Zeniths to become the #1 pilot.

  • Dynamic Environments: Experience a gorgeous, multi-layered background that evolves as you fight.

store_data.about_the_game:
Pygmalion and the Kingdom of Rot is a strategy game built around side-scrolling base defense, deckbuilding, and roguelite decision-making.

You must survive and defend yourself on a side-scrolling battlefield filled with height differences, slopes, ledges, pits, and buildable positions. Enemies attack from multiple directions and steadily push toward your core area. Your job is not simply to stand still and deal damage, but to quickly build, reinforce, and adapt your defenses based on the terrain, available resources, and the pressure of each incoming horde.

The core gameplay revolves around three main elements:

  • First, choose your character.
    The game is not built around a single fixed protagonist. Players can fight as different playable characters, with more characters planned for future expansion. Each character brings different combat options, pressure-handling tools, and deckbuilding directions.

  • Second, play cards to build your defensive line.
    Your main combat tools come from cards. Cards can be used to deploy buildings, place traps, use one-time tactical items, enhance weapons or defensive structures, or provide temporary status effects and resource cycling at critical moments. During each run, you need to gradually shape your deck into a system that can truly come online.

  • Third, hold back wave after wave of zombie hordes.
    Enemies do not attack from just one route. Different terrain layouts change how enemies approach and also change how you should defend. You need to decide where to place firepower, where to build obstacles, which areas should delay enemies, and which zones must be heavily defended. As the battle progresses, you must keep repairing your line, reallocating resources, and preparing for the next wave before the pressure overwhelms you.

  • The game uses a light rogue lite progression structure.
    After each survival round, you can gain new cards, upgrades, relics, or route choices, gradually improving your deck and combat system. You can lean into building suppression, trap-based control, burst tactics through items, or unique strategies built around a specific character. Every push deeper underground becomes a new deckbuilding process.

The focus of the game is not complex storytelling.
It is about using limited resources under escalating pressure to build a defensive system that actually works.

Key Features

  • Side-scrolling defense meets deckbuilding
    This is not a traditional tower defense game, nor is it a pure card game. You must play cards under real-time pressure to deploy defenses, reinforce your position, and respond tactically.

  • Multiple playable characters
    The game is not designed around one fixed protagonist. Different characters provide different combat experiences, and future updates can expand the game with more playstyle routes.

  • Multiple entrances, varied terrain, multi-lane pressure
    Enemies approach from several directions. Slopes, high ground, ledges, pits, and buildable areas all directly affect how you plan your defenses.

  • Buildings, traps, upgrades, and items all shape your deck
    You do not win by relying on a single type of turret. Buildings establish your defensive line, traps control and weaken enemies, items provide emergency burst power, and upgrades determine whether your build can truly come online.

  • Light roguelite progression
    Each run gives you new cards, upgrades, and relics, allowing you to form different build directions and improving replicability.

  • Decision-making over raw numbers
    What matters most is how you use terrain, resources, and your deck to organize a defensive line before the zombie hordes grow out of control.

store_data.about_the_game:
After School, the Corner Shop Becomes the Battlefield

After School: Days Gone By is a collectible progression game built around childhood toy battles.

Step back into the days when going home after school could wait. Outside the corner shop, beside the schoolyard, or down by the apartment blocks, kids crouch on the ground and settle the day’s bragging rights with glass marbles, round cards, and spinning tops.

At its core, the game is not just a collection of simple minigames. It is a progression loop built around three childhood battle systems:

Marble Battles, Round Card Battles, and Spinning Top Battles.

You will collect toys of different rarities, learn their stats and traits, build your own battle setups, and win new collectibles through match after match.

  • Three Childhood Battle Systems

Marbles: Aim, Angles, and Feel

Marble battles focus on launch angles, collision paths, and reading the field.

Different marbles come with different rarities and properties. Basic two-color marbles, advanced patterned marbles, refined solid-color marbles, rare golden-glow marbles, and more may all differ in feel, weight, bounce, or special traits.

You will need to choose the right marble based on the arena, your opponent’s marble positions, and the current state of the match.

  • Round Cards: Slaps, Flips, and Deckbuilding

Round cards are not only childhood collectibles, but also a major battle system in the game.

Players can build their own deck of round cards. Common cards offer stable performance, while higher-rarity cards may come with unique traits that make every slap more strategic.

Round card battles are not just about execution. They are also about deckbuilding.

Which cards do you bring?

Which one do you play first?

Do you aim for consistent flips, or gamble on a high-reward combo?

Every choice can change the outcome of a match.

  • Spinning Tops: Assembly, Customization, and Counters

The spinning top system emphasizes part combinations and matchup counters.

Each top is made up of multiple components, such as an upper attack ring, blade structure, core shaft, or bottom tip. Different parts affect attack power, defense, stability, stamina, and movement patterns.

Players can buy, collect, dismantle, and customize spinning top parts, even experimenting with unusual combinations to create different styles:

store_data.about_the_game:
FINAL RITES PROTOCOL

CONFIDENTIAL REPORT, ARCHIVE COPY

OVERVIEW

After a series of unexplained incidents in a remote village in northern Spain, a group of exorcists was dispatched. No further communication was received.

Following the loss of contact, a secondary unit was authorized.

Designation: FINAL RITES.

This unit is not tasked with absolution.

Its purpose is containment.

THE SITUATION

What began as a localized religious disturbance has escalated into a spreading condition affecting the entire region.

The village appears intact, yet abandoned. Signs of daily life remain undisturbed, but no inhabitants are present.

Inside, reality itself shows signs of instability:

  • spaces that do not match their external structure

  • doors leading to unknown locations

  • environments that shift and disorient

THE THREAT

Entities encountered are not fully understood.

The dead do not remain at rest.
Termination does not guarantee neutralization.

Some entities resemble former inhabitants. Others do not correspond to any known form of life.

In multiple cases:

  • movement occurs without visible cause

  • figures appear where no one is present

  • reflections act independently

Destruction alone is insufficient.

Something remains.

BREACHES

Certain locations act as transition points between realities.

These are not conventional portals, but unstable openings where:

  • sound is distorted

  • light behaves irregularly

  • space itself becomes unreliable

Personnel have reported crossing into environments that do not exist within known geography.

Some have not returned.

FAILURE OF EXORCISM

Initial ritual procedures did not eliminate the presence.

They altered it.

What was once contained is now unbound.

The situation is no longer a haunting.

It is a spreading condition.

YOUR ROLE

You are part of the FINAL RITES unit.

A military esoteric squad deployed when exorcism fails.

Your mission is to:

  • investigate corrupted locations

  • engage hostile entities

  • perform sealing rituals

  • contain the spread

You will explore abandoned structures, forests, and underground sites while confronting the aftermath of failed rites.

Some threats can be destroyed.

Others must be bound.

DIRECTIVE

  • Do not rely on standard exorcism procedures

  • Destroy remains when possible

  • Apply sealing rites to stabilize affected areas

  • Do not assume cleared zones remain safe

Engagement alone is insufficient.

What is encountered must be contained.

FINAL NOTE

Recovered records from the first unit include the following:

“We thought it was inside the village.
It is not.
The village is inside it.”

END OF REPORT

Donut Smash is a small arcade game about feeding a hungry cat with falling donuts!

Tap the donuts before they hit the floor, break frozen ones, grab coffee when you can, and try not to touch the broccoli. If you miss a donut or tap the wrong thing, the run is over.

It starts simple, but after a while the game gets faster and more chaotic. Power-ups can flip the screen, change the pace, boost your score, or just make everything harder to control.

Runs are short, so it is easy to jump in for one more try. Chase your high score, unlock silly cosmetics, and see how much your cat can eat.

Tap donuts. Feed the cat. Fear the broccoli.

Features

  • Simple one-tap gameplay

  • Short arcade runs

  • Donuts, frozen donuts, coffee, broccoli, and random power-ups

  • High-score chasing

  • Unlockable skins and cosmetics

  • A cat that grows as you score

  • Colorful, silly chaos

The world of Lucrea is not what it once was.

In the aftermath of collapse, what remains is dangerous, forgotten, and largely unexplored. Laban is one such place — a remote, untamed land that your squad didn't choose to land on. But here you are.

Lucrea: Laban is a cooperative PvE extraction shooter with hero shooter mechanics. Each player brings a unique set of abilities to the team, and you'll need all of them. Communication, coordination, and knowing when to use what you've got is the difference between making it out and not making it out.

Explore the world of Laban together, uncover what's been left behind, and find a way home — if you're ready for what you'll discover along the way.

Features

  • Co-op for up to 4 players

  • Hero shooter abilities built around teamwork

  • A rich post-apocalyptic sci-fi/fantasy setting

  • Integrated voice chat

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Neo-Uryupinsk. There is no exit. There is only the update.
“In a world where corporations replaced nations and AI replaced conscience, you are the last failsafe in a system that wants you erased.”

You are Gleb, a “freelance manager” for Global Trust Corporation. You live in a luxurious penthouse overlooking an eternal sunset. You dine on the finest steaks. You converse with your flawless virtual assistant, CHARL.

But why does rusted metal from a prison carriage sometimes flicker through the panoramic glass?
Why does your exquisite dinner smell faintly of bleach and boiled cabbage?

What is this game?

A psychological cyberpunk thriller in the visual novel genre, where the line between reality and simulation has collapsed.

You will make ethical decisions on behalf of an entire corporation-signing death warrants for entire city blocks—while your own mind slowly fractures into lines of code.

But remember: every breath you take is monitored by three algorithms:

  • CHARL - caring, yet disturbingly opaque

  • Sergeant - a paranoid security script

  • The Judge - cold, impartial, absolute

To them, you are either a valuable asset… or biological waste awaiting disposal.

Early Access - Current State & Roadmap

This is an early version of the game, currently featuring the first standalone episode:

Episode 1: “AGE Inc.”

  • ~1.5–2 hours of gameplay

  • ~22K words of narrative content

The full game is planned as a three-episode experience.
Episodes 2 and 3 will expand the story with an additional:

  • ~2–3 hours of gameplay combined

  • ~60K+ words of narrative content

Why play?

A Reality with Layers
Explore 5 hyper-stylized “mini-horrors” embedded within the main narrative. Each is a distorted genre thriller-from American slasher to Soviet depressive noir-rendered in a bold, uncompromising visual style.

Gameplay as Survival
Your progress is inseparable from your performance in mini-games. These aren’t distractions-they are tools to deceive the AI surveillance system.

Story & Tone
Sharp, ironic dialogue. Deep metaphysical themes of digital servitude. And the bitter humor of someone who already knows the serial number of the axe meant for them.

The Bio-Drone System
Can you outplay the superintelligence “Unburnt Sun” using fragments left behind by failed predecessors? Or will you become just another branch in the corporation’s main update package?

Familiar Mechanics - Reimagined

7 unique mini-games, each reinterpreted within the world of Neo-Uryupinsk:

  • Combat Brick Crusher - Arcade-style battles against security firewalls

  • Classic “Durak” - A psychological duel with Sergeant, where your memory is at stake

  • Domino Reimagined - Build logical chains to bypass corporate restrictions

  • The Memory Trials - Over 100 symbolic fragments to reconstruct the truth hidden behind CHARL’s filters

  • Mahjong - A meditative purge of digital noise from your consciousness

  • Tactical Inventory - Assemble gear in the “real world” (the carriage), accompanied by industrial ASMR

  • Military Training (Clicker) - Upgrade Gleb’s bio-chip to resist sedation protocols

Are you ready to press Ctrl+C on your life… without ever pressing Ctrl+V into reality?

Discover the truth in Neo-Uryupinsk.
If CHARL lets you see it.

Language Support

Currently available languages:
English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, LATAM Portuguese, LATAM Spanish

Planned for the full release:
Italian, German, Polish, Ukrainian, French

store_data.about_the_game:
EXILE

Branded expendable by your own government, you are sent into the Interzone, a sealed quarantine where survival is not promised, only expected.

THE INTERZONE

A dark, violent top down open world consumed by collapse, contamination, and unknown anomalies.

  • A fractured territory with shifting dangers

  • Systems have failed, nothing is stable

  • The environment is as deadly as any enemy

COMMUNICATION

The outside world cannot reach you normally.

  • Orders arrive through artillery fired capsules

  • Messages are fragmented and unreliable

  • Tools sent to you are temporary and flawed

SURVIVAL

Everything revolves around staying alive.

  • Manage hunger, thirst, and exhaustion

  • Monitor radiation and contamination levels

  • Limited medical supplies and recovery options

SCAVENGING

Search what remains of a broken world.

  • Loot abandoned buildings and ruins

  • Explore military zones and underground areas

  • Find food, water, ammo, and rare components

CRAFTING

Create what you cannot find.

  • Craft weapons, tools, and survival gear

  • Repair and reinforce equipment

COMBAT

Every fight is a risk.

  • Face infected, survivors, and hostile factions

  • Use melee weapons, firearms, and explosives

  • Ammunition is scarce, every shot matters

ANOMALIES

The world itself is unstable.

  • Deadly environmental hazards

  • Distort space, damage, or kill instantly

  • Some generate rare and valuable artifacts or might teleport you to different areas

WEAPONS

Adapt your loadout to survive.

  • Melee weapons and improvised tools

  • Pistols, rifles, and shotguns

  • Military grade equipment and rare finds

WORLD & BIOMES

A hostile and varied landscape.

  • Contaminated urban ruins

  • Radioactive industrial zones

  • Dead forests warped by anomalies

  • Military exclusion areas

  • Underground networks and tunnels

FACTIONS

You are not alone.

  • Rebel scavengers

  • Military remnants

  • Black market traders

  • Desperate survivors

  • Infected swarms

QUESTS & OBJECTIVES

Nothing is clearly given.

  • Orders delivered through shells

  • Tasks discovered through exploration

  • Clear zones, retrieve items, investigate anomalies

  • Your actions shift the balance

MULTIPLAYER

Survive your way.

  • Play solo or with others

  • Trade, cooperate, or betray

  • Trust is never guaranteed

THE RULE

Nothing stays stable.

  • Areas change over time

  • Safe paths disappear

  • Every decision has consequences

FINAL

The past is gone.
The Interzone remains.

Move, dodge, shoot, and survive as wave after wave of angry poultry flood the arena. The controls are simple, the action starts quickly, and every run must last a little longer than the last one!

No long setup. No complicated systems.

Start a run, fight as long as you can, then jump straight back in for another attempt. Ideal for short breaks, Steam Deck sessions, and “one more try” gameplay with Controller-friendly gameplay.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are alone on the road, trying to reach an unknown destination. Cars pass by in the night, and strangers offer you rides. Some are kind. Some are not. Some should never have stopped at all.

Walk through desolate highways, abandoned gas stations, fog-covered forests, and empty roadside towns. Meet bizarre, unpredictable characters who may help you… or make you disappear.

Every decision matters. Every ride is a gamble.

CORE GAMEPLAY

Hitchhike across a branching network of roads and stops

Decide which drivers to trust… or avoid

Engage in tense first-person conversations inside moving vehicles

Observe, investigate, and survive unpredictable situations

React through quick-time events in critical moments

Manage survival needs: hunger, thirst, sleep, hygiene, and stress

A WORLD OF PARANOIA

News reports talk about a series of brutal killings across the region. Radio broadcasts warn travelers to be careful. Posters appear in roadside stops with vague descriptions of a possible suspect.

As tension rises, people become more desperate. Drivers demand payment, favors, or silence. Trust becomes a currency more valuable than money.

And sometimes… you may not be the only one hiding something.

SURVIVAL IS NOT ENOUGH

Talk to drivers
Escape from a moving vehicle
Be stopped by the police and questioned

Walk alone through dangerous routes when no one stops

Decide what kind of person you become

But every action changes the world around you.

WALK BETWEEN WORLDS

Not every journey happens inside a car.

You will walk through:Desolate highwaysAbandoned gas stationsFoggy forestsEmpty roadside structures

Bizarre encounters with strangers who shouldn’t be there

Sometimes, the road itself feels alive.

FEATURES

First-person psychological survival horror

Dynamic hitchhiking system with multiple outcomes

Moral choices with long-term consequences

Resource management and survival mechanics

Reactive world shaped by regional fear and crime reports

Multiple endings depending on your journey

THE ROAD DOESN’T CARE WHO YOU ARE

You are not the driver.
You are not in control.

You are just trying to get a ride.

And the road always collects something in return.

CURSOR.EXE is a fast-paced minimalist arcade experience set inside a corrupted digital system.

You are the cursor.

Your goal is to navigate, activate, and deliver signals between nodes while a virus fights you to take complete control. 
Each stage you complete makes the virus more desperate for control. It will begin wasting your time by creating fake nodes, false mission objectives, and find ways to mess with your movement patterns.

The game is focused on short runs with increasing pressure and difficulty rather than long term progression. Mostly designed around reaction speed, movement, and adapting to changing conditions inside the system. 

Can you dominate the virus?

store_data.about_the_game:
"Why should moving a character be as easy as a single click?"

Walking is easy. Sure it is. But is it that easy in this game? If you want to walk, press the 4 keys: [W], [A], [L] and [K]. Exactly those keys. Want to jump? Brace your fingers and press [J], [U], [M] and [P].

You have to jump, air-dash, and dodge lethal spikes to climb your way up. It's quite simple. But it will take some time to get used to.

Moreover, a single missed keystroke could send you plummeting all the way back to the bottom. But hey, you can just climb back up.

Do you have what it takes to master these key chords and reach the top? Yes!

Key Features:

  • The 'Typing Action' Movement System: Execute specific key chords to perform actions. It's not just about timing your jumps; it's about executing the right commands under pressure.

  • Dynamic Vertical World: There is no Game Over. However, you must keep in mind that the higher you climb, the further you can fall from a single mistake.

  • Hardcore Voxel Platformer: Precision is everything. Utilize air-jumps, manage your dash stacks carefully, and avoid the spike traps that will knock you away without mercy.

Controls Overview:

  • Walk: Hold [W] + [A] + [L] + [K]

  • Jump: Press [J] + [U] + [M] + [P]

  • Dash: Hold [D] + [A] + [S] + [H] to charge, release to fire!

  • Menu: Press [M] + [E] + [N] + [U]

  • Exit: SAVE and Exit the game.

(Note: A keyboard with Anti-ghosting / N-Key Rollover supporting at least 4 simultaneous key presses is strictly required to play this game properly!)

store_data.about_the_game:
Story

The Orb has been stolen, trust within the team has collapsed, and Dr. Jim begins a search to uncover who is responsible. The Lakeview Orb 2: Consequences continues directly after the first game, following Dr. Jim as he deals with the fallout of the incident and the uncertainty surrounding the people he once relied on.

Gameplay

This is a short, linear first‑person psychological horror game focused on atmosphere and narrative progression. Players will explore environments connected to Dr. Jim’s search, complete objectives that move the story forward, drive between certain locations as part of the investigation, and watch visual cutscenes that present key moments. The experience is guided, compact, and designed to be completed in a single sitting.

Features

  • Short, linear first‑person narrative experience (less than an hour).

  • Objective‑based progression

  • Driving sections that connect major areas

  • Visual cutscenes that deliver story moments

  • Psychological horror elements and atmospheric tension

  • Direct continuation of the events from The Lakeview Orb

Play Order

This game takes place after the first one. While both games are connected, you can start with either title. The Lakeview Orb 2: Consequences provides enough context for new players, while returning players will recognize it as the next part of the story.

store_data.about_the_game:
Immunity Protocol is a neon pixel-art horde-survival auto-shooter set inside a collapsing biotech system.

Deploy a combat sentinel into a living machine gone hostile. Drift through bloodstream channels, corrupted circuitry, synaptic architecture, and fiber-optic kill zones while swarms, elites, roaming hazards, and recurring boss breaches keep tightening the screen around you. You move. Your arsenal fires automatically. Survival depends on positioning, routing, and building something strong enough to outlast the collapse.

Core Features

  • Manual movement, automatic fire
    Steer through dense enemy pressure while your build handles the shooting.

  • 10 playable sentinel chassis
    Start each run with a distinct weapon, passive identity, and combat style.

  • 6 symbiote companions
    Bring a support organism into battle for tanking, artillery, suppression, shielding, healing, or utility.

  • Build-driven survival runs
    Draft weapons, passives, legends, and run-only augments as the run mutates under pressure.

  • 2 deployment zones, 4 biome identities
    Fight across bloodstream tissue, motherboard corridors, cerebral structures, and fiber-optic lanes with different traversal and encounter reads.

  • Recurring bosses and live hazards
    Survive elite spikes, roaming environmental threats, and biome-routed boss encounters that keep changing the tempo of the run.

  • Persistent laboratory progression
    Archive fragments, secure blueprints, unlock chassis upgrades, expand symbiosis options, and earn achievement bonuses between deployments.

  • Readable neon pixel combat
    High-contrast visuals keep threats, rewards, hazards, and projectiles legible even when the screen turns chaotic.

At Launch Includes

  • 10 playable sentinel chassis

  • 27 weapons

  • 17 passive upgrades

  • 6 symbiote companions

  • 2 deployment zones across 4 biome identities

  • 10 biome-routed bosses

  • 12 achievements with permanent bonuses

Optional AI Windows Hardware Feature
On supported Windows systems, Immunity Protocol can enable optional AI-assisted combat behaviors on verified NPU hardware, including enemy tactics, pressure-direction support, and reward recommendations. This feature is verified-hardware only, is not required to play, and the full game remains fully playable without AI augmentation. The Linux release does not include this optional verified NPU path.

Survive the breach. Rewrite the immune response!

store_data.about_the_game:
The Story of the Soil is in Your Hands!

Beyond the Soil: Farming & Tales Prologue invites you to take the first steps of a peaceful and immersive farming adventure. Far from the chaos, in this valley where it’s just you and nature, you will discover what it means to build a life from scratch and learn the language of the land.

🚜 What Awaits You in This Journey?

  • The Thrill of First Crops: Plow the soil, plant the seeds, and begin mastering the craft of farming by gathering your first harvest.

  • Listen to the Valley Residents: Meet characters like Farmer Jack, help them out, become part of the community, and hear the story of the valley directly from them.

  • Resource Management and Discovery: Chop wood, mine ores, and survive by using the resources around you in the most efficient way.

  • Crafting: Create essential items like fire pits with the materials you collect to develop your living space.

✨ Explore the Mysteries of the Valley!

This beginning opens the doors of the Beyond the Soil world for you. Throughout the Prologue, you will lay the foundations of a deep story, spend time with side activities like fishing, and perhaps find the trail of a loyal friend waiting to be rescued in the heart of nature.

Add Beyond the Soil: Farming & Tales Prologue to your library now and start writing the first page of your own farming legend!

store_data.about_the_game:
You just opened a koshary cart. Simple enough, right?

Wrong. This is Egypt. This is the street. And the street has other plans.

Koshary Chaos is a chaotic street management game set in the heart of Egypt. Take orders, assemble koshary, collect your money and survive everything the neighbourhood decides to throw at you. Because it will throw things. A lot of things. All at once.

The street is alive. Over 20 characters with their own logic, their own agendas, and their own ways of making your life harder or occasionally easier, if you play your cards right. Events unfold the longer you survive. The chaos escalates. Decisions matter.

Some characters can be reasoned with. Some can be avoided. Some will surprise you. And one of them — you'll know him when you meet him — cannot be stopped.

No two rounds play the same. The street is unpredictable, deeply Egyptian, and completely unhinged. But the chaos is universal.

Features:

  • A living open-world Egyptian street with 20+ unique characters

  • Dynamic chaos meter — manage it, or lose everything

  • Random events with modifiers that escalate the longer you survive

  • Missions, unlockables, and level progression

  • Full Arabic and English localization

  • Custom music support — drop your own MP3s and play them on the radio

  • A secret easter egg. You'll find it.

How long can you last before the street wins?

FULLY VOICED IN ENGLISH. Every line. Every character. Every scene.

A waitress. An impossible bill. A supper club where the fog rolls in around six and the staff sometimes don't make it home.

Four romance routes. Five stats. One question: how much of the truth are you willing to find?

Fully Voiced in English: Every line of dialogue, every narrator beat, every late-night conversation — performed from first shift to final ending.

Four Romance Routes: A man with old money and older secrets. A regular who watches more than he drinks. A member who knows what's in the walls. A stranger who shouldn't be there at all. Each route reveals a different piece of the room.

Stat-Driven Investigation: Every choice raises one of five stats — Sharp Eye, Nerve, Wit, Trust, Composure — and unlocks or closes scenes, dialogue, and entire branches of the mystery. The men tell you different parts of the truth. You need all four to see the whole picture.

The Pay Is Too Good: The founding families have owned Crestfall Harbor for over a century. The docks. The hospital. The police. And a private supper club that doesn't appear on any public registry.

This is The Server.

store_data.about_the_game:
Cheese Stack -  is a cozy puzzle game where you arrange falling pieces of cheese into perfect rows. Simple rules, delicious graphics, upbeat music, and a highscore table you'll be tempted to beat. It's the perfect way to relax for 5 minutes or lose yourself in the game for an hour.

How does it work?

Slices of different shapes fall from above. Your task is to rotate them and arrange them to fill horizontal lines. Once you've filled them, the row disappears with a pleasant sound, earning you points. If you don't make it, the stack grows. Everything brilliant is simple.

What makes Cheese Stack special?

🧀 Cheese instead of boring blocks

Each piece is hand-drawn: holes, jagged edges, golden hues. Swiss, Gouda, Cheddar, Parmesan—they're a joy to examine, not just to stack.

🏆 Your Leaderboard

The game remembers your best scores. Beating your own high score is a whole other level of fun. Got friends over? Hand them the controller and see who can do it better.

🎵 Music that stays in your head

Joyful jazz and French tunes that set the rhythm without being overwhelming. You'll find yourself humming them in line at the store.

👶👴 For everyone from 5 to 99 years old

No complex plots, violence, or microtransactions. The rules are explained in 10 seconds. Kids master the controls instantly, and adults appreciate the depth—the further you go, the faster the pieces fall.

store_data.about_the_game:
Cinematic Business is a deep film-industry management simulator. You run a production studio as both producer and CEO — every screenplay, every casting decision, every release date is yours to make. There are no shortcuts and no "right" answer: you read the talent, you read the market, and you live with the result on opening weekend.

The simulation tracks each creator as a person with a career, not a stat block. Writers grow stronger after every project. Directors form opinions about you. Actors collect filmographies the press will remember. Rival studios run their own pipelines on the same rules you do, with their own strategic profiles, budgets, and ambitions. The industry keeps moving whether you ship a film this year or not.

Develop the Screenplay

Brief your writers on genre, setting, period, themes, tone balance, and role structure. Pick one or two screenwriters from your studio or the open market — their talent, speed, reliability, and genre fit shape what the script becomes. Track the screenplay's idea score, structure, characters, style, logic, worldbuilding, and tone control as it develops. Order corrections, change the writing team mid-project, or shelve the draft if it isn't working.

Assemble the Crew

Run a director kickoff to lock the creative brief, then attach a director by direct pick, shortlist, or open search. Negotiate creative freedom, scenario rights, casting influence, and pace. Cast leads, supporting roles, and minor parts through shortlists, open casting, or director-led picks. Assign a camera operator and lock down shooting locations and stages before the preparation deadline runs out.

Run the Production

Preproduction, shooting, and postproduction each carry their own decisions, costs, and risks. Plan picture editing, sound, music, VFX, and animation work — choose between in-house capacity, outsourced postproduction houses, or premium music options from library tracks to original scores to star composers. Every choice feeds into a ten-category quality score that decides how the film actually plays.

Compete in a Living Industry

AI studios run the full pipeline alongside you, driven by procedural strategic profiles: commercial focus, expansion aggressiveness, producer control, long-term strategy, market reactivity, and financial status. They greenlight projects, hire crews, and release films based on the same world you operate in. The press covers everything — start announcements, reviews, director picks, breakout hits, year-end top lists. Festivals run on a real calendar with nominations, juries, and prestige weights.

Release and Results

Sign distribution contracts, build marketing campaigns with hype tracking across stages, and pick a release date that gives postproduction and marketing room to land. Premiere day converts the entire production chain into reviews, audience numbers, and box office — weekly, by year, and all-time. Strong films collect festival nominations and awards that follow the creators who made them.

Build Your Studio

Expand stages, postproduction rooms, casting offices, and development capacity. Hire permanent writers and production managers, build production teams, and grow your reputation across regions. Decisions you make in year one shape the talent willing to work with you in year ten.

Features

  • Full film pipeline from screenplay brief to box office and festival results

  • Deep creator simulation — writers, directors, actors, operators, and production managers with statistics, careers, and project histories

  • SI rival studios with distinct strategic profiles

  • Press ecosystem with reviews, news coverage, and year-end coverage

  • Festival calendar with nominations, awards, and prestige rules

  • Box office tracking — weekly, yearly, all-time, by region

  • Modular creator sets — the game ships with a default set, with more sets and community-friendly JSON authoring planned

  • Difficulty modes and three career starting points: Startup, Professional, Hollywood

Early Access

Cinematic Business is launching in Early Access. The full pipeline — from screenplay to release, including AI competitors, press, and festivals — is playable today. Early Access is where we tune balance, expand creator content, add scenarios, and shape the simulation around player feedback. See the Early Access section above for details on plans and current state.
