store_data.about_the_game:
Soothe is a brief single-player puzzle game characterized by dingey, dystopian architecture and bizarre, abstract imagery. Focus, patience, and attention to detail will serve you well.

You are a lone machine left behind in this strange environment, sporting an extendable grappling claw on your right arm and a melted screen on your left. You will be presented with a series of thematic challenges designed to evoke thoughts of what we value in the lives we all live. The grapple on your right can be used to collect distant objects and interact with the various interfaces you'll need to use to progress through this surreal place. Your only guidance will come from the glass fused into your left hand, and it directs you foremost to do one simple thing - reach the light above. 

Unpack the meaning behind the rooms and find a way to get what you want. That is, after all, more important than anything else. Right?

store_data.about_the_game:
An island. An active volcano. A station to build before it wakes up.

Build, expand, transform

Gather what the terrain offers, order equipment through the Institute's supply chain, assemble your first workbench — then a laboratory, a sensor network, generators, enough to power it all. Each tier unlocks the next. A patch of bare rock becomes, piece by piece, a running facility. And you fund it however you want: science for the Institute, volcanic crops the port can't get enough of, or what a quieter channel takes off your hands through the lava tubes. The station you end up building tells the story of the markets you served.

Read what the volcano is saying

Seismometers, SO₂ sensors, ground deformation readings: each instrument delivers a fragment, none gives the full picture. Cross-referencing the signals, separating pattern from noise — that's what turns a passive station into a system that sees things coming.

Then everything tips

The volcano erupts. Hikers are trapped by the flow. You lift off from your platform and run evacuation rotations — limited capacity, a timer on each group, the lava closing in. Then the front turns back toward your station: hold the line, divert the flow, choose what you save. A few minutes of adrenaline that put everything you've built to the test.

Your call, your consequences

Alert the Institute or wait for more data: nobody decides for you. The reputation you earn in a crisis funds the next one. Rebuild, prepare better — the volcano comes back.

store_data.about_the_game:
Do you like Boba?

There is no true answer to this age old question. But some say should you choose to find one, the Elevator is the only way there. 

Explore...

Take the Elevator through endless floors seeking a way to reach the top. Be wary of the danger waiting for you as you through each floor. 

Main Features:

  • Online Co-Op: Don't face the dark alone! Bring up to 5 friends to join you on the journey. That's 4 chances that they will be eaten instead of you!

  • Boba: Boba.

  • Suspenseful First-Person Exploration: Navigate claustrophobic, procedurally generated floors where every dark corner could hide the answer you're looking for. Or just a freaky monster. 

  • Terrifying Entities & Jump Scares: You'll definitely want a flashlight when exploring each floor so you don't go head to head with one of the abominations roaming the darkness.

  • Proximity-Based Voice Chat: Keep close to your friends to communicate, because sound doesn't travel far in the oppressive dark.

  • Weapons: Weapons?! Yes, weapons. If you are lucky enough, maybe you'll find firearms left behind by previous pursuers of Boba. They can be of great help to you and your friends as you push upwards. Just be careful, bullets hurt.

Bring Friends. The Journey Is Grim.

Misery loves company. So grab your friends! Up to five fellow Boba Enthusiasts (or just regular friends) can take the plunge with you into the procedurally generated darkness via online co-op. Survival depends on teamwork! Watch each other's backs, turn on a flashlight when the light grows thin, and coordinate your efforts to find a way to the next floor.

When The Elevator Opens, Push Forward.

Do you like Boba? The answer must be found. Travel each floor looking for the exit, or any clues that can take you further toward the answer. (To put it simply: Run, try not to get eaten, find the exit that takes you to the next floor.)

Utility: Find some flashlights and walkie-talkies hidden around each floor. They're a great asset in helping you navigate and communicate with your friends if you get lost or separated.

Weapons: Firearms can provide a major boost to your survivability... or they'll be your demise. Ammo is a rare find and sometimes being loud is the fastest way to meet your end. 

Cowardice Will Be Punished: Those who seek Boba are not afraid. Those who are afraid will suffer. Be wary of your behaviors in game- as people who tend to chicken out are more likely to be tormented...

Take the Elevator through endless floors seeking a way to reach the top. Be wary of the danger waiting for you as you through each floor. 

Main Features:

  • Online Co-Op: Don't face the dark alone! Bring up to 5 friends to join you on the journey. That's 4 chances that they will be eaten instead of you!

  • Boba: Boba.

  • Suspenseful First-Person Exploration: Navigate claustrophobic, procedurally generated floors where every dark corner could hide the answer you're looking for. Or just a freaky monster. 

  • Terrifying Entities & Jump Scares: You'll definitely want a flashlight when exploring each floor so you don't go head to head with one of the abominations roaming the darkness.

  • Proximity-Based Voice Chat: Keep close to your friends to communicate, because sound doesn't travel far in the oppressive dark.

  • Weapons: Weapons?! Yes, weapons. If you are lucky enough, maybe you'll find firearms left behind by previous pursuers of Boba. They can be of great help to you and your friends as you push upwards. Just be careful, bullets hurt.

Bring Friends. The Journey Is Grim.

Misery loves company. So grab your friends! Up to five fellow Boba Enthusiasts (or just regular friends) can take the plunge with you into the procedurally generated darkness via online co-op. Survival depends on teamwork! Watch each other's backs, turn on a flashlight when the light grows thin, and coordinate your efforts to find a way to the next floor.

When The Elevator Opens, Push Forward.

Do you like Boba? The answer must be found. Travel each floor looking for the exit, or any clues that can take you further toward the answer. (To put it simply: Run, try not to get eaten, find the exit that takes you to the next floor.)

Utility: Find some flashlights and walkie-talkies hidden around each floor. They're a great asset in helping you navigate and communicate with your friends if you get lost or separated.

Weapons: Firearms can provide a major boost to your survivability... or they'll be your demise. Ammo is a rare find and sometimes being loud is the fastest way to meet your end. 

Cowardice Will Be Punished: Those who seek Boba are not afraid. Those who are afraid will suffer. Be wary of your behaviors in game- as people who tend to chicken out are more likely to be tormented...
store_data.short_description: Boba is a co-op FPS horror game. Journey through multiple floors, stopping at each one to route power back to the Elevator of Life in order to continue your journey. The floors are always changing so you never know what to expect. Be very careful! Those who ride the Elevator have never returned...

Enter a vast magical world shaped by war, ambition, and shifting allegiances.

In Sellsword, you are not a chosen hero, but a mercenary carving your own path through conflict. Pick your character by choosing from different characters, each offering unique strengths, playstyles, and progression paths.

store_data.about_the_game:
"The recorder lies. The blood lies. And so do you."

Twelve researchers. Nine days. Something is wearing their faces.

Deep Frost is a Carpenter-flavored social-deduction roguelike set on Halström Outpost 7, a failing Antarctic research station where a parasitic intelligence called the Thaw has begun copying its hosts. One by one, the crew is being replaced. You are one of them. Maybe.

Every run, every trait, every relationship is randomized. Every day a new body goes through the airlock. You have until Day 9 to identify the infected, survive the blood test, and hold the station together long enough for the helicopter to return.

Features


  • Full social verb set, chat, ask, plant, defuse, accuse, bribe, specialty, study. Every interaction moves suspicion in a hidden network of 12 contestants.
  • Round-table interrogation, you get questioned too. Lie convincingly or burn.
  • The Thaw sync and queen mechanic, infections spread through contact. The queen rewrites the rules.
  • Anomaly run modifiers — White Noise, Frost Loop, Blood Moon, Recorder Lies. No two runs play the same.
  • Station-ops missions, patch the reactor, hack the airlock, run the blood analysis. Failures cascade.
  • Trait-aware rapport, five relationship tiers per contestant. Treat them right and they'll testify for you. Burn them and they won't.
  • Codex, unlock lore fragments across runs. Halström has lost a crew every eight years. Someone should have told you.
  • Save / continue, day-boundary autosave. The station remembers.

Twelve named contestants. Not random meeples.


KESH won't meet your eye after Day 6. MOIRA's recordings stop matching the timestamps. Dr. Vance's grudge with the surgeon goes back to a paper neither of them will discuss. Every contestant is named, traited, and procedurally pulled into a web of grudges, debts, and quiet loyalties. You learn them. You start to care which ones survive. You vote one out anyway.

Singleplayer. No baggage.


  • No matchmaking queues
  • No microtransactions, no battle pass, no cosmetics store
  • No teenage Discord griefers
  • No cheaters, no smurfs, no "the host left"
  • No scheduling four friends at 2am

The deduction lives in the procedural NPCs. The lies are written, not typed. One purchase, one game, twelve liars, nine days.

Inspirations


If you loved The Thing (1982), Gnosia, or Among Us and wished for a singleplayer horror experience with more teeth, this is that game. Think of it as a single-player Among Us with a story — and a body count that has names attached.

Tone


Paranoid. Cold. Carpenter-flavored. No jump scares. The dread builds in the silences between dialog options, in the way KESH won't meet your eye on Day 6, in the recorder entry that says you were somewhere you weren't, in the blood test on Day 4 when the centrifuge hums and nobody blinks.

Solo dev


Deep Frost is built and released by AeonGames. Audio sourced under Creative Commons from OpenGameArt and Pixabay (full credits in-game). Visual art AI-assisted. Written, coded, designed, and tested by one person over a year.

Controls


  • WASD / Arrow keys, move
  • E / Space, interact
  • F1, mechanics briefing
  • Esc, pause

content_descriptors.notes: Deep Frost is a singleplayer psychological horror game set in a 1980s Antarctic research station. Expect scenes of violent death (corpses, frozen bodies, blood from accidents and killings) presented in a slow-burn, atmospheric style rather than gore-focused. NPC dialogue contains mild profanity. Themes include isolation, paranoia, mistrust, and a body-snatcher antagonist who copies members of the crew. No explicit sexual content. No drug use. No jumpscares.

Aschente is a 2D action roguelite where you build your own spells.

Mix magical chants to change how your spells behave. Split projectiles midair, create spiraling explosions, chain attacks across enemies, or flood the battlefield with upredictable magic.

Some spells work exactly as planned.

Others make you go:

“...wait, why are there MORE?”

Your magic grows wilder as your build evolves, filling the screen with strange reactions, unexpected combos, and fireworks that barely stay under control. Enemies push back, interrupt your setup, and force you to adapt in the middle of the fight.

Every run becomes a battle against the chaos you created yourself.

Master your magic. Or keep casting and hope for the best!

Mine, build, upgrade, and extract. Scavenge the stars in a resource-management sim focused on base building and survival. Gather materials, construct facilities, and order units to thrive in a hostile galaxy. Fortify your temporary base and secure your haul for a clean escape before it’s too late.

Mine & Process Resources

Gather raw resources from the planet's surface and process them into high-value assets through automated systems. Every scrap you scavenge is a vital building block for expanding your base and surviving the harshest reaches of the galaxy.

Manage units

Maximize operational efficiency by assigning specialized task priorities to your units. From auto-mining to maintaining structures, you must strategically manage and upgrade your workforce to keep your production lines running around the clock.

Expand your base

Build a temporary outpost from the ground up and evolve it into a high-tech facility. Research advanced technologies and design optimized logistics to outlast the hostile planetary environment.

Extract with caution

No matter how much resources you have, your efforts are in vain if you fail to escape the planet alive. Before the planetary threats reach a breaking point, make a swift exit with your secured haul.

Features

  • Base Automation

  • Strategic Unit Command

  • Resource Management

  • High-Stakes Extraction

Pixel art meets medieval nostalgia in a modern roguelike turn-based game. You are a fledgling adventurer from the Duchy of Lyle. Faced with a crumbling kingdom overrun by goblin hordes, you must traverse randomly generated deadly dungeons and rise as the hero who saves all. Forests, swamps, snowy plains, deserts, abandoned ancient cities... every step unveils a new path and unknown events.



Swordsman crushes foes with heavy blades, Assassin strikes from the shadows, Mage bombards from afar, Alchemist concocts arcane potions, Guardian stands unbreakable. Each class offers a completely different combat style. Mix and match skills, items, and sub-classes freely—no restrictions, imagination is the only limit.



Battle greedy goblin tribes, savage orcs, and eerie undead armies—every step demands careful planning. One mistake can ruin everything, but a perfect combo will send your adrenaline soaring with an explosive rush of satisfaction!



Random events, mighty artifacts, hidden bosses, sub-classes... you never know if the next encounter will be a blessing or a disaster. Death means rebirth, with countless build combinations and surprises waiting to be conquered. Countless heroes have fallen here, countless legends have been born—will you be the next to become a legend? Add to your wishlist now and embark on a pixel legend journey!

Play with 2 to 6 crewmates as you traverse space, gather resources, survive disasters, battle aliens and each other's incompetence before the sun goes supernova. Can you keep your SHIP together?
store_data.detailed_description:
WORK TOGETHER (GOOD LUCK WITH THAT)

All Hands on Deck? You'll need to rely on your crewmates if you want any hope of making it through space alive, not that they'll be much help. Repair damaged systems, respond to emergencies and work together to stop small problems from becoming full ship-wide disasters.


EXPLORE SPACE (WHAT COULD POSSIBLY GO WRONG?)

Chart your course through space, explore dangerous locations and alien hazards you probably weren't ready for. Gather the resources you need to keep your ship running and escape the solar system before time runs out and the sun goes supernova.


SURVIVE (SKILL ISSUE)

Space doesn’t care about you! Aliens, fires, broken systems, and disasters you definitely didn't plan for can strike at any moment. Think fast, adapt to the chaos and try to hold it together long enough to finish the mission.


KEEP YOUR SHIP TOGETHER! (OR DON'T, SEE WHAT HAPPENS)

Your ship is your only lifeline. Without it you're just floating in space, which is not ideal. Keep it repaired, keep your crew alive and hold everything together long enough to make it out in one piece.


EVERY RUN IS DIFFERENT (FRESH CHAOS EVERY TIME)

Sector-based runs mean every jump brings new risks, resources and decisions. No two missions play out the same way, so whatever worked last time probably won't save you now.


RANK UP (GATEKEPT BY YOUR OWN INCOMPETENCE)

Take on crew roles, earn upgrades, unlock new abilities and climb the ranks. Survive long enough and you might even look like you know what you're doing.


KEY FEATURES (NO CAP)

  • 2–6 player online co-op aboard a failing starship

  • Space survival action with repairs, combat, crafting, scavenging and exploration

  • Dynamic ship emergencies including fires, hull breaches, oxygen loss, rogue AI and system failures

  • Alien threats and infestations that force the crew to respond fast or lose control

  • Sector-based runs where each jump brings new risks, resources and decisions

  • Crew roles and progression with upgrades, rank, unlocks and status rewards

  • High replayability driven by unpredictable disasters and crew-driven chaos

  • CROWDPLAY features planned for streamer and spectator interaction

  • Big dumb fun with enough pressure to matter and enough stupidity to make failure worth it!


DESIGNED FOR STREAMS, CLIPS AND CROWDPLAY (WATCH THIS SPACE)

Some games are fun to play. Some are fun to watch.

STARSHIP BLOOPERS is being built for both.

With Crowdplay features planned from the start, spectators will be able to influence the chaos and help turn every mission into a live, interactive disaster show.

Your viewers might save you. Your viewers might doom you. Either way, they’ll be part of the story.

More coming soon...


WORK IN PROGRESS

Please note that STARSHIP BLOOPERS is currently in early pre-production. All assets/visuals are work-in-progress and subject to change.

>>> WELCOME TO PROJECT B.L.U.E.

B.L.U.E. [Build, Launch, Upgrade, Evolve] is an simulation software designed by BlueHeaven Aerospace Corporation for training our engineers in space exploration, ship design and combat. It involves realistic simulations of both space physics and current technologies within the BlueHeaven product lineups. Your mission as the B.L.U.E. engineer is to Build the best ships, Fight other candidates, Improve your designs and Evolve your skills!

NOTICE: THE CURRENT STATE OF B.L.U.E. IS ONLY FOR CONCEPT VALIDATION, IT IS NOT NOT NOT A FULL GAME, EXPECT POTENTIAL BUGS AND PERFORMANCE ISSUES!

>>> SHIP BUILDING SYSTEM

Every spaceship in B.L.U.E. is player designed. We have a list of modular components for propulsion, radiation, combat, structure, defense, etc. Choose the parts for your dreadnought, snippers, interceptors or destroyers, and beat your friends or opponents in a way they never thought off!

Also, remember to be Cost Efficient! BlueHeaven Aerospace awards employees with designs that minimizes our cost in missions.

>>> PHYSICS AWARE SHIP PERFORMANCE

The maneuverbility and performace of your ship is entirely dependent on your design! B.L.U.E. uses a serious of physics simulations to compute mass, thrust and moment of inertia or your ship. If you cannot move or turn, there are some engines or RCS you forgot to add!

>>> HEAT AND RADIATION

How comes every space movie forget about HEAT! Every part on your ship generates heat, and we have an full heat conduction simulator. If you don't build these radiators to get rid of the heat you are gonna burn bright hot!

>>> Fight! Fight! Fight!

Finally its time to Test your design! hop into or start a server, call up your friends, and fight with your ship! Testing is the only way to validate and improve stuff in Aerospace, so embark and enjoy!

store_data.about_the_game:
The gold rush has transformed the quiet frontier town of Leadville into a battleground for greed and justice. When a gang of bandits ambushes a silver carriage bound for the bank, a deadly showdown ensues. Will the sheriff’s posse manage to protect the valuable shipment, or will the outlaws make off with the loot?

Leadville is a grid-based hidden movement strategy game. Each turn, players secretly plan the movement and shot direction of their crew, trying tooutmaneuver their rivals. The map is filled with obstacles and boons: covers, aids, and traps, and the ever-moving gold wagon that may decide the game’s finale.

In the Wild West, there are no second chances: only those with quick thinking and a steady aim prevail. Choose which side of the law you're on.

Leadville is a board game adaptation of the upcoming same-named board game by Ramezware.

Campaign

Single Player (PvE)

PvP (up to 4 players)

store_data.about_the_game:
Day one: a coal mine, an iron mine, a well, a farm. That's it. Earth is modern but empty of space infrastructure, and the only way forward is to build it yourself.

Mine coal to make power. Smelt iron into steel. Refine oil into rocket fuel. Process air into oxygen and nitrogen. Grow the supply chain until you've got electronics, composites, and a rocket assembly plant. Then you launch.

Low orbit is a station, not a home — a staging point you use to reach the Moon. The Moon has polar ice and regolith and no atmosphere. Mars has thin air full of CO2 and enough water locked in the ground to run a Sabatier reactor and brew your own methane. Each world is a new economy you have to rebuild for the environment you're in.

Transport ties it all together. Ships run fixed loops between worlds — Earth to orbit to the Moon, Earth to Mars, Moon to Mars — hauling whatever cargo you tell them to haul. You pick the stops. You pick the cargo. You scale the fleet. A single screen shows every line in your network at a glance, green where it's flowing and red where it's stalled.

No lose state. Close the game for a week and your colonies are still there, making things, waiting.

Key Features

The gameplay is logistics, production, and network-building — not piloting or physics. The systems below are what ships today.

  • A production chain built on real recipes: Rockets burn RP-1 kerosene refined from crude oil. Mars methane comes out of a Sabatier reactor fed by local CO2 and hydrogen split from water ice. Steel is iron ore cooked in a smelter. Nothing is magic. Everything is a recipe.

  • Four worlds, four economies: Earth, low orbit, the Moon, and Mars. Each has its own buildings, its own resources, and its own production problems to solve. You don't pilot ships or manage orbits — you build the supply chain that keeps each world fed.

  • Transport is the game: Ships run fixed loops between worlds. Pick the stops, pick the cargo, scale the fleet. Watch the whole network on a single screen and catch the one line that just stalled.

  • A tech tree you can follow: Power Systems. Atmospheric Processing. Fuel Chemistry. Rocket Engineering. Orbital Operations. Lunar Exploration. Mars Transit. Every tech unlocks a building you can actually build.

  • Population that you have to keep alive: Colonies need habitats, food, water, and oxygen. People are your workforce, and losing the supply chain that supports them doesn't kill them — it just stops everything from working. Managing that tension is half the game.

  • Offline progress that respects your time: Close the tab. Close it for a week. The game keeps ticking. Come back to stockpiles and a running economy.

  • Ranks to chase: Tiered achievements on every resource and building, feeding a 20-rank ladder from Ground Crew to Stellar Vanguard.

  • Built for long play: Auto-save every 30 seconds. Export and import your save. An example save for exploring a mid-game state. Four theme presets plus full color customization. A curated soundtrack. A desktop client with a clean borderless window and updates that land without asking.

store_data.about_the_game:
Relaxing Zen or Total Chaos. You Choose!

Welcome to the ultimate physics playground where the only limit is your imagination. Whether you want to build a hypnotic, ASMR-style loop or a massive, logic-defying mechanical beast, Crafty Marbles gives you the tool you need!

🛠️ Build Anything, Break Everything

Lay down miles of track in seconds or spend hours tweaking every angle and speed to perfection.

  • Snap & Go: Connect tons of modules instantly with intuitive, click-to-snap building.

  • Complex Contraptions: Integrate spinning hammers, smashing rackets, and gravity-defying obstacles.

  • Deep Logic: Combine sensors, triggers, and mechanical parts to create fully automated marvels.

🏁 The Greatest Spectacle

Your marbles aren’t just props, they’re the stars of the show. Give them names, skin them with unique textures, and pit them against each other in high-stakes races.

  • Emergent Drama: Watch marbles collide, recover, and battle for the lead through branching paths and hidden shortcuts.

  • The Trap Factor: Will you build a fair race, or a gauntlet of doom filled with blockers and giant swinging clubs?

  • Cinematic Chaos: Switch to the follow-cam and experience your creation from the marble's perspective.

🎨 A Living, Breathing Toy Box

Why stop at tracks? Populate your worlds with a cast of animated characters, robots, and animals.

  • Build Anywhere: Construct your race on the back of a giant creature or inside any environment you can imagine.

  • Expressive Aesthetics: A vibrant, playful style that makes every run look like a work of art.

  • Absurd Machinery: Use rackets, pins, hands, or whatever you want to catapult your marbles across the map.

🌐 Share the Genius (and the Madness)

The fun doesn’t end when you finish your build.

  • Steam Workshop Integration: Upload your masterpieces and share your creations with the entire world!

  • Remix Culture: Download community maps, see how their logic works, and add your own wild twist.

  • Infinite Inspiration: There’s always a new track to explore, a new mechanic to learn, and a new way to make things go zoom.

"It’s like the toy box you always wanted as a kid, but with infinite parts and no cleanup."

🚀 Wishlist Now to Join the Sandbox!

Don’t miss out on the most satisfying physics experience of 2026. Hit that Wishlist button to get notified the second we launch, and tell your friends about the incoming marble mayhem!

store_data.about_the_game:
A town. A stairway. A lot of missing adventurers.

Many years ago, in the middle of Desolation, someone found a stairway leading down into a huge labyrinth. Since then, adventurers from across the Seven Kingdoms have come looking for fame, fortune, and powerful artifacts.

A few return rich.  Most do not return at all.

Dungeons of Desolation Remastered brings back the Xbox Live Indie Games dungeon crawler from 2012: turn-based, grid-based, loot-heavy, and built around the dangerous idea that you can probably survive one more floor.

Descend into 25+ dungeon levels filled with procedural layouts, dozens of monsters, and more than 150 items to find, equip, drink, sell, or regret picking up. No two trips below Desolation are quite the same.

Build your adventurer through stats, gear, and over 100 skills. Fight with swords, axes, maces, daggers, shields, or magic. Focus on combat, detection, healing, protection, enchantment, or whatever build keeps you alive long enough to reach the next staircase.

Then return to town.  Talk to the townsfolk, they might help you out, for a price...

In Desolation death is not always the end, but it is never free. When you fall in the dungeon, the Wheel of Fate decides what you lose before your next attempt. Gold. Experience. Items. Progress. Maybe something worse.

Features

  • Turn-based, grid-based dungeon crawling

  • 25+ dungeon levels to explore

  • Procedural floors that change every descent

  • Randomized items and loot drops, so no two playthroughs are the same

  • 150+ items, weapons, armour pieces, potions, and gear

  • 100+ skills across combat, magic, defence, detection, healing, and more

  • Dozens of monsters lurking below town

  • Town hub for shopping, recovery, and preparation

  • Die? Play a game of fate with Death. You might get lucky...

  • Feeling confident? Play Hardcore Mode with enhanced difficulty and permadeath, but with extra XP, loot, and gold

  • Remastered from the Xbox Live Indie Games era

Can you discover the secrets lurking in the deepest depths?

store_data.about_the_game:
In Hide or Seek: Container Island, you can play as a hider or seeker. While playing as a hider (SOLO, COOP, PVP), you have to hide from seekers until you get picked up to be dropped off in another area. You must be at the Pick Up zone at the end! You have to go through multiple areas to finally escape Container Island. Look for magic potions hidden mostly inside containers to help you escape but watch out for unexpected creatures and traps!

As a seeker (PVP only), your mission is to stop all hiders from escaping Container Island. You can also use some of the magic potions, but you also may have to deal with those creatures. Teamwork is crucial to find and capture the hiders.

MAGIC POTIONS

Magic potions take hiding and seeking to a whole new level. Potions can make a hider or seeker run faster, become invisible or heal faster.  Certain potions can be used only certain hiders and certain seekers. In coop or pvp, collect potions for others on your team to help them survive. 

2 CLASSES, MANY CHARACTERS

The hider class, NegoNego cats, has over 10 characters to choose from. Each character can initially use only a certain set of magic potions and can upgrade to more potions after having earned rewards.

The seeker class, Dhug dogs, also has more than 10 characters to choose from and can be upgraded to use more options, abilities, custom outfits, and accessories after having earned rewards.

New characters will be introduced frequently.

UNPREDICTABLE MAPS

You will have to escape from several randomly picked maps from more than 30 maps. Every time you play, each map will have different creatures and traps. No matter how many times you play, you will have a completely different experience. New maps and creatures will be introduced frequently. 

CREATURES and TRAPS

Expect the unexpected. These creatures and traps will make both hiding and seeking more challenging. Some creatures and traps may only affect hiders or seekers or both. Some potions may protect hiders and seekers from some creatures and traps and some may not.


SOLO, COOP OR PVP

As solo hider, you will have to deal with numerous AI seeker dogs chasing after you. You will have to heavily rely on magic potions you find. As COOP hiders, you should rely on each other to find potions for each other and also distract seekers from a hider about to get captured.

store_data.about_the_game:
Rediscover a Lost Civilization

A millennia ago, the Rune Civilization carved the laws of the world into these stones. Now, they slumber in eternal darkness. You will step into the shoes of a silent archaeologist venturing deep into these subterranean caverns. There is no complex combat here—only the mysterious resonance emanating from ancient stone arrays. Your mission is to awaken these long-dormant runes.

Rune Resonance

Experience a sophisticated dual-layer matching system:

The Rune Altar: The altar is stacked with ancient rune stones in intricate patterns. Every puzzle is a test of spatial hierarchy and logical sequencing.

The Guardian Echoes: Translucent spiritual echoes float throughout the cave, constantly bouncing and moving to obstruct the altar runes below. You must track and match these moving targets in real-time to clear a path to the stones beneath them.

Dynamic Hazards and Variations

The deeper you go, the more the cave resists your presence. As your exploration intensifies, the ancient restrictions within the caverns grow increasingly strange and volatile.

Guaranteed Solvability

Every floor is 100% solvable through logic and strategy. Every altar ensures a definitive path to victory. Failure is never a matter of luck, but a result of the choices you make when faced with multiple paths and complex decisions.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE ORDER OF THE DAMNED is a dark-fantasy action-RPG from the shadows of Arthurian legend.

As Duran, one of the last remnants of a fallen Order of knights, you must choose your path as you fight to uncover the mystery of the Spectre that haunts you and destroy the ancient darkness of The Revenant. Steel your abilities as a warrior, master the mysteries of the arcane or hone your many talents as you develop your character through a branching skill tree. There are many souls, friend and foe, to encounter on your journey through the wasteland. Many decisions you must face. The choices you make matter and will shape your ultimate fate - and that of your world.

Discover the faded ruins and lost legends of a mythical post-Roman Britain. In the deepest shadows of haunted forests, through the frozen wilderness of barren mountains, to the ancient stones that stand older than time itself, explore a broken world shrouded in darkness and mystery as you search for what remnants are whispered to survive. 


 

The battle is yours. Cut down your enemies in furious real-time combat or learn to harness the Spectre that haunts you to unleash lethal devastation. Hone your skills in various weaponry and chain deadly attack moves as you forge a bloody path through the forces that assail you. 

The Order Of The Damned is a darkly atmospheric RPG with old-school DNA. With unforgiving action, a deep, challenging narrative and a haunted world to discover, forge your path in a land of legend where duty and destiny collide.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Follow Alice into the abyss."

Project Rabbit is an Extraction Soulslike Action RPG inspired by a dark fantasy reimagining of Alice in Wonderland.

Fight, explore, and survive within the twisted abyss of time. Will you escape the madness, or be consumed by it?

[Into the Abyss of Time]

When the power of dimensions collapsed, continents from different realms became entangled into a single world, and within the cracks between them, the “Abyss of Time” was born.

The Abyss is a twisted world sealed away by the Blood Queen.

Within it wander beings that neither age nor die, trapped in an endless cycle of time.

Those who survived the darkness of the Abyss built the last refuge beneath a fading barrier of light.

But the barrier is slowly losing its power.

To survive, someone must once again step into the Abyss.

Will you survive the madness consuming the Abyss of Time alongside Alice?

[Forge Your Own Way to Fight the Madness]

Within the Abyss of Time, even the smallest mistake can lead to a fatal end.

Use dodges, parries, and a variety of combat skills to battle against beings consumed by madness.

Discover hidden treasures and forgotten secrets buried deep within the Abyss, and forge your own combat style through countless combinations of weapons, equipment, and skills.

[Explore the Abyss Together — And Return Alive]

Venture into the dangerous Abyss of Time alone, or alongside your allies.

Within the Abyss, it is not only creatures consumed by madness that await you, but also unpredictable encounters with other survivors.

If you manage to claim valuable treasures and resources, you must survive and make it back alive before losing everything.

4683520.name: Late Ming: County Magistrate Simulation & Management

store_data.about_the_game:
Late Ming: Magistrate Simulation & Management is an immersive county reconstruction simulation game set against the chaotic background of the late Ming Dynasty. You will play as a county magistrate appointed in times of crisis, taking charge of a border county in ruins. Faced with famine, banditry, harsh governance and displaced people, you must make choices amid numerous crises, lead this small town to rise again from the ruins, and seek a glimmer of survival in this turbulent era.

 

As the local governor, your primary duty is to govern people’s livelihood. The civilian system in the game shows the real lives of ordinary people in troubled times. You need to pay attention to public sentiment, assign corvée labor, adjust grain prices and comfort displaced refugees. Every policy you issue will directly affect public support. Unstable public sentiment will make people flee; with popular support, civilians will voluntarily repair city walls, cultivate farmlands, and even stand up to defend the county in times of danger.

In troubled times, intelligence is the key to survival. The game’s unique spy system acts as your eyes and ears, allowing you to perceive everything around you. You can send spies to infiltrate enemy camps, penetrate local noble clans, or investigate the movements of surrounding forces. The intelligence they bring back will serve as a vital basis for you to formulate strategies and resolve crises. Yet be cautious: spies may meet misfortune or be instigated by enemies, delivering deadly false information.

When bandits invade, public support and wisdom alone cannot safeguard your land. You need to establish and develop your military system. From recruiting local warriors and training militias to forging weapons and building city defenses, every step requires careful planning. You can deploy troops personally and command city defense battles to fend off invaders, or adopt conciliatory policies to reach agreements with neighboring forces. The choice between war and peace will profoundly shape the fate of your county.

Talent is the most precious resource in chaotic times. Through the recruitment system, you can discover various talents among refugees, local warriors and impoverished scholars. Some excel at farming and greatly boost crop yields; others master martial arts and become core military forces; a few are well-versed in strategies and offer valuable counsel. Reasonable talent allocation will strongly support your county governance and foreign defense.

To sustain all these undertakings, you must build your county from scratch. The construction system lets you plan urban layouts, gradually transforming ruins into an impregnable border stronghold with government offices, granaries, barracks and workshops. The warehouse system is your lifeline: manage grain, wood, ore, armaments and other supplies properly, balance income and expenditure, and withstand the dual trials of famine and warfare. When resources run short, you can trade with other towns to exchange limited goods for survival.

The game’s map system presents a chaotic sandbox world full of opportunities and dangers. You can explore surrounding villages, abandoned strongholds and trade route checkpoints, or encounter wandering bandits and refugees. Different locations trigger random events, ranging from unexpected treasures to deadly traps. Every exploration is an unknown adventure.

Beyond open governance and warfare, you can uncover hidden secrets with the underground treasure-hunting system. Form expedition teams to delve into ancient tombs, abandoned mines and hidden underground palaces, searching for lost armaments, precious ancient books and treasures capable of turning the tide of war. Yet the underground holds more than wealth: mechanisms, traps and guardian spirits will pose deadly challenges on your treasure hunt.

In this challenging era, every decision you make matters greatly. Will you become a benevolent and upright magistrate who cares for the people, or a ruthless overlord of chaotic times? Will you navigate among factions to survive, or gather strength to seize the realm in due time? Your legend will be written by your own hands.
store_data.detailed_description:
Late Ming: Magistrate Simulation & Management is an immersive county reconstruction simulation game set against the chaotic background of the late Ming Dynasty. You will play as a county magistrate appointed in times of crisis, taking charge of a border county in ruins. Faced with famine, banditry, harsh governance and displaced people, you must make choices amid numerous crises, lead this small town to rise again from the ruins, and seek a glimmer of survival in this turbulent era.

 

As the local governor, your primary duty is to govern people’s livelihood. The civilian system in the game shows the real lives of ordinary people in troubled times. You need to pay attention to public sentiment, assign corvée labor, adjust grain prices and comfort displaced refugees. Every policy you issue will directly affect public support. Unstable public sentiment will make people flee; with popular support, civilians will voluntarily repair city walls, cultivate farmlands, and even stand up to defend the county in times of danger.

In troubled times, intelligence is the key to survival. The game’s unique spy system acts as your eyes and ears, allowing you to perceive everything around you. You can send spies to infiltrate enemy camps, penetrate local noble clans, or investigate the movements of surrounding forces. The intelligence they bring back will serve as a vital basis for you to formulate strategies and resolve crises. Yet be cautious: spies may meet misfortune or be instigated by enemies, delivering deadly false information.

When bandits invade, public support and wisdom alone cannot safeguard your land. You need to establish and develop your military system. From recruiting local warriors and training militias to forging weapons and building city defenses, every step requires careful planning. You can deploy troops personally and command city defense battles to fend off invaders, or adopt conciliatory policies to reach agreements with neighboring forces. The choice between war and peace will profoundly shape the fate of your county.

Talent is the most precious resource in chaotic times. Through the recruitment system, you can discover various talents among refugees, local warriors and impoverished scholars. Some excel at farming and greatly boost crop yields; others master martial arts and become core military forces; a few are well-versed in strategies and offer valuable counsel. Reasonable talent allocation will strongly support your county governance and foreign defense.

To sustain all these undertakings, you must build your county from scratch. The construction system lets you plan urban layouts, gradually transforming ruins into an impregnable border stronghold with government offices, granaries, barracks and workshops. The warehouse system is your lifeline: manage grain, wood, ore, armaments and other supplies properly, balance income and expenditure, and withstand the dual trials of famine and warfare. When resources run short, you can trade with other towns to exchange limited goods for survival.

The game’s map system presents a chaotic sandbox world full of opportunities and dangers. You can explore surrounding villages, abandoned strongholds and trade route checkpoints, or encounter wandering bandits and refugees. Different locations trigger random events, ranging from unexpected treasures to deadly traps. Every exploration is an unknown adventure.

Beyond open governance and warfare, you can uncover hidden secrets with the underground treasure-hunting system. Form expedition teams to delve into ancient tombs, abandoned mines and hidden underground palaces, searching for lost armaments, precious ancient books and treasures capable of turning the tide of war. Yet the underground holds more than wealth: mechanisms, traps and guardian spirits will pose deadly challenges on your treasure hunt.

In this challenging era, every decision you make matters greatly. Will you become a benevolent and upright magistrate who cares for the people, or a ruthless overlord of chaotic times? Will you navigate among factions to survive, or gather strength to seize the realm in due time? Your legend will be written by your own hands.

Rule as a magistrate, rebuild your border town, raise troops, gather intelligence, explore underground treasures, and expand your power across overseas islands amid endless chaos.

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into a fantasy metropolis where humans and beastfolk coexist. Beneath its prosperous surface lie hidden secrets and swirling dark undercurrents.

Play as a destitute, unemployed journalist at rock bottom. An enigmatic hyena extends a mysterious investigation offer, drawing you into the city’s shadowy underbelly. Embark on a journey of inquiry, wander through urban streets, encounter all kinds of people, and unearth the truth behind bizarre, unsolved incidents.

The game features hardcore binary-choice storytelling. Every pivotal decision carries no absolute right or wrong, directly shaping four core attributes. Maintain careful balance at all costs—any attribute collapse will terminate your investigation and trigger a tragic ending.

Gather fragmented clues, experience peculiar urban tales, and interact with distinctive characters. As scattered cases intertwine, layers of fog lift to expose a grand conspiracy, with a hidden mastermind controlling the city’s fate.

Game Features

  • Original Fantasy World

    A vivid 2D atmospheric cityscape where humans and beastfolk cohabit, blending daily mortal life with dark underhanded schemes.

  • Binary Choice Gameplay

    Every choice affects your fate and plot progression, unlocking rich story branches and diverse outcomes.

  • Immersive Suspense Narrative

    Journalist-led detective experience with fragmented, progressive storytelling, keeping suspense high all the way.

  • Multiple Endings

    Your decisions write the finale. Uncover the truth and escape, or sink deep into the conspiracy—every path is your own to make.

Welcome to Café Connect

Here, you run your own internet café starting from scratch!

To begin with, repair, clean, or upgrade customers’ computers to earn the cash you need for your first shop.

Once you own your first shop, it’s time to build your first computer.

Get all the necessary components (CPU, motherboard, RAM, GPU, etc.) and build your very first PC.

Then install the software, and your first customer’s computer is ready!

Now just buy a modem, set up an internet connection, and you’re all set to go.

But be careful! Various events require your attention!

Viruses, fires, thieves, and other events are just the tip of the iceberg.

Keep expanding your inventory and your café to become a successful internet café operator.

Additionally, you can expand your business by selling your own computers, so that your old computers which are being replaced by newer ones might still bring in some money.

🚀 SPACE FETUS CLICKER


An absurd, fast-paced idle clicker where you capture... well, space fetuses.

Click, upgrade, automate, and push your numbers beyond reason. What starts simple quickly turns into a chaotic, exponential grind for power.

🪐 WHAT IS THIS GAME?


Space Fetuses are drifting through the cosmos.
Your mission is to pull them onto your planet and convert them into pure profit.

Click → deal damage → earn gold → upgrade → repeat.
Then automate everything and break the game.

⚔️ CORE GAMEPLAY


    []Click to deal damage to enemies[]Defeat waves and earn gold[]Fight bosses every 5 levels (30-second time limit)[]Progress endlessly with increasing difficulty
  • Experience exponential scaling of damage and income

🤖 AUTOMATION & UPGRADES


    []11 tiers of automated units (from Space Drone to Quantum Decimator)[]Idle damage grows alongside your empire[]Upgrade your click power and automation efficiency[]Unlock new layers of progression as you advance

⚡ ACTIVE ABILITIES


Powerful boosts available every 10 minutes:

    []⚡ Rapid Fire — 10x more clicks[]🎯 Critical Strike — chance for massive crits[]🤖 Machine Click — clicks scale with idle damage[]💎 Enrich Loot — 2x gold
  • 🔥 Overload — 2x all damage

Each lasts 30 seconds. Timing matters.

🧬 COSMIC DNA (META PROGRESSION)


    []Reset your progress using Time Warp[]Gain permanent bonuses[]6 types of upgrades affecting damage, gold, and more[]Chance to double your Cosmic DNA gains

This is where real optimization begins.

🎲 RANDOM EVENTS


Every ~30 seconds, special objects appear:

    []💰 Basic Gold — quick cash boost[]💎 Great Gold — massive reward (boss-level)
  • 🧬 Cosmic DNA — instant meta progression

Click them before they disappear.

🌟 PASSIVE BONUSES


    []Unlock passives every 25 upgrade levels[]Boost click damage (2x–2.5x)
  • Global multipliers affecting all damage (1.1x–1.5x)

⏱️ IDLE & OFFLINE PROGRESS


    []Auto-save every 30 seconds[]Earn gold while offline (up to 24 hours)
  • Come back and claim your rewards

🛠️ FUTURE UPDATES


Space Fetus Clicker is planned to receive 3–4 major content updates after release, adding new gameplay systems, progression layers, and more chaotic content.

    []All major updates will be completely free for existing owners[]The game price may increase slightly with each major update
  • Early players get the best deal and all future content included

📈 ENDLESS PROGRESSION


There is no cap.
There is no ending.
Only bigger numbers.

🧠 WHO IS THIS FOR?


    []Fans of idle and incremental games[]Players who enjoy optimization and scaling systems
  • Anyone who appreciates absurd humor

If you like watching numbers explode, this is for you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Shunned and feared for her mysterious past, Averi has spent her life hiding from realms that have never truly accepted her, but when a violent explosion shakes her awake in her hideout, it becomes clear that disaster has struck at The Heart, the towering castle that watches over the entire kingdom. With chaos spreading across the small planet, her best friend Iris urges her to investigate while she races back from training. Reluctant, Averi sets out anyway unaware that the fate of the world is about to fall into her hands.

Battle your way through a vibrant and dangerous world in this action-packed 2D pixel-art platformer inspired by classic retro adventures! Run, jump, dash, punch, and fight your way across 14 handcrafted stages filled with deadly hazards, challenging enemies, and hidden secrets. Take on ruthless bandits, corrupt soldiers, monstrous creatures, and colossal bosses as you uncover the truth behind the uprising threatening the planet.

Face off against 8 powerful bosses, master tough but satisfying platforming challenges, and reclaim the throne from the tyrannical duo Lord Kroff and Lady Psonos before they plunge the kingdom into ruin forever.

Featuring fluid combat, memorable characters, animated cutscenes, retro-inspired pixel art, and challenging gameplay designed for both platforming veterans and newcomers alike, Averi’s journey is a classic adventure filled with danger, mystery, and heart.

About This Game

Crown & Applause is a rhythm game with a narrative story about a jester forced to perform for a kingdom that wants laughter without trouble. Perform across a series of escalating stages, win over changing crowds, and navigate a tale where every act carries more weight than the last. What begins as simple entertainment soon grows into something far harder for a king to keep on script.

A jester in service to their king

Step into the bells of a wandering performer sent around the kingdom to lift spirits, please the king’s court, and keep unrest at bay. With every stage and every crowd, the jester’s performance grows into something harder for the kingdom to keep on script.

Perform across the kingdom

Perform through rhythm-based stages where timing, flow, and control matter. As the jester moves from village squares to royal halls, each new venue raises the pressure and asks more of every performance.

Choose what your performance stands for

Each new stage brings more than applause. As the jester’s role grows, the player must navigate rising pressure and decide whether their act serves the king, the people, or something more personal.

Features

  • Fun & challenging rhythm gameplay

  • A theatrical story told through performances and VN-style scenes

  • Distinct stages shaped by shifting audiences and rising pressure

  • A kingdom of control, spectacle, and expression

  • Multiple endings shaped by who your act ultimately serves

store_data.about_the_game:
Dies Irae tactical puzzle is a 2D strategy, puzzle, and roguelite game built around a tactical board where every move matters.

Move pieces, force manual matches, trigger automatic chain reactions, and evolve your pieces through merges. But every action also strengthens the enemy: after your moves, new enemy pieces appear on the board, putting pressure on your space and your decisions.

Advance through islands and biomes with unique rules, resources, and abilities. Unlock mercenary contracts, factories, rerolls, reputation, credits, and powers that let you manipulate the match hierarchy and change the course of the game.

When the board is full and there are no possible moves left, you must reset that board and try a better strategy.

Key Features:

2D grid-based tactical puzzle

store_data.about_the_game:
ROCKS.EXE is an idle market machine.

ROCKS.EXE is a dark terminal-style idle market simulator about minting resources, entering exposure, surviving market events, and collecting Steam inventory items through timed drops and case systems.

You are not buying and selling in a normal market. You are operating a machine.

Core Loop

  • Mint Bedrock and Ember over time.

  • Convert resources into Krypto.

  • Enter exposure on rock markets.

  • Wait for global events.

  • Resolve positions automatically.

  • Receive Krypto outcomes and possible case opportunities.

Timed Steam Inventory Drops

Eligible players may receive Steam inventory item drops through the timed drop system. The standard drop interval is 3 hours of eligible play.

Timed drops are separate from case openings. They do not require a case or key. When a timed drop is granted, it rolls from a selected Steam inventory item pool with fixed rarity odds.

  • COMMON: 78.0%

  • UNCOMMON: 18.0%

  • EPIC: 3.5%

  • LEGENDARY: 0.5%

Timed drop items may be marketable and tradable through the Steam Community Market.

Cases and Keys

Cases are generated through gameplay, usually from attended exposure resolutions. Different rock families can generate different case families.

Rocks do not directly drop premium rewards. Rocks create opportunities for cases.

Cases are Steam inventory items. They can be kept, collected, traded, sold where marketable, or opened with a key.

Opening a case requires a key. Keys are separate Steam inventory items and are consumed when a case is opened. A case opening consumes one eligible case and one eligible key, then rolls one item from that case's reward pool.

Fixed Odds. No Hidden Modifiers.

Case rewards are family-based. Each case contains its own authored item pool, usually including common, uncommon, epic, and legendary variants from the same visual family.

Case openings use fixed authored odds per case. Odds are not affected by spending, playtime, account age, streaks, losses, or previous results.

  • No pity systems.

  • No fragments.

  • No hidden odds modifiers.

  • No alternate currency that bypasses keys.

Two Steam Item Paths

  • Timed Drops: Eligible players can receive a direct Steam inventory item drop at the timed interval.

  • Cases and Keys: Gameplay can generate cases. Cases require keys to open and roll from their own item pools.

The Endgame: The Rig and the Skill Tree

Late-game ROCKS.EXE is not about more exposure. It is about compounding.

When you terminate a meme rock through LARGE-tier exposure, you produce a Core. Cores socket into your Rig — a private mining machine. Socketed cores generate Bedrock and Ember passively, on a per-core rate, even while the game is closed.

  • Cores recovered from terminated LARGE-tier meme rocks

  • Multiple core sockets per Rig

  • Passive Bedrock and Ember generation while offline

  • Late-game rigs fund their own next exposures

The Skill Tree runs parallel to the Rig. Progression nodes affect:

  • Mint speed and parallel mint slots

  • Offline mint queueing capacity

  • Per-event resolution windows

  • Rig multipliers and additional core slots

  • Cosmetic terminal themes and console variants

The Skill Tree never affects drop odds, case contents, or item rarity. Those are fixed.

The Tree affects the machine. The market remains untouchable.

The Long Game

Higher rate → more Krypto → more exposure → more rocks terminated → more cores → faster Rig → more Krypto.

The loop closes on itself. ROCKS.EXE rewards investment of time and Krypto. It is the long game.

Features

  • Terminal-style minting interface

  • Bedrock and Ember resource generation

  • Krypto conversion system

  • Event-driven exposure markets

  • Stable, meme, and special rock categories

  • Global market, volatility, and special events

  • Active and historical holdings

  • Rock archive and prestige progression

  • Family-based Steam inventory cases

  • Case opening with key consumption

  • Fixed timed drop rarity odds

  • Steam inventory item drops every 3 hours of eligible play

  • Marketable and tradable item support where enabled by Steam

  • The Rig — endgame compounding via core mining

  • Cores extracted from terminated LARGE-tier meme rocks

  • Passive Bedrock and Ember generation, online or offline

  • The Skill Tree — progression nodes for mint, queue, rig, and cosmetics

  • No pay-to-win — Skill Tree never affects drop odds or case contents

Watch the Terminal

Read the market. Enter exposure. Wait for the event. Resolve the position.

ROCKS.EXE is about waiting, pressure, and the moment the terminal resolves.

store_data.about_the_game:
Chrongrid is an AI-driven narrative orchestration engine. Inside the stories it builds, you are not reading a pre-written plot, nor are you picking options from a menu of buttons — you enter the story the way you want to, the world responds according to its own logic, and events grow from there, one step at a time.

What you can do: enter a preset story world, make your own choices, and let the world fill itself in dynamically as it unfolds. No journey ever repeats — not because the branches multiplied, but because the story is no longer a script written in advance. You may even arrive at endings the author never anticipated.

Chrongrid is a one-time purchase that runs entirely on your machine. It needs you to connect an LLM (you choose which one) to work — meaning your story content flows only between you and the LLM provider you trust. Nothing is sent to us.

What's Inside: Five Stories in the Demo


The Demo contains five complete stories, playable before launch. These five fully independent stories — different in genre, pace, and play — take you from gentle to deep, showing different facets of what Chrongrid can do.

  • The Cat Hunt — An early-summer afternoon in a Beijing hutong. You are A-Chen, a fourteen-year-old boy. Grandma Zhang's orange cat has gone missing. A warm starter story, and the most fundamental narrative loop in Chrongrid.
  • My Week — You are a 23-year-old freelance illustrator. This week you have a commercial commission to finish and a market-day product to prepare. Every block of time is a choice; every choice has a cost. You decide how these seven days are spent.
  • Goodnight, Tomorrow — The last night in a small port town. A case already closed, an old journalist friend, drinks and stories — both within reach. What kind of night this turns out to be is up to you.
  • The Vortex Core — A ten-kilometer-wide vortex appears in the western Pacific; a tsunami swallows the entirety of Japan. You are the chief scientist aboard the research vessel Qiming — the human being closest to the truth.
  • The Night Tide Aquarium — You are the night security guard at an old aquarium. Tonight, for eight hours, you are alone with this place. The manager has handed you a list of eight rules and said: "Follow them, and you'll make it to morning."

These five stories are a snapshot of what Chrongrid can do today. We are still polishing — by launch, we will bring richer, deeper stories with more replay value.

How to Play Chrongrid


About connecting an LLM

Chrongrid does not bundle an LLM. After first launch, you'll need to connect a working LLM in the Launcher before reaching the main interface — this is a product design choice, not a temporary limitation we plan to relax.

We support any service compatible with the OpenAI or Anthropic protocols, as well as Ollama running locally. How you connect to an LLM service is entirely up to you. Note: although Chrongrid itself is a one-time purchase, using an LLM may incur ongoing costs — a hidden expense no AI-driven product can ignore. And at least for now, LLM usage is not cheap. Please budget accordingly.

About your API key

The Demo does not save your API key — you'll re-enter it each time you launch.

The full release will offer persistent storage, but please only enable it on a home environment you trust — opening Chrongrid in a public space with persistence on may leak your API key and produce unexpected charges from your LLM provider. Keep your API key safe.

About presentation

Chrongrid offers two window modes, switchable at any time:

  • Dual-window mode — the Launcher and Container windows run independently. You enter your actions in the Launcher, while the narrative unfolds in the Container. Strong sense of immersion. Dual-window mode is the recommended default.
  • Single-window mode — only the Launcher runs. Your input and the narrative both appear inside the Launcher window. This is the traditional, classic approach.

About languages

On first launch you'll enter the Beilin — dozens of language stones laid out in sequence, from which you pick the one you want to play in. The multilingual capability during play is provided by the LLM you connect to.

About current limitations

Three things we want to say before you open the Demo:

  • Multilingual experience is not yet stable — Chrongrid supports dozens of languages by architecture, but LLMs vary widely in their linguistic ability. Chinese and English are currently the most reliable; other languages depend on the model you choose. If, at the start of a story, the displayed language doesn't match the one you selected, we strongly recommend opening a new story and trying again.
  • AI replies take time — a single narrative turn typically takes several seconds to tens of seconds, depending on the model and your network. Chrongrid does not pre-generate content; the wait is the price of real-time AI thinking. We will keep optimizing — but it will not disappear.
  • Occasional parsing failures — when an LLM returns malformed content, Chrongrid may not parse it correctly, and the scene can stall. This usually does not block you from continuing. If it happens repeatedly, try switching to a different model.

These are honest realities of AI-driven products today. We won't hide them — we'll keep pushing them down, one at a time, as models and the orchestration layer improve.

Boundaries of Generated Content


The story content in Chrongrid is generated in real time by the LLM you connect to. At the product-prompt layer, we actively avoid content that violates Steam's policies, and we'll keep refining this as rules and models change.

But the final output is decided by the LLM — its training, its version differences, and the way players guide it during play can all push it to produce content beyond what we anticipate. Please choose a compliant LLM provider, follow that provider's terms of use, and keep your inputs within reasonable bounds — this is also the foundation for a good play experience.

Chrongrid is an AI-driven narrative orchestration engine

Chrongrid is not a chatbot, not a visual novel, and not a menu of branching choices. It is a machine that runs stories — separating a narrative's skeleton from its flesh, each playing its own role.

The author writes the blueprint — defining the world, the characters, the destinies.
The Chrongrid engine sets the blueprint in motion — orchestrating cause and effect, holding the story's inner order.
You step into the world, make your own choices, and watch events unfold one step at a time.

Here, you don't need to anticipate every possible script, nor do you need to play a role someone else has written. You do what you want to do — and the world responds in its own way.

This is a new narrative medium — one whose boundaries we are still defining together.


Why Early Access?

Chrongrid will not have a traditional "1.0 final release."

This is not a product that calls itself EA because it isn't done — it is something that, by its nature, has no finish line. Narrative orchestration is a frontier still being explored: every new AI model, every new blueprint, every new way of playing redraws its boundaries. Calling it "finished" would be the dishonest thing to do.

We are a small independent studio building something far larger than our size. So we choose to slow the pace, tighten the promises, and walk every step honestly.

During Early Access, we commit to:

  • Steady updates — new blueprints, new mechanics, ongoing refinement of the engine;
  • Phased disclosure of the design process — important design decisions will be shared publicly as development unfolds;
  • Co-shaping with players — your feedback, your experiences, the blueprints you create — all become part of how this product evolves.

You are not buying a finished product. You are joining an exploration still in motion — about how far AI and narrative can go together.


About AI: We Sell Shovels

AI today is already capable of writing long, coherent prose, but it is still some distance away from true narrative. Compared to the great human storytellers, AI is far from perfect — it needs to be understood, guided, and placed inside an ordered system before it can tell a story worth telling.

We've chosen to grow alongside AI:

  • The stronger the AI, the more alive the story — but the more powerful the AI, the more it needs a stable system to harness it;
  • One-time purchase, runs entirely on your machine — you choose which LLM to use; your plot, your characters, your dialogue flow only between your computer and the LLM provider you trust. Nothing is sent to us;
  • A commitment to compliance — on top of whatever safeguards your online LLM provider offers, Chrongrid also actively avoids content that violates Steam's policies at the product-prompt layer, and will keep improving as rules and models evolve.

We sell shovels — well-made, trustworthy ones. How deep the gold runs depends partly on the tool, partly on the AI, and partly on you.

  • Narrative orchestration handles more complex scenes — combat, negotiation, ensemble scheduling — content that today can only be rendered roughly will gain finer orchestration over time. The ways you interact with the world will also grow deeper and more natural;
  • Our blueprints — visible to you, editable by you — Chrongrid's built-in blueprint texts will be made public alongside the product, and we'll open Steam Workshop as soon as we can. You can start by imitating, modifying, until you write a story of your own. We'll keep refining the blueprint authoring rules, returning the power of creation to the authors themselves.

store_data.about_the_game:
Portucale: Sword and Subtlety

In the brutal dawn of a new kingdom, honor is a luxury and survival is a calculation. Portucale: Sword and Subtlety is a strategic card-battler that strips away the fluff of traditional CCGs to focus on the raw mechanics of power: building prestige, fortifying borders, and the cold-blooded art of sabotage.

Gamers will care about Portucale because it transforms the "defense" phase from a passive wait into a high-stakes economic engine. In this game, your walls don't just stop arrows; they generate the gold required to fund your next conquest. But the true hook lies in the "Cheat" mechanic—a system that weaponizes treachery, allowing players to directly erode an opponent’s hard-earned attributes.

It is a game of "asymmetric friction" where you aren't just playing your cards; you are actively dismantling your rival's legacy. Whether you rule through the absolute authority of the King or the quiet lethality of a well-timed betrayal, Portucale offers a tense, psychological duel where the greatest threat isn't the army at your gates, but the subtlety of the hand you didn't see coming.

A cozy 3D spot-the-difference game set in a nostalgic ’90s office.

Cozy Finds is a take on the classic “spot-the-difference” game inside a single, detailed office frozen in time. Look for multiple differences in each room using the split-screen. Rotate, zoom, and explore the office from every angle as you uncover subtle changes hidden in plain sight.

Key Features

Spot the Difference in 3D
Freely rotate and zoom around different rooms. Check every desk, corner, and cubicle—details matter.

One Space, Endless Details
Instead of separate levels, explore all of the rooms one-by-one in one continuous office.

Relaxing, No-Pressure Gameplay
No timers. No way to lose. Just you, the space, and your attention to detail.

Cozy Vibes & Lofi Music
Perfect for unwinding—like staying at the office with nothing but humming of the screens and a good playlist.

Slow Down and Look Closer

Some changes are obvious. Others are almost impossible to notice.
Take your time, trust your eyes, and enjoy the process of finding what is different.

store_data.about_the_game:
MAGOSTOP is a roguelike deckbuilding game inspired by Go-Stop, a Korean card game derived from Koi-Koi. Create your cards, combine Benefits, and shout "GO" to multiply your score. But be warned: the moment greed takes over, the board can flip in an instant. Don't miss your chance to STOP.

Endless Choices

Craft valid cards, complete Sun, Moon, and Ribbon sets, and combine Benefits with special cards to create powerful synergies. Simply raising your base score won't be enough. In MAGOSTOP, cards are more than just scoring material. Some count as two, while others hint at an upcoming explosion. Remove, copy, change suits, and refine your deck. A single small change can completely alter the outcome of your next GO.

  • A roguelike deckbuilding card battler inspired by Korean-style card games.

  • Build hands using Sun, Moon, and Ribbon sets with modified playing cards.

  • Ever-changing combinations of Benefits, special cards, and card processing in every run.

  • Various special card types: Silver-foiled, Gold-foiled, Ash, Ice, Tick-Tock, and more.

Shake the Board

The board in MAGOSTOP never stays quiet. Gain unexpected opportunities with a Kiss, and blow up the board all at once with a Bomb. Cards that belonged to your opponent a moment ago can become your score, and cards you thought were safe might be snatched away in the next turn. It is not just about playing good cards. It is about deciding which cards to keep, which to shake, and when to steal from your opponent.

  • Special mechanics like Kiss, Ppuck, and Bombs that shift the flow of the game.

  • A tense tug-of-war where you steal cards back and forth.

Can You Go One More Time?

In MAGOSTOP, having good cards is just the beginning. The real massive scores start with a GO. The key is deciding how far you can push. You can play it safe, STOP, and prepare for the next round. Or you can shout GO one more time to explode your score—but the next card might ruin everything.

Will you stop?

Or will you go once more?

Test your luck and skill.

  • A risk-taking scoring system centered around GO and STOP.

  • The intense tension between choosing safety or chasing a higher score.

store_data.about_the_game:
Play as Maya, a beta tester trapped inside a broken VR simulation. Manifest items to navigate hidden digital layers, purge anomalies, and escape the terrifying Warden. Manage battery life and corruption, search your virtual desktop for clues, uncover the secret truth, and shatter the endless L00P!

Slip on the revolutionary NEW REALITY headset and dive into the mesmerizing purple void, where your wildest dreams take shape! But there's more than meets the eye. Beneath the surface lies a secret layer of the world waiting to be uncovered. Developers unlock the exclusive L.R.S headset in-game to reveal hidden assets and step boldly into uncharted realms!

Manifest your way forward! In NEW REALITY, anything you can think of can be manifested. A pathway to access an area, a fresh new lawn, a campfire, hopes, and dreams! With each area of the game giving you new things to manifest that fit the area's theme. You name it, you can manifest it in NEW REALITY.

Scattered across the map are mysterious foreign assets that must be destroyed to stabilize the game. You traverse corrupted landscapes to reach them. If you stay too long, you can corrupt yourself completely! As well as keeping an eye on your headset's battery life so you don't plummet into the endless void! Also, beware—The Warden prowls relentlessly, hunting for its next prey. Your corruption—or health—persists throughout the entire game. Every move counts, so tread carefully and strategize wisely!

This L00P is unlike any before it—now, you can interact with lifelike NPCs! These cutting-edge AIs are so convincing, you might start to believe they’re real humans trapped in the game. Plus, uncover the secrets of Purple Void Inc. by collecting hidden emails through each level, revealing fascinating backstories and the lives of its employees, and also receiving them when going back to the desktop!

Maya’s ultimate mission is to shatter the endless L00P that binds her. By updating the game, obliterating anomalies, and gathering elusive data fragments, you’ll edge closer to the power needed to face The Warden. Only then can you seize your chance to defeat it and finally BREAK FREE!

store_data.about_the_game:
Echoes of Creation: Origin is a single-player 3D open-world action RPG with deep stat-driven progression and grindy, satisfying combat. Hunt monsters across seven hand-painted zones, master one of four classes, and free the sealed goddess Light from the dark guardian who imprisoned her.

Story

The Creator forged two mythical beings — Light and Dark. When Light saved the world she was weakened, and Dark sealed her away. You are a chosen Adventurer drawn to her aid. The story sends you across the realm to defeat The Forgotten One, the boss guardian holding her chains. Free her, and the world begins to heal.

Classes & Progression

  • Start as an Adventurer and choose your path at Level 10: Swordsman, Assassin, Ranger, or Cleric — each with unique skills, weapons, and play styles.

  • Level cap 30 for the MVP campaign, with a progressive EXP curve designed for grindy long-session play.

  • 2 stat points to allocate every level across STR / DEX / INT / END / VIT / SPR.

  • Skill books in Normal / Rare / Epic / Legend tiers expand your toolkit as you progress.

  • Talent tree with branching specializations unlocks alongside your class.

Combat & Auto-Hunt

  • Real-time action combat with weapon swings, ranged attacks, and casted spells.

  • Auto-Combat with two modes — Hunt (chase monsters within radius) and Guard (stationary defense). Customize target priority, skill rotation, auto-potion thresholds, and self-buff schedule.

  • Status effects (stun, poison, bleed, slow), critical strikes, dodge rolls, and weighted damage formulas.

  • No death penalty — respawn at the village with 30% HP.

The World

Seven distinct hand-painted zones connected by unlockable fast-travel waypoints:

  • Eloria Village — your hub for shopping, NPCs, quests, and the Bank.

  • Forest Path → Dark Woods → Goblin Hills → Cursed Caverns → Ancient Ruins → Creator's Gate — escalating difficulty through a richly themed world toward the final boss.

  • Mini-bosses punctuate each zone with unique mechanics and signature drops.

  • Elite monsters — towering 5x-scale variants of normal enemies that broadcast their arrival in chat and drop rare loot.

Gear & Customization

  • 14 equipment slots: weapons, armor, accessories, capes, wings.

  • Equipment upgrade system (+1 to +10) with success/failure rates and Scrolls of Protection.

  • Typed gem sockets — normal/rare gear gets one socket, epic/legendary gets a higher-tier socket too.

  • Monster Essences — ultra-rare 1/10,000 drops from signature monsters, soulbound on socket, opening new build axes (crit rate, lifesteal, gold find, move speed, and more).

  • Gear sets with multi-piece bonuses across leather, chain, plate, and forgotten tiers.

  • Customizable character with modular hair, eye, and costume slots (anime-styled cel-shaded look).

Quests & Activities

  • 6 main story quests following the path to The Forgotten One.

  • 12 side quests spread across all zones (kill, collect, deliver).

  • Daily quests with rotating objectives + a daily login streak that grants Eloria's Favor.

  • Achievements tied to combat milestones, exploration, and rare drops.

  • Monsterpedia unlocks monster info, stats, and drop tables as you kill more of each species.

  • Gear and monster collections with permanent stat bonuses for completing sets.

Other Features

  • Weight-based inventory (your VIT stat determines max carry weight).

  • Dual currency: Gold (50% drop) and Diamonds (1% drop) for premium upgrades.

  • Auto-loot charm for hands-free farming sessions.

  • Cloud saves via Steam.

  • Marketplace to trade rare drops with other adventurers.

  • PvP arena for competitive play between sessions.

  • Eloria's Favor — a daily blessing resource that triples your gains during favored hunts.

Playtime

  • ~25-40 hours to clear the main story and reach the level cap.

  • Open-ended grind, gear hunting, talent specialization, and rare-drop farming extend playtime well beyond.

What Makes It Unique

  • A love letter to grindy stat-driven progression in a modern 3D anime open world.

  • Auto-combat designed for both active and idle play styles — set up your character and let them farm, or take direct control for boss fights and PvP.

  • 1-in-10,000 essence drops give every monster pull a "lucky" lottery feel.

  • No death penalty, no pay-to-win — the game respects your time.
