  • Level cap 30 for the MVP campaign, with a progressive EXP curve designed for grindy long-session play.

  • 2 stat points to allocate every level across STR / DEX / INT / END / VIT / SPR.

  • Skill books in Normal / Rare / Epic / Legend tiers expand your toolkit as you progress.

  • Talent tree with branching specializations unlocks alongside your class.

Combat & Auto-Hunt

  • Real-time action combat with weapon swings, ranged attacks, and casted spells.

  • Auto-Combat with two modes — Hunt (chase monsters within radius) and Guard (stationary defense). Customize target priority, skill rotation, auto-potion thresholds, and self-buff schedule.

  • Status effects (stun, poison, bleed, slow), critical strikes, dodge rolls, and weighted damage formulas.

  • No death penalty — respawn at the village with 30% HP.

The World

Seven distinct hand-painted zones connected by unlockable fast-travel waypoints:

  • Eloria Village — your hub for shopping, NPCs, quests, and the Bank.

  • Forest Path → Dark Woods → Goblin Hills → Cursed Caverns → Ancient Ruins → Creator's Gate — escalating difficulty through a richly themed world toward the final boss.

  • Mini-bosses punctuate each zone with unique mechanics and signature drops.

  • Elite monsters — towering 5x-scale variants of normal enemies that broadcast their arrival in chat and drop rare loot.

Gear & Customization

  • 14 equipment slots: weapons, armor, accessories, capes, wings.

  • Equipment upgrade system (+1 to +10) with success/failure rates and Scrolls of Protection.

  • Typed gem sockets — normal/rare gear gets one socket, epic/legendary gets a higher-tier socket too.

  • Monster Essences — ultra-rare 1/10,000 drops from signature monsters, soulbound on socket, opening new build axes (crit rate, lifesteal, gold find, move speed, and more).

  • Gear sets with multi-piece bonuses across leather, chain, plate, and forgotten tiers.

  • Customizable character with modular hair, eye, and costume slots (anime-styled cel-shaded look).

Quests & Activities

  • 6 main story quests following the path to The Forgotten One.

  • 12 side quests spread across all zones (kill, collect, deliver).

  • Daily quests with rotating objectives + a daily login streak that grants Eloria's Favor.

  • Achievements tied to combat milestones, exploration, and rare drops.

  • Monsterpedia unlocks monster info, stats, and drop tables as you kill more of each species.

  • Gear and monster collections with permanent stat bonuses for completing sets.

Other Features

  • Weight-based inventory (your VIT stat determines max carry weight).

  • Dual currency: Gold (50% drop) and Diamonds (1% drop) for premium upgrades.

  • Auto-loot charm for hands-free farming sessions.

  • Cloud saves via Steam.

  • Marketplace to trade rare drops with other adventurers.

  • PvP arena for competitive play between sessions.

  • Eloria's Favor — a daily blessing resource that triples your gains during favored hunts.

Playtime

  • ~25-40 hours to clear the main story and reach the level cap.

  • Open-ended grind, gear hunting, talent specialization, and rare-drop farming extend playtime well beyond.

What Makes It Unique

  • A love letter to grindy stat-driven progression in a modern 3D anime open world.

  • Auto-combat designed for both active and idle play styles — set up your character and let them farm, or take direct control for boss fights and PvP.

  • 1-in-10,000 essence drops give every monster pull a "lucky" lottery feel.

  • No death penalty, no pay-to-win — the game respects your time.

store_data.about_the_game:
******   Tap the ball, swish, automate and numbers go up!   ******

The ultimate low-stress, pixel-perfect journey from being rookie to a BASKETBALL ALL-STAR.

In Swish Ball Clicker, ball isn’t just life—it’s an investment. Dive into a charming, stylized world where every click translates to a satisfying sound of swish.

You will love the sound of every score.

Whether you’re looking to actively click for that perfect shooting combo or want to sit back and watch your "guys" do the heavy lifting, this is the relaxing indie experience for the casual baller in everyone.

Key Features

  • Satisfying Pixel Action: Enjoy a "cute and cartoonish" aesthetic with crisp 2D pixel graphics that make every basket feel rewarding.

  • Hiring your "guys" is King: Why sweat when you can automate? Unlock upgrades that shoot for you, allowing you to stack up "net worth" even while you’re away.

  • The "Grumpy" Side of Hoops: You have a weird coach to hire. He collects skill stars for you to use in skill trees.

  • Zero Stress, All Progress: A truly relaxing simulation designed to be played at your own pace. No defenders—just you and the rim.

  • Perfect for keeping open on the side: Your progress can be transferred any computer, so you don't have to start over.

  • Unlock cash generators and earn more prestige: You went from being rookie to an ALL-STAR, and now time to invest your earnings into cash generators.

  • Different ball types: 7 different ball types and other things to explore.

  • Talent cards and skill trees: Talent cards and skill tress for providing game depth and cool effects.

  • Global leaderboards, achievements and statistics: See who is the most prestigious basketball player in a leaderboard, compete with others or unlock achievements at your own pace.

Why You'll Love It

"It takes the complex stats of a basketball simulation and strips them down into a pure, addictive, and adorable idler. It’s the perfect game to keep open in the background while you work, or to dive into for a quick session of point-and-click glory."

1 V 1

There is no end of game monsters, but work on your skill tree if you want to beat 1v1 games. ...or else you get cooked.




Ready to start your journey? Just click. Swish. Automate. Repeat.

......and WISHLIST

Contact: ugur.yilmaz@broadstreetanalytics.com

store_data.about_the_game:
CO-OP STEALTH ACTION WITH DUMB ASSASSINS

Step into a parodic world where high-profile assassination contracts meet absolute chaos. Team up with your friends to infiltrate heavily guarded facilities and eliminate your targets. The stakes are high, the security is pretty tight, and you… well, you’re trying your best.

ELIMINATE “THE ELITE”

You’ve definitely seen these guys before, whether on the news or in memes with their iconic haircuts. Now, they are your VIP targets! Navigate their luxurious lairs, bypass ridiculous security measures, and strike when they least expect a clumsy ambush.

HIDE THE BODIES

Eliminating the target is only half the job. Grab a buddy to haul floppy ragdoll bodies and awkwardly stuff them into the nearest dumpster. Leave no trace before the guards start asking questions!

A THOUSAND WAYS TO FLOP

Sneaking in is hard when your squad is this clumsy. There are tons of cameras to get caught by, X-ray scanners everywhere... Hell, even the target’s bodyguards aren’t messing around!

THIS IS A FLAWLESS DISGUISE, SURELY

Need to access a restricted VIP area? Just borrow a uniform from a suspiciously unconscious guard. Slip into their clothes right at the crime scene and pretend you actually belong there.

store_data.about_the_game:
Background

On a midnight in your thirties, you wake up surrounded by Lesser Demons closing in for the kill.

Soaked in cold sweat. The mountains around you make no sense; the city walls pulse like a living heart.

Your mind goes blank—

This doesn't look anything like your world.

You are Ren Xia.

A medical doctor. A surgeon.

And the vast continent before you is called Xiaoyao—a land worshipped by countless souls under the rule of a single Divine Emperor.

Day after day, the people of Xiaoyao battle invading evil and the quiet ailments inside themselves.

Your training tells you something impossible:

this world runs on the very same rules as the human body.

—Xiaoyao IS the Divine Emperor's body.

The souls who would die for him are the cells that make him whole.

You are, as of now, the only one in all of Xiaoyao who knows.

You will fight beside the dutiful denizens you meet, and they will come to call you a hero;

You will take up the five great bounties the Emperor has carried for years unsolved;

And as Doctor Hero, on this strange journey, you will peel back the secrets of this world—and seek the way back to your own…

---

About the Game

*Doctor Hero* is a story-driven RPG built on medical science and clothed in Eastern wuxia.

Through visual-novel storytelling and combat shaped by clinical strategy, you will pick up everyday health knowledge—and serious immunology and physiology—simply by playing.

Across fantastical adventures that span the common cold (acute viral upper respiratory infection), gastritis (chronic atrophic gastritis), cardiac arrhythmia, and pancreatic cancer (pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma) and beyond,

laugh your way into becoming the kind of expert who can take apart cellular function on demand.

---

Main Characters

> Beneath the eyes of Doctor Hero, the workings of all things become startlingly clear—

> Even if [Doctor View] sounds like a foreign tongue at first, after playing, the Hero in you will come to understand.

Ren Xia

[Hero View]

To Xiaoyao, you are a stranger of unknown origin, with a gourd of lollipops at your hip.

But you know the truth—you are a doctor of medicine, a surgeon. In this world, can your inner qi and your knowledge work miracles, and carry you back home?

[Doctor View]

You come to suspect, fairly soon, that your role and abilities mirror those of a Natural Killer cell (NK cell).

A sharp blade, the spirit of a wanderer—you will bring profound change to Xiaoyao.

Chun

[Hero View]

The most ordinary of the [Marrow Guard] juniors, a young woman among the first to charge the front lines.

She met Ren Xia by chance during the Lesser Demon incident, and became his trusting, devoted disciple.

[Doctor View]

Innate Immune Cell · Myeloid · Neutrophil

The most abundant of white blood cells. As the immune system's first responders, neutrophils rush to sites of infection and eliminate pathogens through phagocytosis and the release of antimicrobial agents.

Xiao Ba

[Hero View]

A warrior of the Marine Army, risen through layered trials. Cheerful, confident, and gently self-deprecating about his own wits—he hunts traitors and corrupted souls on the strength of intelligence reports and warrants.

He met Ren Xia during the Yanxia Pass crisis—and that meeting stirred up a past he had long tried to bury…

[Doctor View]

Adaptive Immune Cell · Lymphocyte · T Cell · Cytotoxic T Cell (CD8+)

The principal killing force of adaptive immunity. Releases perforin and granzymes to drive infected or transformed cells into apoptosis.

Xiao Si

[Hero View]

The strategist of the Marine Army, also forged through layered trials. Steady and sharp-minded—he supports allies, gathers intelligence, and shapes the rhythm of the field.

He met Ren Xia during the Yanxia Pass crisis—and noticed there was something not quite right about him…

[Doctor View]

Adaptive Immune Cell · Lymphocyte · T Cell · Helper T Cell (CD4+)

Through cytokine release and other signals, the helper T cell coordinates and reinforces the rest of the adaptive immune response.

Zhao

[Hero View]

A Giant Marrow Guard, the lady general who keeps watch deep in the bamboo forest. With a great cauldron in hand, she devours demons and gathers in the remains of fallen comrades alike.

Her bond with Ren Xia, forged during the Lesser Demon turmoil, has set her thinking about Xiaoyao's fate.

[Doctor View]

Innate Immune Cell · Myeloid · Macrophage

A large phagocyte, and a professional antigen-presenting cell (APC)—the bridge between innate and adaptive immunity.

Jian

[Hero View]

An Epithelial Guard, a common citizen standing the front line at Yanxia Pass. No fighter—what he is good at is calling for help and absorbing blows.

Behind that thick-skinned, plain-spoken exterior is a man who, after the Yanxia Pass incident, has come to regard Ren Xia as the one who saved his life…

[Doctor View]

Tissue Cell · Epithelial Cell

Tightly arrayed cells that form the body's physical barrier against external invaders.

Lei

[Hero View]

A messenger—the eyes and ears of the Divine Emperor. Through a secret transmission art passed down within his order, he gathers information across wide regions and reports it home.

The Emperor's surveillance, the Emperor's hearing—his arts are wondrous enough that he can sit motionless and act a thousand miles away.

[Doctor View]

Nervous System · Primary Sensory Neuron

The fundamental unit of the nervous system. Conducts electrical impulses; links sensation to coordination across the entire body.

> And many more companions still wait along the road to be revealed…

> Fight, adventure, and untangle the troubles of Xiaoyao alongside its cells—and rise as the famed Doctor Hero.

---

Game Design

- The full work is planned across five major chapters, each centered on one common topic in popular medicine:

· The Common Cold

· Stomach Pain

· Staying Up Late

· Obesity

· Cancer

- Presented as a medium-to-long visual novel paired with light turn-based combat, within an RPG framework.

---

About the Developer

*Doctor Hero* is a medical-science RPG independently developed by **Uncle Yidao**.

There is no fee. There are no microtransactions. It is simply the attempt of one clinician—using the hours off-duty—to bring together the form of entertainment he loves most and the science communication he believes in.

We hope to dedicate this work to you, who care about your health.

And if you find yourself liking it, please pass it on to those around you who love life and value their well-being.

The medical knowledge in this work has been adapted and popularized for the sake of storytelling. It is for reference only and does not constitute medical advice or guidance.

If you are facing a health concern, please consult a qualified professional.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE HORDES WON'T STOP. WILL YOU?

A 3D survival roguelike wrapped in retro PSX aesthetics. Thousands

of enemies, twenty weapons, ancient pacts with unpredictable cost.

Every run is a new build, a new death, a new chance.

ABOUT THE GAME

You are the last hunter in lands swallowed by darkness. Vampires,

goblins, ancient treants and bosses older than the gods themselves

march in endless waves. Pick your weapons, forge your build, gamble

on pacts with forgotten powers — and last as long as you can.

KEY FEATURES

• 20 unique weapons — from Sickle and Whip to Moonlight and Soul Link

• Ascension system — evolve your weapons into legendary forms

• 21 rings to collect and upgrade

• Ancient Pacts — high-risk modifiers offered at the Shrine

• 24 enemy types with elite variants

• Procedurally generated locations

• Shrines, Grimoires, Curse Statues — in-world risk and reward mechanics

• Character customization, passive skills, savable build presets

• First-person and third-person camera modes

• Retro PS1-style visuals: PSX shaders and 2D sprite enemies in 3D worlds

• Day/night cycle, dynamic fog, atmospheric sound design

EMBRACE THE RISK

Sign a pact — gain power, pay the price. Death's Debt. Doppelganger.

Glass Covenant. Pendulum. Every pact rewrites the rules of your run.

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into the soot-stained glamour of 1940s Hartford, Connecticut, in Encoria!, a first-person Circus RPG inspired by a chilling true story. As the newly hired Ringmaster, you are the architect of spectacle - orchestrate breathtaking performances by directing your talent and engaging with the performers and environment to keep the crowd roaring. 

Capture the audience’s claps to manifest Encoria stones, a mystical currency used to unlock the heavy doors of the circus grounds and reveal the dark secrets hidden within the shadows of the backstage rooms.

Between the shows, the greasepaint comes off, and the real drama begins. Navigate the labyrinthine backstage rooms to play minigames, immersing you in The Silly Circus.

Through conversation, you’ll uncover the personal histories and existential fears of your performers, strengthening your team’s resolve before the next curtain rises. 

When tragedy strikes, the game shifts into a pulse-pounding survival horror experience. As a catastrophic fire engulfs the tent, you must navigate the chaos and save who you can. Every second is a gamble as you dodge lethal flames and gore-streaked wreckage to pull your performers from the inferno.

Featuring a haunting, "lo-fi" aesthetic with low-poly 3D models and hand-painted textures, Encoria! blends nostalgic charm with visceral horror. Can you maintain the magic of the circus, or will you lose everything to the flames?

store_data.about_the_game:
A card game grandparents and grandkids both know


Žolík (pronounced ZHOH-leek) is a beloved Central European rummy played for generations across Slovakia and Czechia. The Slovak name literally means Joker — and jokers are the cards that make every hand a puzzle.

Now on Steam with friend lobbies, customizable rules, AI bots for solo play, and full Slovak + English interfaces.

How it plays


Build sets (three or more cards of the same rank) and sequences (three or more in a row, same suit), play them onto the table, and lay off cards onto opponents' melds. Be the first to empty your hand each round. Whoever finishes a multi-round match with the lowest cumulative score wins.

Jokers are wildcards — but specific rules govern how they swap, burn, and carry between rounds. The game rewards patience, observation, and the occasional well-timed bluff.

Features


  • 2–4 player online multiplayer — host a Steam lobby, invite friends through the Steam overlay. No IP, no port forwarding.
  • Solo mode vs AI — practice against 1–3 bots offline.
  • Three rule presets — Slow (the classic Central European version), Fast (modern, looser opening), or Custom with twelve tunable rules.
  • Reconnection — drop and rejoin mid-match without losing your seat.
  • Bilingual — full English and Slovak interfaces, switchable any time.
  • Steam achievements — eleven goals tracking wins, milestones, and party tricks.
  • Steam Cloud — your settings, custom rules, and stats follow you to any PC.

Why play digitally?


Žolík has lived around kitchen tables for decades. The digital version isn't here to replace that — it's here for the moments when the table isn't possible. Family across borders, friends in different cities, or just a quiet evening alone. Same rules, same feel, with Steam carrying the cards.

movies.name: Split-Screen Co-Op Horror Gameplay | Redemption: The Sin Eternal

store_data.about_the_game:
Redemption: The Sin Eternal is a dark psychological horror game about guilt, possession, and a priest trapped inside the sins of his past.

You play as Father Lucian Vale, a Catholic priest drawn into a cursed orphanage where the line between confession, punishment, and damnation begins to disappear. As the night unfolds, Lucian is forced to explore haunted rooms, abandoned halls, and twisted spiritual realms connected to the suffering of the children who once lived there. The game offers a split-screen experience, as the second player gets to play as Father John.

But something is wrong. The orphanage is not simply abandoned — it remembers. Voices whisper through radios, phones ring in empty rooms, toys move on their own, and demonic figures stalk the darkness. Every note, sound, and supernatural encounter reveals more about what happened inside the orphanage, and what Lucian may have done before he arrived.

Features

  • Psychological horror story centered on Father Lucian Vale, a priest confronting his past sins.

  • Single-player and local split-screen co-op support.

  • First-person and third-person gameplay, allowing players to switch perspective during exploration.

  • Haunted orphanage setting with dormitories, dining halls, prayer rooms, dark corridors, and demonic spaces.

  • Exploration-based storytelling through notes, environmental clues, radio broadcasts, phone calls, and supernatural events.

  • Enemy encounters and chase sequences where players must run, hide, and survive.

  • Platforming and traversal challenges, including dangerous canyon paths, boulder jumps, and deadly falls.

  • Checkpoint-based progression for retrying difficult areas.

  • Creepy atmosphere and sound design with demonic voices, crying children, distorted prayers, radio reports, and unsettling ambience.

  • Early Access development, with more levels, scares, enemies, story content, polish, and gameplay features planned over time.

Current Early Access Content

The Early Access version includes the opening playable section of the game, introducing the orphanage, Father Lucian Vale, interactive notes, supernatural events, environmental scares, exploration, split-screen functionality, perspective switching, and early enemy/traversal gameplay.

As development continues, the game will expand with additional levels, more story chapters, new enemy encounters, improved animations, more voice/audio content, refined gameplay mechanics, and deeper horror sequences.

store_data.about_the_game:
On a day that started like any other, you were startled by Ashley and her story of a contest she won, granting you all a trip to an expensive resort. Ultimately deciding to leave, you start packing your things. But not all is as it seems.. As the corporation in charge of this contest has some deeper, more sinister plans for you. Choose your protagonist and unravel the story, discover the goals of this corporation and form unbreakable bonds with the people around you. Will you take advantage of the situation? Corrupting the others and bending them to your will? Or will you give love a chance? The choice is yours.

We Are Lost II is an Adult Visual Novel centered around the story of 5 people who found themselves on the radar of a shady corporation. In We Are Lost II you will have a choice between two different protagonists. Depending on which character you choose to play as the story presented will be different! That is not the only story altering choice you will have. Another will be whether or not you will join the Corporation in charge of the situation your player character finds themselves in. Do you agree with their goals and want to help them further them? Or will you try to take them down? Both choices are valid and will completely change the story of the game. This means We Are Lost II will offer you 4 major paths of the story. The game features hundreds of HD still images and many animations, with 3 different women you will be able to form a relationship with. The game is designed as a 'Harem' genre so you will be able to connect with all 3 women in the same playthrough. The gallery is also a part of the game so you will be able to rewatch all your favorite scenes without having to play through the game to watch them again.

store_data.about_the_game:
Donlan Men's Athletic Academy: Before the Line is a BL visual novel set in a private MMA academy, where young adult fighters are preparing to enter the professional circuit.

You play as Xu Yanchuan, a disciplined and restrained student who believes every movement should have a clear purpose. After entering Donlan Men's Athletic Academy, he meets Jiang Ye—a sharp, unpredictable fighter who always manages to disrupt his rhythm. What begins as irritation and technical conflict gradually turns into recognition, attraction, and a dangerous closeness neither of them knows how to handle.

This is the first installment in the Donlan Men's Athletic Academy series. It follows the early stage of Xu Yanchuan and Jiang Ye's relationship: from rivalry, training clashes, and cafeteria conversations, to late-night practice, subtle tension in the infirmary, and the first moment when professional distance begins to loosen.

Story

Donlan is not an ordinary school.

Every trainee is ranked, evaluated, recorded, and pushed toward the same goal: earning a place in the national youth competition and, eventually, the professional MMA circuit. Inside the training hall, every mistake is visible. Every choice has weight. Every relationship is shaped by competition.

Xu Yanchuan wants control.

Jiang Ye keeps stepping into the places he cannot control.

Their relationship does not begin with tenderness. It begins with friction: mismatched rhythms, sharp words, forced training pairs, and the kind of attention that neither of them wants to admit. As the months pass, irritation becomes recognition, recognition becomes tension, and tension becomes something harder to ignore.

Features

  • A story-driven BL visual novel focused on adult male characters.

  • A modern MMA academy setting with training, ranking, sparring, and professional competition pressure.

  • A slow-burn relationship built through conflict, physical tension, and emotional restraint.

  • Character-driven scenes in the training hall, cafeteria, medical room, night gym, and academy facilities.

  • Multiple language support for subtitles and interface.

  • Chinese voice acting for the main story.

  • Cohesive character sprites, backgrounds, artwork, music, and visual novel presentation.

  • A complete standalone title, and the beginning of a larger series story.

Content Note

This game contains romantic scenes between adult male characters, including kissing, embracing, suggestive romantic tension, partial male upper-body nudity, mild profanity, brief references to alcohol, and non-bloody MMA training and combat scenes. It does not contain explicit sexual acts, visible genitals, sexual violence, gore, gambling, drug abuse, or online interaction.

store_data.about_the_game:
Summary

Bound By A Curse is an asymmetric co-op horror game where two survivors are linked by a supernatural force that swaps their positions.

One is trapped inside a mysterious room. The other walks through a world twisted by a parallel dimension filled with monsters, hidden clues, and things that should not exist.

Find the room. Break the curse. Escape together.

One player takes on the role of the Explorer, navigating dark, dangerous areas filled with obstacles and several threats. The other becomes the Operator, observing through their partner's eyes and monitoring the environment to guide their partner using information the Explorer cannot see.

Operator

As the Operator, you can see and hear information that the explorer can't, so you must keep a close eye of their environment at all times. You must also prepare yourself for the inevitable moment that you swap positions.

  • Analyze the environment

  • Listen for sounds

  • Recharge your flashlight

  • Relay important information

Explorer

As the Explorer, your job is to navigate around the dangerous environment, listen to the operator's information and avoid the lurking threats. Conserving your resources is also crucial.

  • Navigate the environment

  • Locate important items

  • Solve puzzles

  • Communicate with the operator

Role Swapping

At regular intervals, roles switch. The Explorer returns to safety, and the Operator must enter the environment themselves. Both players must adapt, communicate, and trust each other to survive.

Every action depends on coordination. The Explorer must rely on the Operator's instructions to solve puzzles, avoid danger, and progress, while the Operator must interpret limited data and make quick decisions under pressure. Mistakes can be costly, and tension builds as the threat becomes more aggressive.

Puzzles

There are several types of puzzles requiring communication and deduction skills in order to complete. Collecting items, looking for clues, listening to sounds and searching the environment will be crucial.

store_data.about_the_game:
Fruit Snake Arena is a fruit-fueled action snake game. Eat fruit to grow longer, dodge live hazards, and time your dash carefully: normal contact costs body length, while a well-timed dash lets you bite through enemies.

Play solo, local two-player co-op, or local versus. Each player has independent controls, so two snakes can cooperate through the same arena or compete for space.

Campaign mode includes 10 chapters with 10 substages each. Every tenth substage becomes a chapter boss. After each boss clear, the snake enters a portal in the center of the map and travels to the next chapter.

The demo also includes Classic, Boss Rush, Endless, Campaign, and two-player PK modes. Earn points through play, then spend them on skins, tools, and extra lives. If a player runs out of lives, points can be used to buy back into the run.

store_data.about_the_game:
FLY THE OPEN SKIES








In Iron Dogs, take the helm of 1930's inspired aircraft in a colorful retro-inspired arcade flight-sim where you will blast hordes of enemy aircraft, naval vessels and more! Engage in dogfights (literally) with hostile aircraft, while flying through hand-crafted environments, find hidden secrets and keep your crew airborne by pillaging resources!

JOURNEY MODE

Command your crew through environmental zones, evading hostile patrols, pillaging resources whenever possible to keep your zeppelin in the air. Recruit new crew members, ally with local factions, and fight back against a tyrannical militaristic government that seeks to wipe out all of the pirates.

ENDLESS MODE

Test your skills against and endless onslaught of enemies with increasing difficulty. Manage currency and resources to make sure you can stay in the air for as long as possible. 

UNLOCK AIRCRAFT, PILOTS, WEAPONS AND MORE

-12 unique maps (Mountains, canyons, cities, and more!)

-First Person Cockpit view 

-7+ enemy types (enemy aircraft, naval enemies, etc)

-5 factions (hostile/neutral/friendly) with reputation system

-8 new objectives (Like zeppelin defense & train heists)

-Unique & dynamic Points of Interest for each map

-9 Unique Pilots to join your crew with varied skillsets and bonuses to your aircraft

-2 new Primary Weapons

-3 new Secondary Weapons

-Full Crew Emblem customization

-Pilot & Crew name customization

-Journey Mode (Rogue-lite mode)

-Endless Wave Mode (Survivor-like mode)

-Multiplayer Mode (team dogfights, zeppelin attack, and more!)

RANK UP



Earn experience and rank up your pilot in order to unlock hats, cockpit customization and more

Music: Moonana & Bryn 

Art Direction: Tetra (Lucas Eilert)

Coding, UI & Design Director: Jet

UI Elements from: Kenney's All-in-one asset pack

Additional Sound Effects from: Ovani Sound

store_data.about_the_game:
"She Is Always Right Beside You"
Due to his father’s circumstances, a young boy, Saku, finds himself visiting the rural village of Kibuse with him.

There, he ended up captivating a mysterious Ghost that dwells in the land—Hachishakusama, the eight-feet-tall urban legend.
From that moment on, his summer begins to change.

She is always by his side, never leaving.

Is it fear… or something else?

Trapped in days with no escape, what choice will the boy make?

This is a heartwarming yet terrifying Japanese horror game.

《Controls》

  • WASD – Move

  • E – Interact

  • Tab – View Tasks

  • ESC – Settings

  • Mouse – Camera / Look

  • Left Click – Advance Text



《The Adventure》

Left behind in the village after his father departs, promising to return for him later, a young boy named Saku finds himself all alone. As he completes errands for his grandfather and interacts with a girl he meets there, the gears of fate begin to turn.

《A Peaceful Countryside》

Experience a story set within a soothing atmosphere, featuring scenery that shifts with the passing of time and the gentle sounds of nature.


《Escape》

Hachishakusama loves to play. Hide from her sight, run for your life, and find a way to outsmart her to survive the encounter.

《Streaming & Content Creation》

Game captures and live streams are more than welcome!
If you enjoy the game, we would be incredibly grateful if you could include the URL to this page in your video description.

store_data.about_the_game:
Read emails, spend tokens, dive into a surreal dimension outside the observable universe to fight unknowable horrors and harvest them for Psychomatter, have an existential crisis, grapple with the true meaning of happiness, and worry about meeting your next quota in this first-of-its-kind incremental FPS hybrid.

In ParaDive++, you play as a newly inducted member of the Prometheus Collective's ParaDiver division, as you use technology developed under the supervision of the great Professor John Zeno, to astral-project into a matrix, a pocket-dimension grown on the membrane that envelopes the observable universe.

Fight the strange psychic life forms inhabiting the matrix and collect their Psychomatter:

  • The more Psychomatter you absorb and level up, the more aggressive the matrix becomes, throwing bigger hordes and more complex lifeforms at you.

  • The more Psychomatter you spend on upgrades, the stronger you become, and the better you can keep up with what the matrix throws at you.

  • Understand the rules of the matrix to be able to maximize Psychomatter yield and reach your even increasing quota.

  • With each quota reached, you receive Prestige Tokens, which can be spent to unlock new types of upgrades you can use, losing all your existing upgrade progress in the process, but gaining access to new features and mechanics that let you reach higher and higher quotas faster the next go-around.

After each dive, you'll find yourself back at your computer, where you can lurk in co-worker chat rooms, read private messages and files, check your progress and your next quota, and purchase upgrades before diving back in again.

Can you survive the gauntlet and uncover the truth that lies at the heart of the matrix?

store_data.about_the_game:
STORYLINE

You, the nine year-old, and all of your friends from school, venture out into the woods on Halloween night on a quest to rid the monsters that have infested your town. You and your team quickly realize that this quest is not for the faint-hearted, and therefore, you are all terrified. To make matters worse, your mom only has room for one of you in her car back to town. You must fight against your team and the creatures that lay hidden in order to survive Halloween - and make it back before bedtime. 

A game of social paranoia, terrifying creatures, and make-believe guns.

FIND A FRIEND

Team up with up to one other player throughout the match to increase your chances of survival. But be careful - once there are only a few remaining, the teams will dissolve, and every kid will be on their own.

WATCH YOUR SANITY

You will undoubtably encounter monsters, scares, and the shrinking zone, all of which will cause you to slip father and farther into insanity. Watch your (and your teammate's!) sanity meter to ensure you don't go mad.

FIGHT HALLOWEEN'S CREATURES

Throughout the match, you must fight off zombies, skeletons, ghouls, and even the "Gwim Weaper" himself. 

LEVEL UP

Earning XP throughout the match will help you level up, which gives you Gourds to spend on skins, emotes, finishers, and other fun things to show off to your jealous friends. 

FIGHT!

Use your imaginary weapons to fight off the monsters as well as other kids. Watch out for the chaotic Hauntings!

SURVIVE HALLOWEEN

After all goes wrong, there's only one spot left in the car home. Be the last kid standing to make it back to the fort.

Snowday Co is a business sim where you build a snow removal operation from the ground up — starting with nothing but a shovel.

Take on jobs from residents and businesses across an open-world town, clearing driveways, walkways, and streets to earn money and grow your reputation. As you complete contracts, you'll unlock access to new areas of town, each bringing fresh challenges and new clients.

  • Accept and complete jobs from a variety of clients

  • Dynamic weather and day-night cycle that affect gameplay

  • Grow your territory as your reputation builds

store_data.about_the_game:
Cozy Country is a gentle world-builder for kids and families. Create landscapes with forests, gardens, and rivers, add animals and buildings, then wander through your creation.

Unlike fast-paced or competitive games, Cozy Country is all about relaxation, discovery, and creativity. It's a safe, calming space with no enemies, no timers, and no wrong answers. Just a cozy corner of the world that's entirely yours.

Paint forests of oak, shape terrain, and add rivers. Choose your buildings from a range of styles:  an inn, a church, a row of townhouses, a farmhouse, and watch them rise from the meadow, fully furnished and ready to explore. Adjust the floors, width, and length of any building, then step inside. Walk through your village, enter any building, sit by the fire, and watch sheep graze on the hillside. The world you create is a world you can live in.

Key features:

  • Paint the world by hand: raise terrain, plant trees and bushes, create rivers and waterfalls, and sculpt the landscape

  • Place buildings: choose from different styles and adjust their shape. Every building is furnished and ready to enter

  • Step inside what you build: walk through your village with your character, enter any building, light the fireplace, sit in a chair

  • A living landscape: Add animals that roam your fields, change time of day or weather

store_data.about_the_game:
The return of the Demon King is close. This age is in need of a Hero.

Each age, the Gods choose a Hero and a Brand Master who can face the Demon King. Knight Captain Rein is chosen as the Hero and, to his delight, his wife Aria as the Brand Master.

But, the Brand she receives is from a wicked God who will only bestows his blessings and powers to those who commit acts of betrayal.

Together with their friends Elsye, the haughty owner of a weapons shop, and Mariel, the young and kind nun, they must together share the burden of the Brand of Betrayal in order to prevent the Demon King's return.

In this NTR RPG, lead a party of four friends and adventurers on their journey to the Demon King's lair. Fight and level up to get stronger, or unleash the Brand's might. The Brand of Betrayal can lend you great powers, but only at the cost of having Rein's beloved wife and friends taken from him by other men.

Will you make use of the Brand's power to face the Demon King, or go against the odds to protect those you love?

Exciting Turn-Based Combat

Defeat the enemies who stand between you and the Demon King. Your party's clothes can even break during combat!

More Ways to Get Stronger

Increase your strength by leveling up through battle, or by empowering the Brand.

Multiple Endings

Use the Brand's powers in the NTR route, or reject them and try to protect your love.

Water Mirror Magic

View your party member's H-Stats and what they're doing at anytime. Be careful, you might not like what you see.

store_data.about_the_game:
Rule an Empire. Reshape a Century.


Sultan's Decree is a card-based strategy game that puts you in control of the Ottoman Empire across 623 years of history. From the dynasty's founding in 1299 to the birth of the Turkish Republic in 1922, every swipe of your finger determines the fate of millions. Balance the demands of four powerful factions -- the Ulema (religion), the Reaya (people), the Military (janissaries), and the Treasury (wealth) -- as you guide 36 sultans through an era of constant change.

A Legacy That Never Resets


Unlike other strategy games, your choices don't disappear when an era ends. The flags you raise or lower persist across centuries. Decisions made by an early sultan will ripple forward, shaping the challenges and opportunities faced by rulers hundreds of years later. This is history as a living system -- one where every action has consequences that echo through the ages.

Gameplay at Your Fingertips


The core mechanic is elegantly simple: swipe left or right on 500 hand-crafted cards to issue decrees that affect your four faction meters. Each decision strengthens one faction while weakening another. Will you appease the Ulema and risk angering the people? Invest in the military and watch your treasury dwindle? Every turn presents new moral dilemmas drawn from real historical events and themes.

Features


  • 500 unique, hand-written cards spanning 8 distinct historical eras
  • 36 different sultans, each with their own storyline and challenges
  • 385 character portraits rendered in authentic Ottoman miniature painting style
  • Persistent world state -- choices carry weight across centuries
  • 10 original orchestral music tracks composed for historical authenticity
  • 11 immersive sound effects that bring the empire to life
  • Highly replayable -- average playthroughs last ~432 turns and feature ~10 unique deaths per run
  • Deep narrative woven with Ottoman history, religion, politics, and culture
  • Educational value -- learn real history while you play

An Empire in Art


Every character portrait is lovingly rendered in the distinctive style of Ottoman miniature paintings -- a visual language that captures the grandeur and complexity of the empire. The artistic direction immerses you in the period while the strategic depth keeps you coming back for just one more turn.

The Question is Simple. The Answer is Never.


Sultan's Decree challenges you to navigate the impossible: rule justly while surviving politics, defend your borders while feeding your people, and maintain cultural identity while the world changes around you. There are no perfect solutions, only choices -- and the echoes of those choices will follow you for centuries.

Are you ready to reshape history?

store_data.about_the_game:
No token cap. Stay with the logs as long as you like.

AI Agent Lover is a bite-sized desktop game that puts you in front of a terminal-style screen and asks you to make approval-style calls. Read the streaming logs and prompts, keep picking the safer side, and survive. Light typos might get saved by command completion—until they don't, and you slip toward danger.

A terminal-style intro greets you on launch. On the main screen, each /start runs a set of about ten scenes—manual calls, real score, real streaks. Open extra displays with /displays and watch logs roll on their own, enough to soak in the quiet joy of feeling like you're running AI agents across your desk.

What you can expect

・Start from the intro with simple commands

・Tense back-and-forth as logs arrive line by line

・Score and streak chasing with a combo mindset

・Neat ~10-scene sessions per /start

・Extra display windows—logs only, auto-advancing—tiled across your screen edges (up to 16)

Controls

Use /start, /setting, and /displays from the intro or in-game. Tune font, opacity, display count, and language in settings. Arrow keys browse command history. Switch the interface between Japanese and English.

Single-player. Core gameplay does not require an internet connection.

store_data.about_the_game:
Pixel-neon rhythm roguelite. Six punches. 27 machines. One shot per round.

What you do

Notes fall — QWEASD top/bottom. A note hits the line, you press the right key, a punch lands. Dead center? PERFECT, full damage. Hold the combo, crack the score target, move to the next round. Miss the target — run's over, start again.

Between every round: shop. Buy gloves, pick punch-cards, collect artifacts, refresh the lineup. Every third round, a boss waits with his own nasty twist.

Features

store_data.about_the_game:
Minefront.io is a competitive online 1v1 game inspired by Minesweeper, redesigned as a fast, tactical duel with real pressure.

Each match is divided into two phases. First comes the Mining phase, where you place mines on your opponent’s board and try to create a defense that is difficult to read. Then the Incursion begins: you must clear the enemy board before your opponent does, avoiding traps, managing your time, and making decisions under pressure.

It is not just about clicking fast. Every number, every flag, and every mistake can change the outcome of the duel. A good read of the board can give you the win; a bad decision can cost you seconds, points, and control of the match.

Key features:

- Online 1v1 matches.

- Mechanics inspired by classic Minesweeper, adapted for competitive duels.

- Two phases per match: Mining and Incursion.

- Normal mines and smoke mines with different effects.

- Scoring system, mistakes, streaks, and penalties.

- Fast, intense matches that are easy to replay.

- Unlockable and exclusive avatars.

- Ranking system to compete against other players.

- Tournament mode and private matches with code.

Minefront.io keeps the essence of Minesweeper but turns it into a more competitive, modern, and strategic experience. Plan your defense, read your opponent’s board, and prove you can stay calm when every second counts.

store_data.about_the_game:
Little Master is a top‑down action RPG blended with challenging puzzles. Pick up your sword, bow or a magic staff, and embark on the mission to uncover the seven keys.

Story

Travis has vanished. In a desperate attempt to stop the King from sacrificing his own son to secure peace for the kingdom, he set out alone to end it all. The day of sacrifice draws ever closer, yet Travis has not returned. You and his loyal companions resolve to embark on a perilous journey to find him, and together, uncover what truly lies behind the danger haunting the kingdom.

Explore The World

Little Master is divided into seven distinct areas. You will explore each of these realms to complete your mission. Every world is filled with puzzles that help you grow stronger.

Master Magic

You step into the role of a small hero, yet the skills he wields are those of a true master. Call down meteors from the sky, open portals that unleash frozen blocks to halt your enemies in their tracks.

Features

  • Three weapon types, each representing a distinct playstyle: Sword, Bow, and Magic Staff.

  • Seven worlds packed with puzzles to discover and explore.

  • Over 30 skills to unlock and master.

  • A magic system that truly makes you feel powerful.

  • Challenging boss fights that demand strategy and skill.

  • A storyline full of twists and laced with humor.

The game is created with RPG Maker MZ and plugin "RPG Maker Action Combat".

store_data.about_the_game:
Tired of demons, blood, and gore? It’s time to face your childhood treats! Your favorite sweets have been brought to life by the twisted mad scientist, Small Doc. Get ready for a sugar rush that might actually kill you.

The Glycolysator, Diabetes, and Candy

Hyper Glee Semik is a high-octane First-Person Shooter centered around the mechanics of diabetes. Play as Glee, blast through waves of sentient confectionery, and take your revenge in a rain of sugar.

A Fast-Paced, Merciless Romp

Keep moving! Destroy the storage vats before you are overwhelmed by hordes of candies, more aggressive than ever. Fight your way out of the laboratory before it's too late.

Keep Your Gauge Stable

Watch your gauge! Your survival hangs by a thread. Don't flirt with the maximum or you’ll face instant death, and avoid the minimum at all costs to escape debilitating side effects. To stay in the safety zone, blast your enemies, collect their orbs, and maintain the perfect balance to keep the fight going.

Colorful and Crazed Art Style

Dive into a unique 2.5D universe that blends a Comic Book aesthetic with a "cute but cruel" world. It’s a striking visual contrast designed for nervous gameplay.

Features:

  • Challenging Gameplay: A shooter where resource management is just as vital as your aim.

  • Hybrid Visuals: A unique art style mixing "cute" charm with comic vibes in a 2.5D universe.

  • Initial Content: 2 levels and 2 types of enemies.

  • One Weapon: The Glycolysator.

------------------------------------

Hyper Glee Semik is a Final Year Project created by the Class of 2026 at Brassart Montpellier, produced over 5 months.

Developed with Unity.

store_data.about_the_game:
HyperSurge is a fast-paced boomer shooter roguelite where you climb an endless tower full of monsters.

Ascend the Tower

You’re trapped inside a tower crawling with strange monsters and all you can do is go up. Each floor gets harder, with more enemies and bigger threats. When you clear a floor, you pick up new upgrades and power-ups to get stronger.

Synergize and Evolve

You combine power-ups and weapon upgrades to create broken builds. The higher you climb, the more powerful and fun your build becomes.

Choose Your Weapons

At the beginning of each run you choose one weapon to use. You start with only the Revolver, but you can unlock many more as you progress. During the run you upgrade and improve your chosen weapon with power-ups and synergies.

Never Stop Climbing

There is no escape. You just keep pushing higher, getting stronger, and trying to beat your best record.

The shapes of the objects serve as clues to which shelf number they belong on. For example, the pair of glasses, because of its two lenses, goes on the second shelf. The skateboard, because of its four wheels, goes on the fourth shelf.

You'll also follow different clue types, and take on different sets of rules that change up the way you play.

Features:

  • 20+ levels

  • 100+ items

  • Various modifiers

  • Free Play mode

  • Leaderboards

store_data.about_the_game:
Write words. Fill shelves. Watch reality buckle.

Words become pages. Pages become books. Every book needs a genre, and each genre changes how your library grows. Fill enough shelves and reality folds. Everything resets.

Almost. You rebuild faster, stranger, deeper. And the Library starts to notice you've been here before.

Prestige is the story

Tooltips change between runs. Labels rename themselves. Log entries reference books you haven't written yet.

Three acts. Three endings. One Library that remembers everything.

Core Features

12 Genres, Your Strategy

Horror builds a Dread meter toward devastating bursts. Poetry grants timed global buffs. Romance generates paired words. Your genre balance shapes your path to the ending.

80+ Secret Combinations

Rare Words surface as you write. Combine them into Phrases with powerful effects — none documented. No guide tells you what "Eternal Autobiography Tome" does.

Five Prestige Tiers

Redraft resets your town. Rewrite resets the county. Redaction resets the country. Each tier brings new currencies, new mechanics, and new cracks in the fourth wall.

The Interface Changes Around You

No cutscenes. The story lives in the menus, names that shift between runs, entries that shouldn't exist yet, a Library that speaks through your UI.

Designed to End

~30-50 hours. Three resolution paths. Optional postgame. Complete experience, not a live service.

Also Includes

  • Scriptorium - merge Words into higher-rarity discoveries

  • Skill tree with three progression branches

  • Genre synergy bonuses

  • Offline progression (up to 24 hours, expandable)

  • Active play multiplier (3-5x idle rate)

  • Run history and stats

  • Accessibility options (colourblind mode, screen reader, toggleable effects)

  • No ads. No microtransactions. Just the Library.

From Endpaper

A solo studio. Built in Godot 4.6.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ultra Dungeon is a pixel art auto-battler dungeon crawler inspired by the classic Game Boy era and presented as a fully interactive retro handheld virtual console. Play using your keyboard or click directly on the console interface buttons to experience the game like a real retro device.

Build your party by choosing 2 out of 4 unique adventurers, each with their own strengths and combat styles. Before every expedition, you can select 2 out of 4 available skills, customize how frequently your characters will use them, and equip different weapons and items to create your own strategies.

Once inside the dungeon, your heroes will battle automatically as they progress floor by floor against increasingly dangerous monsters. The farther they travel, the greater the rewards they earn. Use the gold and loot you collect to buy better equipment, level up your characters, and unlock new abilities that allow you to venture even deeper.

Experience a mix of strategy, progression, and retro nostalgia as you attempt to uncover the secrets hidden on the mysterious 50th floor.

store_data.about_the_game:
Defend, loot, level up and descend into the deep! These are the basic principles of Octogun. You were just about to enjoy some snacks in the middle of the ocean as these mean intruders enter your domain and try to take away what is yours. So get on the defense, take back what they stole and become stronger and stronger. This is YOUR place to be!

Defend!

Defend yourself from the hordes of enemies by equipping up to 8 weapons simultaneously of a selection of more than 35 weapons. Choose the powerful sniper, overwhelm the masses with the devastating minigun or set them ablaze using the flamethrower, there is a choice and combination for everyone.

Try out different weapons every time to find the playstyle that matches you the best!

Loot!

Defeating enemies drops the most precious of all! Goldfish! Collect them and buy new weapons from the store. Stronger weapons mean that even more goldfish are yours to be taken. Earn more, fight more and earn even more. Who is going to stop you now?

Level Up!

After surviving a certain amount of enemies you will have proven yourself to challenge even stronger enemies. By leveling up you will face off against even tougher enemies, but the rewards will be worth it.

Stronger weapons will appear in the shop and more money will be earned! But do not worry old weapons still have a purpose. Merge 2 identical weapons to upgrade them to the next level. The sky is the limit!

Descension!

You are fighting and fighting but cannot keep up? Do not worry! Descension will bring you back to the start momentarily, but you will come back even stronger! Get access to more permanent upgrades to your stats, modify your build with the skill tree of the deep as well as a massive boost to your money earned.

Tap into the power of the deep and become unstoppable.

Unlocks!

The game will launch with more than 20 unique hats to unlock. After completing a small feat to unlock the hat, you will be able to select any unlocked hat before passing on beyond level 5 to elevate your power to the next level.

Each hat comes with its own unique benefit for your current ascension run allowing you to specialize your loadout for any occasion.

And did i forget to mention the style? You can be an adventurer, a cook or a wizard. Or feel free to live out your cutie dreams with some cat ears while chat asks for kissies. The choice is yours!

store_data.about_the_game:
Explore a detailed map featuring numerous locations and a dynamic day-night cycle. Every corner is filled with interactive elements that pull you deeper into the unique provincial atmosphere.

Along the way, you will meet three girls, each with her own distinct personality, struggles, and hobbies. To succeed, you must find a unique approach to each of them and navigate their individual questlines.

Beyond romantic interests, you can build meaningful connections with friends, relatives, and a diverse cast of characters, each featuring their own unique personality and dedicated questline. The game is packed with interactive depth: from shopping for various items and engaging in micromanagement gameplay to branching dialogues where your choices truly shape the unfolding narrative.

This isn’t an attempt to reconstruct reality, but rather to capture a specific mood. It’s an echo of an era when cities were less polished, yet somehow felt more alive. Today, the streets are cleaner, the facades brighter, and the spaces more convenient. And yet, the memory holds onto the warmth of those courtyards, stairwells, and vacant lots where an entire generation grew up.

Always Summer Out Here is a journey into that very feeling. It’s a place that never truly existed, but one that everyone will recognize.

store_data.about_the_game:
Jianghu Cangfeng is a martial arts turn-based party-building roguelike RPG set in a dangerous jianghu world.

Lead your heroes into mysterious realms filled with battles, random events, treasure, rest points, and difficult choices. Every step consumes supplies, and every encounter tests your planning, martial arts setup, equipment choices, and resource management.

The game features techniques from multiple martial arts sects, as well as wandering jianghu styles. Skills differ in damage types, cooldowns, energy costs, buffs, debuffs, dispels, cleanses, interruptions, and channeling effects. Build each character around their role, combine techniques with equipment, and adapt your strategy to different enemies.

During each expedition, you may gain temporary raid perks, equipment rewards, and event outcomes that change your run. Choosing when to take risks, when to conserve supplies, and how to prepare for key battles is central to survival.

This is not a game about simply overpowering enemies with numbers. It is about making choices under pressure, shaping your martial arts build, and slowly forging a party that can survive the hidden dangers of the jianghu.

Key Features:

- Martial arts turn-based combat

- Party building with multiple playable characters

- Techniques from different sects and wandering jianghu styles

- Character growth shaped by skills, equipment, and temporary raid perks

- Expedition-based exploration with supply management

store_data.detailed_description:
Jianghu Cangfeng is a martial arts turn-based party-building roguelike RPG set in a dangerous jianghu world.

Lead your heroes into mysterious realms filled with battles, random events, treasure, rest points, and difficult choices. Every step consumes supplies, and every encounter tests your planning, martial arts setup, equipment choices, and resource management.

The game features techniques from multiple martial arts sects, as well as wandering jianghu styles. Skills differ in damage types, cooldowns, energy costs, buffs, debuffs, dispels, cleanses, interruptions, and channeling effects. Build each character around their role, combine techniques with equipment, and adapt your strategy to different enemies.

During each expedition, you may gain temporary raid perks, equipment rewards, and event outcomes that change your run. Choosing when to take risks, when to conserve supplies, and how to prepare for key battles is central to survival.

This is not a game about simply overpowering enemies with numbers. It is about making choices under pressure, shaping your martial arts build, and slowly forging a party that can survive the hidden dangers of the jianghu.

Key Features:

- Martial arts turn-based combat

- Party building with multiple playable characters

- Techniques from different sects and wandering jianghu styles

- Character growth shaped by skills, equipment, and temporary raid perks

- Expedition-based exploration with supply management

- Random events, treasure, rest points, and combat encounters

- Combat mechanics including buffs, debuffs, dispels, cleanses, interruptions, and channeling

- Strategic choices that shape each run
store_data.short_description: Jianghu Cangfeng is a martial arts turn-based RPG about party building, skill choices, and dangerous expeditions. Explore mysterious realms, manage supplies, learn techniques from different sects, and forge your own hidden path through the jianghu.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bloomtide

Every morning, a 9×9 board reshuffles from your filling pool. Apples, lightning, hawks, cherry blossoms — what ends up next to what decides how much you earn today. You have one job: pay the rent.

But the real game is turning "enough" into an explosion.

Core Loop

  • The board reshuffles every day — same pool, new layout. Adjacent relationships create new synergies each run.

  • Event queue resolution — growth, devour, movement, decay, burst. One event triggers the next, chaining into exponential payoffs.

  • Daily 3-pick (CoreItem) — add a new symbol type, or weight an existing one. Slowly bend the random board toward your archetype.

  • Rent at the end of each cycle — survive the rent check, then pick a BuffItem or EffectItem to amplify whatever build is forming. Cycles get longer as you progress; rent keeps climbing.

Three Strategy Layers

  • Board (CoreItem) — define what can show up on your board.

  • Environment (EffectItem) — Snowy Mountain accelerates growth. Deep Sea strengthens devouring. Match your archetype.

  • Equipment (BuffItem) — multiplier wands, xmult rings. Take a working build and break the numbers.

"I went growth-fruits → I need the snowy mountain → I need the multiplier wand." When the build clicks, you feel the machine working for you.

Two Modes

  • Campaign — 12 rent payments to win. A guided ramp through every mechanic.

  • Endless — rent stops scaling at run 14. All items unlocked. No survival pressure — just "how far can my build push the numbers?"

Why You Won't Stop

  • Numbers go up — hard. A modifier pipeline (chips_add → chips_mul → mult_add → mult_mul → xmult) takes a good hand from dozens to millions in a single resolve.

  • Hidden combos to discover. A hawk eating a snake poisons the field. A cherry blossom hitting zero blows up everyone. Hundreds of cross-item interactions waiting.

  • Every run is different. Archetypes × environments × equipment = a vast space of viable builds.

  • Simple rules, emergent depth. Each item is readable at a glance. The combinations are not.

  • Stylized symbol art. Every piece is readable at a glance — high information density, zero recognition cost.

store_data.about_the_game:
A signal under the ice. A crew with too little time. A choice Earth will not understand.


Kryonull is a cinematic science-fiction visual novel set on Europa, the frozen moon of Jupiter. The expedition ship Sirena descends toward a thermal anomaly beneath the ice and a repeating radio pattern that sounds less like noise with every minute.

Every decision changes the mission profile: preserve the relay or chase the signal, drill slowly or force a narrow window, answer the ocean or leave in silence. Trust, hull integrity, oxygen, evidence, and biological risk shape the route to one of several endings.

Features

  • Branching sci-fi story inspired by tense first-contact cinema.
  • Multiple routes and endings based on mission discipline, crew trust, evidence, and risk.
  • Russian and English text support.
  • Voice acting for both Russian and English versions.
  • Original 1920x1080 background art for Europa, the under-ice ocean, laboratories, orbit, and mission-critical scenes.

For players who like

Quiet space horror, philosophical science fiction, hard choices, crew drama, alien contact, and endings that remember what you risked.

Bet on every card flip in this cozy roguelike deckbuilder.

Will the next card be Higher, Lower, or Equal? Predict right and stack your score. Predict wrong and watch your run unravel. Hi-Lo Roguelike is a card-flipping, joker-stacking, story-telling adventure where every choice could be your last.

Climb a procedurally generated map of battles, shops, events, and treasures. Collect 32 unique jokers, build absurd score-multiplying combos, and find your perfect run. Then do it all over again, every run is different.

FEATURES

Master the Hi-Lo Mechanic, Predict if the next card is higher, lower, or equal. Simple to learn, impossible to master.

32 Unique Jokers to Collect, From the simple Diamond Hunter to the run, defining Phoenix, each joker rewires how you play.

15 Story-Driven Events, Encounter a lost puppy, a card-sharking monkey, a whispering crystal lizard. Every choice, Brave, Smart, or Coward, changes your run.

Roguelike Map Progression, Battle nodes, shops, treasures, elites, and a final boss. Choose your path wisely.

Skill Over Luck, Use Peek, Skip, and Insurance abilities to read the deck. The more you know, the better you bet.

Pastel Cozy Aesthetic, A handcrafted cartoon world full of charm, soft colors, and surprisingly tense decisions.

Endless Replayability, Procedurally generated maps, randomized jokers, branching events. No two runs alike.

If you love score-stacking deckbuilders, run-based roguelikes, and cozy story-driven card games, Hi-Lo Roguelike was built for you.

One deck. Endless decisions. Will you bet it all?

A decade and almost 1 million mobile downloads later, Skillful Pixel Dungeon comes to Steam.

Dive into a challenging roguelike RPG where every run tells a different story. Choose from four distinct classes, each offering unique active and passive abilities that open up multiple playstyles. Whether you favor brute force, precision, or strategy, no two journeys feel the same.

Descend through 25 procedural generated levels filled with danger, secrets, and loot, culminating in five formidable bosses that will test your mastery. With ever-changing dungeons and meaningful build variety, Skillful Pixel Dungeon delivers a fresh, high-stakes experience every time you play.

Pick one of 4 classes

Warrior

The warrior relies on brute strength and toughness in combat. His skills are close combat oriented leveraging melee weapons and high durability. The gladiators excel in single melee combat while berserkes are all around strong and can attack multiple enemies in one attack.

Mage

The mage relies on magic and minions to battle the forces of evil. The battle mage subclass boosts wand damage and allows using mana to absorb damage while the warlock turns his minions into even more feared beasts.

Rogue

The rogue relies on stealth and speed. Some rogues are so fast they can create copies of themselves while others excel in stealth allowing them to instantly take out sleeping enemies.

Huntress

The huntress is the weakest of all physically but her ranged skills make sure no enemy comes to close. The huntress's knowledge with the bow gives her access to skills like fletching and kneeshot. The warden is capable of shooting two arrows in one go as well as hunting animals passively for food. Snipers are capable of putting enemies to sleep and even attaching explosives to arrows.

Mercenaries

The hero is not alone on his quest. He can hire one of five mercenaries to aid him on his quest. The mercs come with basic equipment that may need replacement as the levels get tougher.

Brute

The toughest of mercenaries. A brute is slow but capable of soaking a lot of damage. He is also of capable of carrying any item in the carry slot.

Wizard

The wizard is physically weak but can summon rats in combat.

Thief

The thief is very fast and relies on stealth. His attack may poison enemies.

Archer

The archer does not have a lot of health so she attacks from distance. She has a habit of attacking kneecaps.

Archer Maiden

The elite version of archer mercs. Archer maidens are more expensive but worth the investment.

store_data.about_the_game:
Idle Defense throws you into a hypnotic, minimalist arena where neon cubes of every color surge toward you. You can crush them yourself or build an automatic defense grid that grinds them down while you strategize.

This isn't just another idle game. It's a deep, neon-soaked loop of progression, prestige, and pure destruction.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Dual-Mode Destruction – Play actively by smashing cubes with your mouse, or go idle by purchasing automated turrets that fire non-stop. Both paths are viable. Both are rewarding.

  • 7 Cube Colors = 7 Currencies – Each color has its own resource, its own upgrade tree, and its own behavior. All seven can swarm your screen at once. Manage the chaos.

  • 25 Base Upgrades – Split across three core pillars:
    Cube upgrades, Idle turret upgrades, Mouse upgrades.

  • Prestige System – Reset your progress to permanently boost your base upgrade power with multipliers and raise upgrade base levels. Each prestige makes the next run noticeably stronger.

  • Tiers Difficulty – Complete specific objectives to ascend to higher Tiers. Each new Tier ramps up the danger—and the rewards.

  • Perk System – Unlock passive skills and unique bonuses based on your total enemies defeated. The more you kill, the more specialized your build becomes.

  • Boss Waves – Summon massive, high-risk waves at will. Defeat the boss to claim exclusive rewards that normal cubes never drop.

  • Minimalist. Neon. Satisfying. – No clutter. No distraction. Just a grid, vivid cubes, sharp particle effects, and clean UI. It looks simple. It plays deep.

Add Idle Defense to your wishlist and dive into the neon grind very soon!

store_data.about_the_game:
About Hearts in Open Water


Hearts in Open Water is an adult romance visual novel set aboard M/Y Halcyon, a 55-meter superyacht working a high-pressure Mediterranean charter season while quietly preparing for a looming sale. You play as Reeve, a disciplined ex-Royal Navy captain whose authority is absolute on the water—and whose job depends on a single line in a closing memo.

Over twelve weeks of procedures, port calls, and midnight requests that never make it into the official log, three women step across thresholds only the captain controls. Choose one route, live one romance—and learn what a season-ending decision really costs.

Meet the Cast




Cosima — The Owner's Suite
Cosima Lasry is the perfectly photographed wife of a hedge-fund titan—and the most strategic person on the yacht. As her marriage approaches a contractual deadline, she begins using the vessel's routines to carve out an escape that no one is allowed to notice. To Reeve, she is both principal and pressure point: a woman who understands his discretion, and knows exactly how to ask for it.



Anouk — The Survey
A senior yacht sales broker with a six-figure commission on the line, Anouk boards Halcyon as the buyer's observer—clipboard in hand, reputation sharpened to a blade. Her closing memo contains a retention line that can keep Reeve in command or quietly end his tenure. Their relationship is a controlled collision of ambition and attraction: two people trained to keep everything on record, tempted by what happens when the record is closed.



Tully — The Interior
Promoted to Chief Stewardess on Reeve's signature, Tully runs the yacht's luxury like a mission—fast, flawless, and almost invisible until she chooses not to be. Behind the polished service is a private urgency: her sister's chemo back in Brisbane, paid for by the very season she cannot afford to leave. With Reeve, her romance is built on mutual competence and late-night honesty—two professionals choosing each other in the only gaps the job allows.

Key Features


  • Single-choice romance routes with high-stakes intimacy: commit to one love interest and follow a focused, escalating relationship shaped by your decision.
  • A superyacht romance grounded in power, protocol, and consequence: maritime law, chain of command, and professional distance are the central tension.
  • The Logbook as a living threat: what gets recorded, what gets omitted, and what can never be erased drives the story's suspense.
  • Three distinct romantic arcs, three distinct worlds: The Interior, The Survey, and The Owner's Suite.
  • A seasonal clock you cannot stop: the sale closes, the charter ends, and the vessel moves on—no matter what you choose.
  • Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes.

Over twelve weeks of procedures, port calls, and midnight requests that never make it into the official log, three women step across thresholds only the captain controls. Choose one route, live one romance—and learn what a season-ending decision really costs.

Meet the Cast




Cosima — The Owner's Suite
Cosima Lasry is the perfectly photographed wife of a hedge-fund titan—and the most strategic person on the yacht. As her marriage approaches a contractual deadline, she begins using the vessel's routines to carve out an escape that no one is allowed to notice. To Reeve, she is both principal and pressure point: a woman who understands his discretion, and knows exactly how to ask for it.



Anouk — The Survey
A senior yacht sales broker with a six-figure commission on the line, Anouk boards Halcyon as the buyer's observer—clipboard in hand, reputation sharpened to a blade. Her closing memo contains a retention line that can keep Reeve in command or quietly end his tenure. Their relationship is a controlled collision of ambition and attraction: two people trained to keep everything on record, tempted by what happens when the record is closed.



Tully — The Interior
Promoted to Chief Stewardess on Reeve's signature, Tully runs the yacht's luxury like a mission—fast, flawless, and almost invisible until she chooses not to be. Behind the polished service is a private urgency: her sister's chemo back in Brisbane, paid for by the very season she cannot afford to leave. With Reeve, her romance is built on mutual competence and late-night honesty—two professionals choosing each other in the only gaps the job allows.

Key Features


  • Single-choice romance routes with high-stakes intimacy: commit to one love interest and follow a focused, escalating relationship shaped by your decision.
  • A superyacht romance grounded in power, protocol, and consequence: maritime law, chain of command, and professional distance are the central tension.
  • The Logbook as a living threat: what gets recorded, what gets omitted, and what can never be erased drives the story's suspense.
  • Three distinct romantic arcs, three distinct worlds: The Interior, The Survey, and The Owner's Suite.
  • A seasonal clock you cannot stop: the sale closes, the charter ends, and the vessel moves on—no matter what you choose.
  • Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Galaxiwilds is a narrative-driven space exploration experience focused on discovery, first contact, and uncovering the unknown.

Reality is breaking.

Across multiple universes, rifts tear through space, black holes behave unpredictably, and entire systems collapse without warning. These phenomena are not random—they are connected.

Your mission is not to conquer.
It is to understand.

Travel between universes, chart strange systems, and make contact with 75 unique alien civilizations, each with their own culture, history, technology, and perspective on the unfolding crisis.

Some will share knowledge.
Some will grant you new abilities.
Some will offer allies you can call upon—individuals with their own personalities, insights, and stories to tell.

As your network grows, so does your understanding of what lies beyond the rifts… and what may be causing them.

But this is not a guided journey.

Clues are not handed to you. Coordinates are not saved. Information must be observed, remembered, and recorded.

The truth is out there—but only if you’re paying attention.

store_data.about_the_game:
Medieval vs Machines is an incremental tower defense auto-battler about building a medieval army to defend your castle against a massive invasion of machines from another dimension.

Your kingdom was peaceful… until the sky split open and strange mechanical armies came pouring through. Robots, cyber soldiers, tanks, and war machines now march toward your land. Your only choice is to raise an army, strengthen your defenses, and fight back.

Build your forces from humble medieval troops into a powerful fantasy army. Recruit warriors, lancers, archers, knights, and even mighty monsters to protect your castle. Every unit has a role in battle, and every upgrade brings you closer to surviving the next wave.

Build Your Medieval Army

Start small, then grow into a full battlefield force. Add more troops, improve their stats, and unlock new ways to fight the machine horde.

Train and upgrade:

  • Sword-wielding warriors

  • Long-range archers

  • Charging lancers

  • Heavy armored knights

  • Powerful fantasy monsters

  • Defensive towers and castle upgrades

As your army grows, battles become larger, louder, and more chaotic.

Defend Against the Machine Horde

The machines do not stop. Each wave brings more enemies, stronger units, and deadlier attacks. Fight against robotic soldiers, futuristic weapons, armored vehicles, and cybernetic monsters from another dimension.

Your medieval army may look simple, but with the right upgrades, even swords and bows can stand against steel and lasers.

Incremental Progression

Medieval vs Machines is built around satisfying incremental growth. Earn resources from battle, spend them on upgrades, and come back stronger every wave.

Upgrade your troops, improve your castle, unlock new units, and push deeper into the machine invasion. Every run makes your army stronger and your defenses harder to break.

Unlock Skill Trees

Customize your strategy through skill trees. Improve your troops, boost your towers, unlock special upgrades, and shape your army around your favorite playstyle.

Focus on overwhelming numbers, powerful elite units, stronger defenses, faster attacks, or monster-based chaos.

Massive Auto-Battler Battles

Once the battle begins, your army fights automatically. Watch huge pixel-art battles unfold as medieval soldiers clash against futuristic machines.

Battles can grow into massive 100 vs 100+ fights filled with arrows, blades, bullets, explosions, monsters, and robots.

Your job is to prepare the army.
Their job is to hold the line.

Charming Pixel Art Style

Enjoy a fun contrast between cute medieval fantasy units and colorful cyberpunk machines. The battlefield is full of personality, from tiny knights and archers to giant monsters and mechanical invaders.

Key Features

  • Incremental tower defense gameplay

  • Auto-battler style combat

  • Build and upgrade a medieval army

  • Defend your castle against machine hordes

  • Recruit warriors, lancers, archers, knights, and monsters

  • Unlock skill trees and customize your troops

  • Large-scale 100 vs 100+ pixel-art battles

  • Medieval fantasy vs cyberpunk machine theme

  • Charming pixel art and chaotic battlefield action

Defend the Castle

The machines want your land.
Your army stands in their way.

Build your kingdom. Upgrade your troops. Hold the castle.

This is your land. Defend it.
