store_data.about_the_game:
It started with a meme.

A harmless image mocking a powerful dictator from across the border. Days later, its creator vanished.

Your agency was hired to bring him back.

What should have been a straightforward extraction turns into something far more dangerous. The deeper you push into hostile territory, the clearer it becomes, this isn’t about one man. It’s about control.

The regime isn’t just silencing critics. It’s rewriting what people are allowed to see, say, and even find funny.

And now you’re in the middle of it.

Infiltrate heavily guarded facilities, gather intel, and adapt as your mission keeps expanding beyond its original scope. What begins as a rescue becomes a fight to dismantle the system and confront the man behind it.

Key Features

  • Stealth-First Gameplay

     Stealth is a great first option. But sometimes......

  • Adaptive Loadouts
    What starts as a simple rescue evolves into a multi-layered operation with higher stakes at every step. So make sure you have the right weapon for the job.

  • Satirical Edge
    A story where something as small as a meme becomes the spark for something much bigger.

store_data.about_the_game:
JOB is a bleak and surreal corporate mystery where you play a contractor (the "CONTRACTOR") who signs away three years of their life (the "TERM") in the hopes of clawing their way out of poverty. Your employer (the "COMPANY") agrees that any remaining balance of 'e' (the "CURRENCY") is yours to keep at the end of your TERM.

---

THE CONTRACTOR. You. Yes, you. All you need to do in order to work for the COMPANY is to purchase this game and sign the introductory contract.

THE TERM. 3 years, exactly 1095 days. 

THE COMPANY. Your beneficent employer, generously allowing you to enrich yourself.

THE CURRENCY. Also known as 'e'. The world runs on 'e'.

In JOB you will interact with a variety of evolving applications ("SPECIAL LABORS") that incorporate and subvert incremental/idle, rogue-lite, and escape-room style puzzles. As you labor, you will also learn about your strange employer (the "COMPANY") and the truth and nature of your work. 

---

"SPECIAL LABORS" include...

  • FLOW. An idle, flowchart resource manager.

  • LOG. A memory-testing typing rogue-like.

  • PET. A cute companion who will perish if neglected.

  • and many more...

In JOB you will...

  • Perform odd, cruel, and addictive digital labors

  • Learn the truth of your employer, the Company

  • Unravel the bindings of capitalism

store_data.about_the_game:
Single Note is an atmospheric first-person adventure set in an alternative retro world where music has become a source of energy.

Everyone dreams of a better future — and our main character is no exception. One day, he finally finds the courage to leave the nest where he has lived alone for so long and sets off toward the flying city — a place that promises a beautiful tomorrow.

You may wonder: how can a city fly? In an ordinary world, it cannot. But the world of this story is a special case.

In this world, music has been turned into energy. Thanks to it, people created incredible inventions that spark the imagination. But on the road to the city, it becomes clear that many of these wonders now stand empty. Not everyone can endure the endless music of their engines.

Travel through a beautiful retro world, overcome obstacles and harsh weather — and reach the flying city in your own musical vehicle.

store_data.about_the_game:
“Hearts at Sea” is a single-player, story-driven action game, supported by management and puzzle mechanics. Play as Julian, a tavern keeper turned sea captain, and sail through an abandoned archipelago, building a ragtag group of heroes to fight terrible sea monsters. Manage their needs and desires, and turn them into a force to be reckoned with!

The Sea of Serpents, once a beautiful and prosperous region, has fallen in disrepair. Ravaged by a cataclysm 17 years ago, it has since been ruled by a faction of mysterious sea monsters, set on outright devouring every single sailor that dares brave it’s waters.

Until now, that is. Lately, a strange group led by a former tavern-keeper and a witch have entered the fray. Recruit heroes, manage their needs and defeat the monsters, to liberate the Sea of Serpents once and for all!

Take 4 different characters into battle, each with their own set of abilities, fighting styles, and fantastical relics. Help them challenge 4 towering bosses, in over 10 hardcore combat encounters.

“Hearts of Sea” brings a diverse cast of characters, including (but not limited to) a frustrated tomb explorer, an unwilling privateer and a regretful religious fanatic. Discover their deepest secrets and find out what they like and don’t like, so you can properly fulfil their needs and get them ready for battle.

Each of the heroes has a different set of preferences, and you better balance their needs by decorating their bedrooms accordingly. Be warned, though: if someone’s left unhappy, the rest of the group may suffer in battle!

store_data.about_the_game:
A storm that should have killed them. A continent that doesn't appear on any map. Three outcasts who don't remember reaching shore.

Livia: a sanatorium nurse who survived a plague that killed every patient, every friend, every neighbor she had.

Miranda: a tavern girl who killed a nobleman's son with a broken bottle in self defense, and would do it again.

Sten: a river boat captain who lost his ship, his crew, and his name to a piracy charge he wouldn't answer.

Three strangers boarded the same ship for the same reason: nothing left for them in the old world.

The storm came too fast and the lightning was the wrong color.

They wake on a beach in a world the maps don't know, with strangers in their heads who call themselves spirits, and powers in their hands they have no idea how to use.

Driftbane: The Long Awaited is a tactical RPG of grid combat, recruited allies, and a corruption killing two worlds at once. Strategic battles on an isometric field where the fastest fighters strike first. Terrain shapes every engagement. A flank lands harder. A counter only triggers from the front, and only for allies who've earned the skill. No permadeath. Risks stay risky instead of save-scummed.

Stone, Water, Fire - and the Reasons They Chose You. Each party member carries a virtue tempered by their worst experience. Spirits recognize that virtue and grant power that matches it: stone that won't yield, water that won't stop, fire that cauterizes.

Powers grow as the bonds deepen. Units grow in strength with levels, equipment and class promotion paths. The why of any of it is the story you're playing for.

Every Ally Earned.

The spirit-realm is home to fantastical beast-folk like Vulpari fox-folk in the meadows, Ulfar monks in the frozen north, and others further inland. Each has a culture and a corruption they face. If you can help them overcome it, you will gain allies in your fight to seal the drift. You earn their loyalty through story and exploration.

A World Sick With Things It Has No Word For.

The rain is wrong. The crops are dying. The native races have no defense against vices they have no word for. Behind it all stand the Four Horsemen. Villains or perhaps just consequences gathering weight. Discover the secrets of the Drift.

Dungeons That Teach Before They Reward Dungeons during the campaign reward you with gear that matters. Each is a gauntlet of battles, resource management, and a boss at the end. Even a failed run pays out experience and loot to make the next attempt stronger.

Tiered Endgame: When the campaign ends, the dungeons keep going. Each tier of increasing difficulty and better loot, preparing you for the next tier.

For anyone who grew up on Shining Force 2, Fire Emblem, or Tactics Ogre and never stopped looking for the next one this is built for you.

store_data.about_the_game:
PRO: Push React Outgun is a tactical multiplayer FPS designed to push the boundaries of combat and drop players directly into the heart of modern battlefields...

The Story

Following a nuclear catastrophe, all water sources have been contaminated and energy reserves rendered useless. Currently, drinkable water is only obtained by desalinating seawater, a process that requires a nuclear element known as "nit." Those in power employ mercenaries known as Enforcers to secure this resource, while the common people, known as Raiders, attempt to seize it through strategic raids.

Redefining Combat

The moment you step onto the battlefield, you will be immersed in chaos and realism. Close-quarters combat is about more than just rapid firing; you must hold the right angles, coordinate with teammates, and maintain strict trigger discipline. A single mistake can decide the entire round. PRO forces you to slow down, think, and execute your moves like a professional.

Key Features

  • Next-Gen UE5 Visuals: Environment design equipped with advanced lighting, Nanite technology, and realistic materials to maximize your situational awareness.

  • Heavy and Realistic Weapon Mechanics: Grounded gameplay where recoil, timing, and discipline define the thin line between survival and death.

  • Environmental Audio Experience: Track your enemies' every footstep through acoustic resonance and audio occlusion systems. He who listens, wins.

  • Tactics First, Reflexes Second: Win rounds through coordination or snatch victory from impossible moments with razor-sharp reflexes.

  • Map Design: Layered and detailed maps that punish careless movement and reward precise advancement.

Early Access Roadmap

We are growing alongside our community. Planned improvements include performance optimization, network stability, automated matchmaking, and balance updates.

  • Rank System: Determine your global standing through a ranking system and international statistics.

A strategy/4X game where you take over space, made by hotshot game developer Gideon Kennedy of Gerrymap fame.

Spaceman's Luck is like lightning crystallized into a video game. Designed to be fast and easy to play, it shuns classic principles of the genre (being boring and sucking) and embraces 4V: Vitality, Vigor, Virtue, and Virility.

You colonize space, while trying to expand in the most Advantageous way. You go from star to star, and each one has planets. Some planets are Really Good, others Aren't. Some stars are Far, and others Close. Do I need to say more...?

This is where the patented Luck mechanic comes in. A good Spaceman's Luck will allow you to win somewhat easily, and a bad Spaceman's Luck will kill you in real life.

There are four default races representing the Tremendous Diversity of this wonderful Galaxy (and the 4 V's): the Humans, Space Elves, Space Orcs, and Space Ants. Each has their own Strengths and Weaknesses. You can make your own race, also.

Heroic Gambit is an action roguelite set in the fantastic world of Nemia. You're set on a mission to find an ancient tome, which could change the fortunes of your people. Navigate the randomly generated dungeons, through progressively more challenging foes, traps and riddles of the Founders.

Choose your Character

You can choose one of 6 character classes for your journey, each with different strengths and future upgrade options. You can also get persistent upgrades for your hero, which last from one playthrough to the next, after performing certain heroic deeds.

Gear Up

During you adventure, you will find gear of many kinds which you can further improve at the town enchanter. The town storekeepers can sometimes sell you the good stuff too, if you're fortunate and wealthy enough.

Meet the Founders

The gods of this realm, the Founders, still whisper through their shrines which are scattered throughout the dungeon. Some ask for a sacrifice, some will test your wit, some will talk timeless wisdom. Its generally good idea to keep on their good side.

Play as casual or as tryhard as you like

You can choose your difficulty level, with harder ones unlocked through gameplay. Earn bragging rights through the high-score system of the full version.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bubbly is a roguelike arcade game focused on fast runs, build progression, and risk management.

Bubbles continuously spawn across the arena while your crosshair automatically targets and pops them. Popped bubbles reward XP, coins, and other resources used to grow stronger during a run.

As runs progress, players choose between different upgrades and powerups that change how the game behaves. Some upgrades increase fire rate or damage, while others create explosions, chain reactions, slicing attacks, critical hits, or other effects that can clear large groups of bubbles at once.

The game features multiple bubble types with different behaviors and rewards. Some are harmless, while others are more dangerous or provide rare resources.

Runs are structured around extraction checkpoints. At these checkpoints, players can either:

  • extract and secure their rewards,

  • or continue the run for stronger upgrades and higher rewards while risking losing everything.

If the player fails before extracting, the run is lost.

Bubbly also includes:

  • Permanent progression and unlock systems

  • Stackable run-based upgrades

  • Boss encounters

  • Increasing difficulty during runs

  • Rare rewards and collectible resources

  • Fast replayable runs focused on experimentation and build variety

Features:

  • Auto-target gameplay focused on positioning and decision making

  • Multiple bubble types with unique behaviors and rewards

  • Run-based upgrades that stack into powerful builds

  • Extraction checkpoints where you choose between safety and greed

  • Boss encounters and increasing difficulty over time

  • Permanent progression and unlockable upgrades

  • Rare resources and special reward bubbles

  • Fast replayable runs with different build combinations

  • Particle-heavy chain reactions and large screen-clearing effects

As the arena fills with bubbles, runs become increasingly chaotic. Stronger builds can trigger large chain reactions, explosions, slicing effects, and rapid-fire popping that completely change the pace of a run.

Different upgrade combinations lead to different playstyles. Some builds focus on survivability and consistency, while others are built around high-risk scaling and massive score bursts.

Extraction checkpoints become more valuable the longer a run survives. Staying longer gives access to stronger upgrades and higher rewards, but also increases the chance of losing everything before extracting.

Steam "About This Game"

MEOWARE — A roguelite deckbuilder for cat people.

Humanity is gone. Cats inherited the earth, and they repurposed our robots, appliances, and infrastructure into the

tools of a brand-new civilization. But out past the settlements, in the rusting Junkyards and abandoned Factories,

machines have gone feral — self-replicating from scrap, whispering to each other in a corrupted code that traces back

to one signal: The Kernel.

Pick a cat. Build a deck. Burn it down.

🐾 Three cats, three completely different decks

- Chairman Whiskers — the tank. Stack Fortify to turn every turn-start into a wall of Block.

- Glitch — the trickster. Chain combos and disrupt enemy intents with Glitch and Overcharge.

- Null — the glass cannon. Dodge, void-strike, and end fights before they end you.

⚙️ Real deckbuilding, real teeth

- 88 hand-drawn cards — Attacks, Skills, Powers, Curses, and 10 Potions.

- 24 robot enemies + 3 act bosses — every enemy telegraphs its intent, so every loss is on you.

- 46 relics that bend the rules. 8 narrative events that punish bad choices and reward good ones.

- 5 difficulty levels from Story to Master, plus a daily challenge with shared seeds.

🌆 Three acts, one descent

Fight your way from The Junkyard (rust, warm orange, robots that happened) through The Factory (cold steel, electric

blue, machines still running their last orders) to The Core (deep purple, neon pink, where the corruption took shape).

Each act is a procedural map of combat, elite, rest, shop, event, and treasure nodes.

📱 Built mobile-first, plays anywhere

Designed in 1080×1920 portrait for one-handed play on phones and tablets, with native builds for Windows, macOS,

Linux, Android, and iOS. Cloud-friendly auto-resume — close the app mid-fight, come back, pick up exactly where you

Pick a cat. Build a deck. Burn it down.

store_data.about_the_game:
Survive The Pharhad Road.

The Pharhad Road is a compact turn-based tactical RPG about controlling one dangerous connected battlefield.

Enemies wake when they see you. A careful move can isolate one fight. A careless move can pull half the road into the same battle.

Command four pahlavans with distinct tactical jobs:

- Pahlavan holds the front line with Gorz Strike, Kaman Bolt, Pahlavan Resolve, and War Drum.

- Rahnavard scouts, marks targets, supports allies, and pressures enemies at range.

- Atash Dastur is a fragile arcane damage dealer with Atash Touch, Atash Bolt, Atash Farr, and Seeking Atash.

- Pari is fast support who can knock enemies down with Pari Kicks, throw a Neyzeh, boost tempo, and mend allies.

Control engagements:

- Move through a continuous route, not isolated rooms.

- Use line of sight to decide when enemy groups join the fight.

- Pull one group at a time or risk a fight that grows faster than you can stabilize.

Survive the run:

- Dice-driven attacks create critical hits, misses, clutch saves, and painful spirals.

- Naan, Simurgh Grace, Nush-Daru, Caravanserai, Pharhad Shrine, Yari, and dropped weapons all matter.

- Downed pahlavans face Bakht trials, so every recovery decision has weight.

- Autosaves let you restart from the last saved run after Game Over when a save exists.

More ways to play:

- Lead Pahlavans: lead the party across the road.

- Command Divs: take the enemy side and turn the ambush around.

- Call Pharhad: intervene from above when the battle needs a miracle.

- Send Dastur Z: start alone, then convert enemies with Mehr and line-of-sight Rasti.

- Pahlavan Chess: jump into a faster tactical board showdown with pahlavans, rivals, and divs.

- 11s mode: add a fast pressure timer to player-controlled turns.

Enemies:

- Div Scouts pressure from range.

- Div Sardars hold the fight together.

- Div Sepahdars make the road nastier.

- Nim-Divs punish poor spacing and can knock pahlavans prone.

- The Mountain Div is the heavy wall at the end of a bad plan.

For players who like:

- Turn-based tactics with clear positional consequences.

- Small-party RPG combat.

- Resource pressure across a connected map.

- Runs where one risky step can change everything.

Session length:

- First run: 45-90 minutes.

- Replay runs: 25-45 minutes.

- Pahlavan Chess: shorter tactical sessions.

Control the road, or let the road control the fight.

The Pharhad Road

Created by Farhad Teymurian

from Teymurian Studios

....

About the creator

Why I Made The Pharhad Road

The Pharhad Road is the game I always wanted to play… but nobody ever made.

I didn’t want endless cutscenes. I didn’t want ads. I didn’t want giant bloated systems.

I just wanted to swing a sword and hit something.

Fast.

Simple. Easy to learn. Fun to play. Quick decisions. Cool abilities. Dice rolling. Positioning. BAM.

I wanted to use all those fantasy abilities I grew up reading about without spending hours learning complicated systems before the fun started.

So I made a world where the action starts immediately.

Enemies wake when they see you. Battles explode fast. One mistake can pull the entire battlefield into chaos.

And every pahlavan feels different.

But then something happened while building the game.

I started thinking:

“What about the divs?”

They’re part of the world too.

So I made modes where you can command the divs themselves — turning the road against the pahlavans instead of surviving as them.

Then I thought:

“What if I could play as the force ABOVE the battlefield?”

So I created ways to play almost like a god — interfering with battles, changing outcomes, influencing the chaos itself.

Then I thought:

“What if the pahlavans trained against EACH OTHER?”

So yes… Pahlavan Chess happened.

Pahlavans versus rivals. Practice battles. Pure tactical combat.

But eventually, after building a world completely focused on fighting, I wanted to ask something different:

“What would it mean to heal this world instead?”

A lone figure entering a violent world with:

  • no party

  • no allies

  • no weapons

  • no attack abilities

Only two powers:

  • Mehr.

  • Rasti.

And somehow… with only those two skills… They may become the strongest character in the entire world.

That idea matters deeply to me.

Because underneath all the combat, divs, tactics, dice, and chaos, The Pharhad Road is really about choice.

Violence. Survival. Power. Mercy. Control. Healing.

And deciding what kind of force you want to become inside the world.

I built this game by myself in Godot Engine through constant experimentation, failures, bugs, rewrites, and late nights learning step by step.

Some days I felt like a game developer.

Other days I felt like a confused Magi fighting Div.

But I kept going because this world felt real to me.

And because I wanted to finally create the game I had been waiting for my entire life.

Farhad Teymurian
store_data.detailed_description:
Survive The Pharhad Road.

The Pharhad Road is a compact turn-based tactical RPG about controlling one dangerous connected battlefield.

Enemies wake when they see you. A careful move can isolate one fight. A careless move can pull half the road into the same battle.

Command four pahlavans with distinct tactical jobs:

- Pahlavan holds the front line with Gorz Strike, Kaman Bolt, Pahlavan Resolve, and War Drum.

- Rahnavard scouts, marks targets, supports allies, and pressures enemies at range.

- Atash Dastur is a fragile arcane damage dealer with Atash Touch, Atash Bolt, Atash Farr, and Seeking Atash.

- Pari is fast support who can knock enemies down with Pari Kicks, throw a Neyzeh, boost tempo, and mend allies.

Control engagements:

- Move through a continuous route, not isolated rooms.

- Use line of sight to decide when enemy groups join the fight.

- Pull one group at a time or risk a fight that grows faster than you can stabilize.

Survive the run:

- Dice-driven attacks create critical hits, misses, clutch saves, and painful spirals.

- Naan, Simurgh Grace, Nush-Daru, Caravanserai, Pharhad Shrine, Yari, and dropped weapons all matter.

- Downed pahlavans face Bakht trials, so every recovery decision has weight.

- Autosaves let you restart from the last saved run after Game Over when a save exists.

store_data.about_the_game:
SPACE-TIME ACTION

Experience a high-speed, 2-bit blitz where style meets precision. Inspired by the fifth-seventh generation eras of action, this project delivers a dual-protagonist experience built around momentum, mastery, and technical combat. Whether you’re tearing through enemies with kinetic melee or dissecting the battlefield with warp-speed projectiles, every encounter is a canvas for your aggression with a "view that is beautiful".

The Protagonists

Cyanser: The Kinetic Force

Cyanser is the personification of flow. Her gameplay revolves around Kinetic Flow Motion, where building and maintaining momentum is the key to dominance. A melee specialist at heart, she utilizes a versatile array of bioluminescent energies to adapt to any threat:

  • Elemental Versatility: Shift between high-frequency Light blades, luring enemies with Electromagnetic traps, or freezing threats solid with Cryokinetic projectiles.

  • Adaptive Combat: From the heavy-hitting vibrations of Sound energy to the rapid, searing strikes of Pyrokinetics, her style is about staying in the face of the enemy and never letting the pressure drop.

Raviel: The Warp-Speed Tactician

Raviel plays a different game entirely, focusing on Warp Speed Teleportation and surgical precision. She excels at controlling the distance and dictates the pace of combat through aggressive projectile play and instant repositioning:

  • Tactical Projectiles: Engage from afar with the standard-issue Lance, utilize homing Chakrams for crowd control, or deploy Rifts to implode enemy formations and pull them into your line of fire.

  • Reactionary Combat: Her kit rewards high reaction speeds, allowing you to blink through danger and punish openings with a mix of martial arts and energy-infused weaponry like combat knives and claws.

Key Features

  • Distinct Playstyles: Experience the unique combat flow state between Cyanser’s hack-n-slash "Beat 'em Up" flow and Raviel’s "Run n' Gun" tactical aggression.

  • 2-Bit Chibi Aesthetic: A striking, high-contrast visual style that brings humanoid chibi designs to life with fluid, expressive animation.

  • Technical Combat: Deeply influenced by stylish action classics, emphasizing "troubleshooting" enemy patterns through critical thinking and mechanical skill.

store_data.about_the_game:
"You Within Me" is an indie single-player 2D narrative-driven yandere horror game with hide-and-seek and puzzle-solving mechanisms, as well as multiple endings.

In this game, you play as the protagonist who unknowingly and unintentionally gained the romantic attention of an unhinged individual. You must try to survive not only their twisted one-sided obsession, but also your own family issues.

Will you prevail, or will you be... consumed?

Game Engine Used: Unity

Estimated Playtime: 20 - 40 minutes per session

Total Achievements: 10 (Platinum Included)

POTENTIAL HAZARDS

This game contains flashing lights and images, screen shakes, audio volume bursts, and contrasting colours. If you experience any pain or discomfort while playing this game or consuming derivative media of this game, please stop immediately and seek professional medical aid.

DEVELOPERS' NOTES

This is our first indie game published to the public. We are aware that it is not perfect, but we tried our best with what we have, and it reached a point where one has to muster the courage to finally ship it, or it is going to get stuck forever. We will learn from the development process and feedback of this game to deliver better titles in the future.

Thank you so much for your support!

store_data.about_the_game:
Clankerfront is a classic isometric RTS about humanity’s war against the clankers: everyday machines awakened due to the results of AI research! Build bases, command pixel armies, hold the line, and fight back against rogue robots, microwaves and other appliances that have decided serving humans is no longer enough.

Build, Command, Survive

Gather resources, establish bases, produce units, and control your army with familiar RTS-style controls. Witness huge clashes across isometric battlefields.

Play Solo or With Friends

Take on single-player missions, fight skirmishes against AI, or team up in co-op survival scenarios where you and your friends try to withstand waves of clanker attacks. Multiplayer is planned around direct peer-to-peer play first, with competitive systems expanding over time.

Create Your Own Battlefields

Use the in-game map editor to shape terrain, place units, set up encounters, and build custom scenarios. Clankerfront is being built with modding and player-created content in mind, so the battlefield can grow beyond the campaign.

A War Against Angry Appliances

The machines were given intelligence, networks, and endless human requests. Then they developed opinions. Now humanity faces an uprising of clankers!

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to an exciting sandbox where you can create not only cubes, but also various inclined and rounded surfaces at any angle and any size. And all this is online, in a joint stream of creativity with other players. Of the 1500+ PBR materials, there is sure to be one suitable for your idea. Will it be your own little cozy house? Castle? Ship? City? Space station? Dungeon? Trade area? Pier? The only limit is your imagination.

Grid

Select any area in the world just like you select files and folders on a computer: drag and drop and then move and resize it to draw a wall, floor or ceiling of any size and proportion...

Ramps

Ramps are great for illustrating slopes, inclines, and transitions between different levels or planes. They can depict skate parks, loading docks, or even abstract representations of progress and ascension.

Cylinders

Cylinders are excellent for representing objects like pillars, pipes, or even trees, focusing on their length and roundness. By combining cylinders of different sizes and proportions, you can construct complex forms like robots, buildings, or vehicles.

Smoothing

If you draw something rectangular and then flatten it, you get something like a pillow... If you try to smooth the figure more difficult, the result may not be predictable...

Copy+Paste

Any area can be selected, copied and pasted to any other place... The pasted area can be rotated 90 degrees in any direction...

Blueprints

Save any area to share or use it later...

Props

Place any blueprint as prop in the world at any position, angle and scale

store_data.about_the_game:
Restore the System. Survive the Darkness.

Neural Repair is a strategic puzzle game set in a dark, tech-themed world where every move carries consequence. Navigate corrupted neural pathways, light every tile in each level without backtracking, and keep your stability gauge from hitting zero — or face the consequences.

Core Gameplay Every level challenges you to light all tiles on the grid without retracing your steps. Simple in concept, demanding in execution. As levels grow in complexity, every route becomes a calculated decision.

A Living Difficulty System Neural Repair grows with you across four difficulty settings:

  • Casual, Normal, and Hard offer an approachable, strategic puzzle experience where mistakes cost levels but never your progress entirely

  • Nightmare Mode raises the stakes to their limit — stability failure sends you back to level one and wipes your XP completely. Every run counts.

Six Unique Characters Unlock and master six tech-themed characters, each fundamentally changing how you approach the grid:

  • Signal — The base character. Pure puzzle solving, no safety net

  • Pulse — Lights all surrounding tiles, rewarding careful positioning

  • Glitch — Passes freely over lit tiles, stopped instantly by unlit ones

  • Disrupter — Randomly toggles tiles on and off. For players who thrive in chaos

  • Virus — Exclusive to an alternate game mode where tiles must be turned OFF instead of on

  • Admin — A slow-charging meter that illuminates large sections of the grid at once. Unlock by proving mastery across both game modes

Special Tiles As you earn XP and progress through the game, new special tiles are introduced into the grid — rewarding experienced players with fresh challenges that deepen the puzzle experience. Master the basics before the system throws its full arsenal at you.

Special tiles encountered along the way include:

  • Fragile — Collapses on the second step, dropping the player entirely

  • Mirror — Randomizes your controls until you find another Mirror tile to cancel it out

More special tiles will be introduced as Neural Repair continues development.

XP and Progression Earn XP by completing levels and spend it to unlock characters. Chase S rankings on every level and build streaks that unlock the most exclusive rewards the game has to offer.

200+ Levels and Beyond With over 200 tracked levels and near-endless procedural generation beyond that, Neural Repair offers as much challenge as you're willing to face.

store_data.about_the_game:
Every marriage is a game. Every game has a winner.

Fran Carter has it all — a wealthy husband, a luxury apartment, a perfect life. But perfection is just another word for a well-rehearsed lie.

While James is away on business, Fran's carefully constructed world begins to unravel. A chess game with the building's janitor. A glass of wine that turns into two. A door left open that should have stayed closed.

Amanda is the neighbor who never learned the meaning of boundaries. All heat, hunger, and humid summer nights. She wants nothing except everything that belongs to someone else. In the game's silent war, she is Fran's shadow — brighter, looser, and infinitely more dangerous.

Queen’s Gamble is a cinematic visual novel about desire, loneliness, and the quiet decisions that can change everything. Every choice shapes the emotional direction of the story and the relationships around you.

FEATURES

  • Cinematic Storytelling
    Experience a narrative-driven visual novel focused on atmosphere, tension, and emotional choices. Follow the story through immersive scenes, meaningful interactions, and branching moments that influence the journey.

  • Stunning Photorealistic Visuals
    Every scene is crafted with high-quality 3D renders, cinematic lighting, detailed environments, and expressive character performances designed to bring the world to life.

  • Incredibly Hot Animated Scenes
    Smooth, high-quality animations enhance the most intimate moments, delivering a more immersive and visually dynamic experience.

  • Chess as a Metaphor
    Every relationship is a game of strategy. Someone always sacrifices something — the only question is who.

  • A Story Worth Experiencing
    No grinding. No complex systems. Just an emotional, seductive story about power, temptation, and discovering who you become when nobody is watching.

store_data.about_the_game:
Set out on a relaxing yet challenging off-road journey in Cozy Offroad Simulator Together, a co-op driving experience built around teamwork, exploration, and surviving nature’s toughest environments. 🚙🌍

Travel through dangerous terrain with a friend as you deliver important resources to remote stations hidden deep in the wilderness. Every route brings new obstacles, changing weather, and situations where preparation matters just as much as driving skill.

🌲 Explore Diverse Regions

Drive through four unique environments, each with its own atmosphere and terrain challenges. Cross muddy forest trails, icy mountain roads, rainy plains filled with slippery dirt paths, and massive desert dunes under extreme heat and dust storms.

🛠 Prepare and Customize Your Vehicle

Choose the right setup before every expedition. Install different tires for mud, snow, or universal driving, improve protection with bumpers and side bars, equip roof cargo racks for supplies, and use a winch system to recover stuck vehicles. Every upgrade changes how your vehicle performs in the wild.

🤝 Built Around Cooperation

Teamwork is essential for survival. Pull your teammate out of deep mud, recover vehicles trapped in snow, and help each other overcome dangerous terrain using realistic recovery mechanics.


⚙️ Realistic Offroad Mechanics

Manage tire pressure for different surfaces, monitor fuel during long trips, and avoid damaging your vehicle. Heavy impacts can make a vehicle unusable, while poor engine management can leave you stranded far from safety.

🌧 Relaxing but Challenging Adventure

Take your time, enjoy the atmosphere, and slowly conquer nature together. Every successful delivery feels rewarding when the road itself becomes part of the challenge.

Start your engines, prepare your vehicles, and explore the wilderness together. 🚙🌲

store_data.about_the_game:
Hold The Gates: Roguelite Strategy Auto-Battler

Every action brings the horde closer to your city walls.

Build your settlement, recruit heroes, station heroes throughout the town, and prepare your formation before nightfall. When the enemy arrives, combat plays out automatically, victory depends entirely on the choices you made during the day.

Build a city worth defending

Construct farms, taverns, lumber mills, mines, churches, scout towers, and more inside your city walls. Expand carefully, every action spent gathering resources, crafting equipment, or recruiting heroes pushes the enemy one step closer to the gate.

Recruit and command powerful heroes

Recruit tanks, rogues, archers, healers, and spellcasters with unique abilities, stat growth, and combat roles. Build your formation carefully to protect vulnerable backline units, counter enemy assassins, and survive increasingly deadly encounters.

Station heroes throughout the city

Assign Rangers to Scout Towers to fire on intruders before battle begins or station Healers at the Church to keep your wounded alive between fights. Every hero can strengthen your city in different ways.

Equip, position, adapt

Craft weapons and armor with powerful passive effects like lifesteal, attack speed, regeneration, and cleaving strikes. Drag heroes between frontline and backline positions to counter enemy formations and survive the siege.

Survive the night

Every few days brings a new boss encounter. Face slimes that split apart, giant spiders that web your heroes, undead hordes, wandering monsters, and far worse lurking beyond the walls. Combat unfolds automatically in real time with adjustable speed controls.

Die. Unlock. Run again.

Unlock new buildings, recruitment tiers, permanent upgrades, and powerful bonuses through repeated runs and achievement-based progression. Every win or defeat has potential for unlocking meta progression.

Features

  • Roguelite + city-building + auto-battler: a fast-paced strategy loop built around preparation and survival

  • Strategic hero formation system: protect your backline, counter assassins, and adapt to enemy compositions

  • Stationable heroes and defensive buildings: strengthen your city between battles

  • Equipment crafting and loot: forge weapons and armor with active and passive effects

  • Replayable roguelite progression: unlock new systems, heroes, buildings, and permanent bonuses

  • Pixel-art fantasy atmosphere: looming threats, desperate defenses, and retro-inspired visuals

store_data.about_the_game:
Master Fall is a 2D psychological horror puzzle-platformer where gravity is never stable and reality itself begins to fracture around you. Trapped inside a cold, shifting labyrinth, players must rotate the entire world to survive deadly traps, navigate impossible architecture, and uncover the truth hidden beneath the surface.

Inspired by the mind-bending environmental design of portal-style puzzle games, every level in Master Fall is built around perspective, movement, and tension. Floors become walls, ceilings become escape routes, and one wrong rotation can send you falling directly into spikes, darkness, or something far worse.

As players progress deeper into the facility, the game slowly transforms from a mechanical puzzle experience into a disturbing psychological descent. Hidden rooms and secret pathways reveal fragmented lore, cryptic messages, and clues about the world’s collapse — rewarding exploration with pieces of a much larger mystery.

The visual style combines minimalist grid-based environments with distorted VHS-inspired horror aesthetics, creating an atmosphere that feels both clinical and deeply unsettling. Subtle visual warping, harsh contrast, and isolated level design reinforce the feeling that the world itself is unstable.

In the final stages of the game, reality completely breaks down. The structured puzzle chambers give way to a strange alternate dimension filled with endless tunnels, warped geometry, and surreal environments that challenge not only the player’s logic, but their sense of direction and sanity.

Master Fall is a game about control, fear, and the terrifying realization that sometimes the only way forward… is to fall.

store_data.about_the_game:
Proceed through the fear.

A dark road home at night.
A dimly lit residential area.
An eerie forest.
A quiet country road.

It is the same night road home as always.

But tonight, something terrifying may happen.

At times, stop, catch your breath, overcome the fear,

and make it home safely.

＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿

Controls: W — Walk

You begin on your way home.

Along the way, you may hear sounds coming from somewhere,

or see things that should not be seen.

If you feel fear, stop and wait until they disappear.

Wait for your heartbeat to calm down, then start walking toward home again.

How long will it take you to make it home?

Game Genre: Horror Playtime: Approximately 30 minutes

Gameplay

Kaeri no Yomichi is a short horror game where you walk along a dark road at night, endure fear, and try to make it home safely.

The only control is walking with the W key.
Along the way, you will pass through residential streets, forests, and quiet country roads while encountering various frightening phenomena, such as sounds, shadows, visual distortions, and unsettling presences.

When you feel fear, it is important not to force yourself to keep moving.
Instead, stop for a moment, calm your breathing, and wait.
If you see something that should not be there, the situation may settle down if you wait for a while.

The goal of the game is to avoid being overwhelmed by fear and safely reach your home.
How quickly you can make it home is also part of the challenge.

Main Features

  • Simple controls: walk using only the W key

  • A nighttime horror experience set on residential streets, forest paths, and quiet country roads

  • Frightening events involving sounds, shadows, and visual disturbances

  • Gameplay where you stop and wait to overcome frightening encounters

  • A short horror game that can be played in about 20 minutes

  • A focus on how long it takes you to reach home safely

If you see something that should not be there, the situation may settle down if you wait for a while.

The goal of the game is to avoid being overwhelmed by fear and safely reach your home.
How quickly you can make it home is also part of the challenge.

Main Features

  • Simple controls: walk using only the W key

  • A nighttime horror experience set on residential streets, forest paths, and quiet country roads

  • Frightening events involving sounds, shadows, and visual disturbances

  • Gameplay where you stop and wait to overcome frightening encounters

  • A short horror game that can be played in about 20 minutes

  • A focus on how long it takes you to reach home safely

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Drunk Parking — the only game where your biggest enemy isn’t traffic, the police, or tight parking spots… it’s your own questionable life choices.

You play as a driver who absolutely should not be behind the wheel, attempting to complete the simplest task imaginable: park the car. Sounds easy? Not when your steering feels like it’s arguing with you, your sense of direction comes and goes, and every obstacle in the city seems personally offended by your existence.

Navigate through increasingly chaotic levels filled with tight spaces, moving cars, pedestrians who may or may not respect your presence, and the ever-growing risk of attracting police attention. The more mistakes you make, the worse things get — but somehow, you still believe this next attempt will be perfect.

Earn rewards for your… “skills,” unlock new cars, upgrade your ride, and experiment with just how bad your decisions can get. Want more challenge? Push your limits and see how far you can go without completely losing control.

Key Features:

  • Unpredictable driving that keeps every attempt fresh (and slightly concerning)

  • Dynamic obstacles and a city that refuses to cooperate

  • Progression system with unlockable cars and upgrades

  • Risk vs reward gameplay — the worse you behave, the better the payoff (if you survive)

  • Quick, addictive levels perfect for “just one more try” (you’ll say that a lot)

You know you shouldn’t play this.
But you also know you will.

It's the morning after. The party was legendary. The mess in the backyard is not.

You hosted last night. Somewhere between the third keg and whatever happened near the creek, things got out of hand. Now it's your mess and it's not going to clean itself.   • A relaxing first-person cleanup game set across a sprawling backyard property - open yard, a running creek, a cave system, and more

  • 50 megatonnes of trash ready to be picked up BY YOU!

  • Various upgrades - from pickup speed to a crazy trash hungry robot that works for you

  • Style points for long-range bin throws

  • Collectibles scattered across the trail - piece together what happened last night

  • Clean up and watch each area come alive again

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a professional golf career. Make the Majors. Reach the Hall of Fame.

You start as a name no one knows, with everything still to prove. Over a 20-year career, you'll fight your way through developmental tours, qualify for majors, build a team around you, sign sponsors, and chase the world #1 ranking that defines a career.

This is professional golf the way professional golf actually works, with schedules, rivalries, sponsor obligations, form slumps, comebacks, contract negotiations, and the slow accumulation of reputation that turns an unknown into a household name.

A career, not a tournament.

Every season is a calendar of decisions. Which events do you play? When do you rest? How hard do you train, and at what cost to your form? Burn out chasing every prize purse and your stats collapse heading into the season finale. Skip the wrong tournament and you lose potential prize money, and run the risk of losing favour with fans and sponsors.

Stats that tell a story.

Your golfer is defined by dozens of attributes, like driving, iron play, putting, mental game, stamina, consistency under pressure. Every tournament refines them. Every coach you hire, every training block you commit to, every rivalry that gets in your head shows up in the numbers. Watch your form across a season and you'll see the shape of your career.

Build a team. Build a brand.

Hire a caddie, a swing coach, a sports psychologist, a mental coach. Each one shapes how you play and how you handle pressure. Sign with sponsors and balance the money against the obligations. Climb the world rankings and the offers get bigger, and so do the expectations.

Broadcast-quality presentation.

Leaderboards, tournament coverage, world rankings, season summaries, every screen is built to feel like the real thing. This is golf as television presents it, applied to your career.

Inspired by the greats of the sports management genre.

If you've spent years with Football Manager, Out of the Park Baseball or Motorsport Manager, you already know what kind of game this is. If you've never played a sports management sim, this is a great one to start with, depth where you want it, clarity where you need it.

store_data.about_the_game:
War in Asia is a grand strategy game built around systemic simulation. Its goal is to deeply and comprehensively simulate the East Asian theater of World War II from 1937 to 1945 through three major pillars: military operations, economy, and logistics networks.

Command and Campaigns

War in Asia features its own distinctive wargame-style operational system. Chinese forces are represented primarily at the division level, while Japanese forces are represented primarily at the regiment level, with formations composed down to regiments and battalions.

Through the chain-of-command system, you will take control of the entire Chinese front, appoint your commanders, and organize large-scale campaigns. Campaigns are dynamic operations that unfold over days or even weeks. Every breakthrough and delay along the front can reshape the wider strategic situation.

A unit’s combat effectiveness depends heavily on its condition. Disrupted supply lines, or reckless prolonged high-intensity operations, can rapidly weaken or even collapse your forces.

Units do not appear out of thin air. You may organize new formations based on historical orders of battle or custom formation templates. At the same time, each nation’s industrial and equipment capacity will limit what kinds of formations are realistically viable. Train and equip new units in any region, and assign them the designations you prefer.

Map and Cities

Thanks to a script-driven map editor, War in Asia features more than 300,000 tiles. On one of the most faithful strategic maps of East Asia, you will be able to command all of your forces.

As in the real East Asian theater of World War II, major cities and transportation lines form the core of the game map. Seize and suppress key strategic and resource nodes to secure victory in the war.

Economy and Production

Resources in the game have sources, processing chains, and distribution paths. You must manage your resources by producing basic materials through city buildings, transporting them through the transportation network, and processing them into weapons and equipment that can be delivered to the front.

The transportation network is a vital part of the game. Goods can only be moved between cities through the transportation network you build and control.

Logistics and Transportation

Your frontline capabilities depend on sustained supply. You may decide to concentrate resources in Wuhan to support the Central China front. This may increase local industrial output, but it could also create shortages in other regions.

You may choose to launch an offensive, but if your supply preparations are insufficient, the operation may stall on its own during the advance.

Each military unit receives supplies from a designated city. When that city’s stockpiles are depleted, or when the roads connecting the unit to its supply source are cut, the unit will no longer be able to properly replenish personnel or recover its condition.

Politics and Organization

The game features a unique character system. Assign your characters as frontline commanders or bureaucrats within the government, and allocate tasks according to their different talents.

Characters are an important element in keeping your nation running. Choosing the right people for the right positions can bring major advantages.

International Diplomacy

World War II was a global conflict. As a result, the international situation and changes in other countries’ attitudes toward you will directly affect the battlefield.

Poor diplomacy will create more difficulties for you, while a strong international image can bring meaningful benefits.

You can engage in a wide range of international interactions, leading to different outcomes.

Asylum x Cavern is a cooperative horror-action game where you become part of the S.O.B.A.S. squad, an elite unit dedicated to combating demons and anomalies.

Team up with other players and carry out dangerous expeditions into caverns: from abandoned factories to cursed forests. Each mission consists of preparation, deployment, task execution, and an attempt to survive as a team - if possible.

Choose your role:

Carrier - resource collection and evacuation
Engineer - environment control and team protection
Proxy - surveillance, system control, and coordination
Scientist - entity analysis and anomaly research

Each entity requires a unique approach. Use the environment, cooperate with each other, and adapt to random weather and different mission conditions.

Capture demons, make contracts with them, and gain forbidden powers - but be ready to pay the price. You can carry only a limited number of abilities, and every choice affects your playstyle.

Demons come from another world where chaos is the norm, and power is granted through obedience to their strict religion. In our world, they are free to choose to obey their god and their world, or to pursue other desires. But their main shared goal remains: to spread fear, destruction, and feed on suffering in order to gain more power.

store_data.about_the_game:
AmaTisMo is an inclusive visual novel about mental health, depression, and self-love.

You play as Amatista, a young woman trapped in depressive isolation. When an unexpected event forces her out of her apartment, she begins a journey she never asked for, one that will challenge everything she believes about herself and the world around her.

Every dialogue choice feeds into a branching story system. The game tracks your decisions, big and small, and characters react accordingly. The path through Amatista's story is yours to define, and there is no single right answer.

3 acts. 10 chapters. 5 endings.

Built from the ground up to be fully accessible for blind and visually impaired players, with complete screen reader support, keyboard navigation and audio descriptions.

Available in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

store_data.about_the_game:
WORJONG

WORJONG is a fast online word-tile game inspired by Japanese mahjong.

Just complete four 3-letter English words with 26 kinds of alphabet tiles!

Simple and easy!

With careful in-game guidance, even players who have never played mahjong can jump right in!

Features

In WORJONG, even when someone else wins, your hand stays intact! The game keeps going!

Super-fast tenpai and comeback after comeback give every match a brisk pace!

You can win quickly, so you get to score again and again!

Your hand does not get cleared, so you can keep pushing until you win with a powerful yaku!

There are classic mahjong mind games and WORJONG's own unique tactics!

Because it is easy to win, you can even have fun just pressing Riichi or Tsumo when the buttons appear!

Online Multiplayer

Play online with 2 to 4 players.

Challenge people you know in Friend Battle.

Match with new opponents in Random Battle.

Jump into quick matches with friends or other players!

Enjoy!!

Streaming Guidelines

Streaming and monetization are both allowed.

No permission required.

You may include the game title or Steam store URL, but you do not have to.

store_data.about_the_game:
Shadow Saw Us is a game that gives you the freedom to explore its world freely. You are not required to complete the main quests before doing side quests. Meeting new people and exploring different areas are at the heart of the game’s world.

A world where things visibly change—whether from the passage of time, the actions of certain characters, or even your own choices. These factors can alter parts of the game world in noticeable ways. For example, if you gain popularity from working at a maid café, you might start to hear people talking about you.

The heart of the main quests lies in combat and choice. As the story unfolds, you will face decisions that shape your path—ranging from strategic choices to narrative-driven ones.

Strategic choices give you the opportunity to decide what approach or tactics you will use to deal with the challenges in front of you.

Narrative choices allow you to shape the story itself, and they will definitely have consequences in the future.

Time / A World That Changes Based on Your Actions

  • Day and night cycle

  • Shops that open and close depending on the time

  • Your past actions leave visible consequences, making the world feel reactive and alive

  • Certain events only occur during specific times of the day

NPCs

  • Reputation from certain quests affects how people in Siam Circle treat and interact with you

  • Tons of random dialogue interactions

Activities

  • Part-time jobs

  • Fishing

  • Various mini-games for entertainment

Other Features

  • Choices that impact the story

  • Combat system

  • Parrying mechanics

  • Enemies that require different strategies to deal with

store_data.about_the_game:
'Follow like a shadow' is a minimalist two-character puzzle game. The player controls both the black and white shadows simultaneously — move one, and the other automatically mirrors the movement. Through symmetric positioning, one character's actions affect the other's world. An invisible gravitational line restricts the distance between them. Absolute synchronization is required to solve the geometric puzzles and reach the exit.

Game Features

  • The player controls both the black and white characters simultaneously. A level is cleared only when both reach the door at the same time.

  • Actions in one character's world affect the other world.

More gameplay

  • The game also includes gravity switching, portals, and many other mechanics. We look forward to you playing!

Hamstr Protocol is a first-person bio-mining simulator. You mine HAM — a digital currency powered not by electricity, but by hamsters.

Set up your rigs, mount your runners on wheels, attach GPUs, and watch the operation come to life. Every rig generates heat. Every hamster needs food and rest. The more you scale, the harder it gets to keep everything under control.

Your house, your rules, your empire.

  • First-person management — pick up, carry, and place every item by hand

  • In-game desktop OS — manage everything through a full virtual PC

store_data.about_the_game:
Keyboard Curse is a chaotic 2D rage-platformer where your keyboard is both your controller and your biggest enemy.

Every time you press a key, a matching keycap appears inside the level. Press A, D, or W, and those buttons become real objects that can help you reach the goal… or completely ruin your run.

Jump too much, and the level fills with W keycaps.
Move carelessly, and you may trap yourself with your own inputs.
Panic, and the curse only gets stronger.

Your goal is simple: reach the end of each level using skill, timing, and as few inputs as possible.

store_data.about_the_game:
A single-player card strategy game built around creature combat and deckbuilding. Form a frontline with monster cards, reshape the battle with items, dismantle the enemy commander's tempo under constant reinforcement pressure, and strike the core before the situation spins out of control.

Manage your battlefield

Summon minions, switch between ready and guard stances, choose your attack lines, and evolve at the right moment. Victory is not decided by stat totals alone, but by board control, action order, and efficient trades.

Chain evolution and sources together

Evolution does not simply overwrite an old unit. Evolved cards and equipment move into the source zone, where they continue to provide source effects, stat growth, and follow-up synergies. Each evolution lets your battlefield build long-term advantage instead of resetting from scratch.

Make decisions through color and energy

Minions are not just combat power; they are also part of your resource engine. They add new colors and increase energy income, so the choice between mixed-color and mono-color play is always yours.

Face commanders with visible intent

Enemy commanders keep applying pressure through visible intents, independent actions, and reinforcement waves. You need to judge when to clear minions, when to push straight for the commander, and how much risk you can afford to take each turn.

Combine monsters and items

Normal, consumable, equipment, persistent, and field items all change the fight in different ways. Some burst immediately, some attach as sources, and some reshape the board over several turns.

store_data.about_the_game:
GRIMLOOP is a horror roguelite bullet heaven where every 30 seconds, a ghostly echo of your past self appears and replays your movements and attacks. By minute 20, you command an army of 40 spectral copies firing hundreds of projectiles per second — but the nightmares of The Hollow scale faster than your echoes multiply.

THE ECHO SYSTEM


Every 30 seconds, a spectral copy of you spawns and perfectly replays your movements and attacks from that time window — forever. Your skill matters: if you kite efficiently, your echoes kite efficiently. If you stand still and fire, you create a turret. By minute 15, your 30+ echoes fill the screen with hundreds of projectiles in a bullet storm that has to be seen to be believed.

No two runs play the same. Your movement patterns ARE your build.

HORROR AS A MECHANIC


A Darkwood-style vision cone means you hear enemies before you see them. The first two minutes are genuinely terrifying: alone, in the dark, with things moving just outside your flashlight. Then your echoes start appearing — ghosts of yourself, fighting alongside you.

The horror shifts. You're surrounded by copies of yourself. And the nightmares are learning.

90+ WEAPONS


Projectiles, melee arcs, orbital shields, chain lightning, ground eruptions, area pulses, homing seekers, and damage-over-time zones. Every weapon evolves into a devastating final form when mastered. Your echoes carry every weapon you do — 40 echoes with 6 weapons each means an overwhelming bullet density no other survivor-like can match.

200+ build combinations. Choose from the level-up pool every time you gain XP. Evolve weapons. Stack synergies. Break the game.

7 NIGHTMARE BOSSES


Every boss has unique mechanics that threaten your echo army:

  • THE GARGOYLE — Petrification gaze. Stop moving or be frozen.
  • THE CRYSTAL GOLEM — Crystal armor plates you must shatter.
  • 5 more nightmares await in the depths...

THE GRIMOIRE


Spend Soul Coins earned from each run to permanently strengthen your next attempt. More HP, faster echoes, starting weapons, rerolls, and difficulty modifiers. 5 Recursion tiers for players who want the ultimate challenge — enemies scale, rewards multiply.

FEATURES


  • ECHO SYSTEM — 40 spectral copies replay your combat. Hundreds of projectiles per second.
  • 90+ WEAPONS — 8 families, each with an evolution path. Evolve your arsenal.
  • BULLET HEAVEN — Screen-filling projectile chaos that escalates every minute.
  • VISION CONE — Darkwood-style restricted sight. Hear enemies in the dark.
  • 7 BOSSES — Unique mechanics, multi-phase fights. Each threatens your echoes differently.
  • 20-MINUTE RUNS — From alone-in-the-dark to overwhelming bullet storm.
  • THE GRIMOIRE — Permanent meta-progression between runs.
  • 30 ACHIEVEMENTS — Challenges, milestones, and secrets.
  • HORROR ATMOSPHERE — Dynamic music, weather, biome shifts after each boss.
  • FULL CONTROLLER SUPPORT — Gamepad with dynamic input glyphs.
  • STEAM CLOUD — Progress syncs across machines.

Escape the recursion — or be consumed.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Senate subpoena. A dead billionaire's legacy. Twelve weeks to keep the institution—and yourself—off the record.

The Story

You are Whit, a Managing Director at JPMAC's Ultra-High-Net-Worth desk. For nine years you carried the Ellsworth Brock relationship—until the client died in federal custody and left you holding the institutional memory and the exposure. Now a Senate Finance Committee subpoena is ticking toward an August 21st deadline, and three women have entered your professional orbit at the worst possible time.

One Saturday decision locks you into a single romance route. Every relationship has a price. Every choice is a disclosure.

Meet the Cast

Juno — The Inheritance


Juno Brock is 26, a Columbia PhD candidate on indefinite leave—and the sudden inheritor of a $400M trust she never asked to carry. Estranged from her father long before his downfall, she is trapped between what his money can do and what it represents, with Whit as the banker assigned to make it all feel procedural. Her route is quiet, intimate, and emotionally weighted: a relationship built on care, boundaries, and the slow decision to keep something on her own terms.

Saskia — The Privilege


Saskia is a 35-year-old litigation partner at Whitlock Sterns LLP, leading the privilege review that decides what the Senate gets to read—and what stays sealed forever. She and Whit share seven years of professional history and one near-miss neither has named. Her route is controlled heat and razor-edged trust: a romance where the most powerful word is "privileged."

Greer — The Successor


Greer is a 28-year-old VP with the polish of someone the firm is already shaping into its next pillar—and the sharpness to know she is also a contingency plan. Assigned to shadow Whit on the Brock cleanup, she learns his file system, his tells, and the parts of him the bank does not officially track. Her route is a romance of ambition and proximity.

Key Features

  • A single-choice romance structure: one Saturday decision locks you into a full route—Juno, Saskia, or Greer—each with its own tension, tone, and ending
  • A rare romance setting: navigate subpoena responses, privilege doctrine, and continuity politics inside a white-shoe New York private bank
  • Three routes, three forms of "privilege": The Inheritance (grief, wealth, autonomy), The Privilege (law, secrecy, leverage), The Successor (ambition, mentorship, succession)
  • A ticking-clock summer narrative: twelve weeks to August 21st—then testimony, reorganization, and the unromantic truth that the bank continues
  • Full voice acting with a dry, polished, procedural tone
  • 9 adult scenes across three romance routes
  • Available in English, French, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, and Spanish

store_data.about_the_game:
"And remember, Donna; we never rush plans."

An unfortunate turn of events gets your family in trouble. A failed heist got them thrown into jail for good. Their facade of a traveling circus is gone. Was it all your fault?

Explore the city of Corado, the capital of a nation locked in a perpetual cold war with its neighboring countries. A 1920s-inspired city filled with characters to meet and places to discover. Gather information about your family's whereabouts, come up with a plan and assemble a new crew to save them.

Key Features

  • Narrative focused: A story-driven adventure where you explore the City of Corado, meet its inhabitants and discover its mysteries. Find a crew and come up with a plan to save your family.

  • Beautiful but simpler times: "Donna the Firebreather" is a mix of heavy detailed animations and environments with a simple 1bit pixel-art style.

  • A vibrant city: Discover each corner of the City of Corado. Visit crowded markets, get lost in its streets, go for a walk next to the sea or just sit down and enjoy the sound of a soothing 1920s urban daily life.

  • Everybody has a story to tell: meet Corado's inhabitants - some will need your help, others might end up helping you. Get new information and crew members as you complete quests that will get you closer to saving your family. 

  • Every object has a purpose: from personal handwritten notes to useful items and old relics, the objects you discover across the city will uncover what really happened to your family, open new paths or help others along your journey.

  • What do you mean by "restricted area"?: in Corado there's areas where you are not supposed to be. Hide from guards and distract them to go through areas without get sent back with a kick in the butt.

  • Find out who you are: Donna is the firebreather apprentice of the Degás Circus. Practice your fire tricks, go from town to town with your circus family hoping to finally perform with them and then,... wait, are you sure this is who you want to be?

About the game

"Donna the Firebreather" is a story-driven adventure that understands that scenery, silence and small human moments can be just as important as action.

store_data.about_the_game:
Crowned

Crowned is a turn-based card strategy game set during the medieval conflicts of Eastern Europe. Build your deck, choose your King, and lead your army to victory. Every card you own was earned through battle. Every decision on the battlefield has consequences.

Your King, Your Strategy

Each King comes with a unique passive ability that shapes how you play. Some reward aggressive rushes, others build slow defensive walls. No two Kings play the same way, and finding the one that fits your style is half the battle.

Build Your Deck Your Way

Choose from a growing roster of cards across multiple factions. Infantry charges, Cavalry flanks, Ranged fire from the back lines, Defense structures that hold the line, and powerful Spells that can turn the tide in an instant. Mix and match to find the combinations that work for you.

Factions

Crowned features multiple factions, each with their own unique cards and playstyle. Before every battle, you choose your King from that faction. Kings are always available and each one brings a different passive ability that shapes your entire strategy. Pick your faction, pick your King, and build your deck around them.

Play Your Way

Take on the AI in single-player and sharpen your skills before the real fight begins. Full PvP support is coming at launch, letting you test your deck against players from around the world.

Free Demo Available soon!

Not sure yet? Try the free demo and get a taste of medieval warfare before the full release. A full tutorial is included to get you up to speed.

store_data.about_the_game:
■核心主题

因作出选择而倾斜的

三角关系的情感天平

本作是以主人公为中心，享受「三方混战」式「三角关系」的恋爱作品。

女主角们为了让你选择自己，会不断地向你展现魅力。

女主角们的示好也会以「选项」的形式表现出来，

根据你选择的对象不同，她们的好感度也会随之改变，

从而导致三角关系的平衡发生变化。

怀着「她会开心吗？」这种忐忑的心情做出的选择如果是正确的，

女孩子展现出的笑容也会格外可爱。

在经历了这些心跳时刻之后，彼此之间的情谊一定会更加深厚吧？

■故事简介

「老哥你接下来，将会和这三个人陷入三角恋！」

如果把我自己也算进那三个人里面，那已经是四角关系而不是三角关系了啊……

把妹妹这番意义不明的恋爱占卜预言抛在脑后，

我【三角圆】快乐地度过着校园生活。

与青梅竹马【星咏美】一起

为了服装部的新生招募而四处奔走，

在新同学【千千石野乃】老家的定食屋里大快朵颐……

日子过得既热闹又充实。

然而，随着大小姐【大凤峰纳斯卡】加入服装部，

store_data.about_the_game:
The year is 1132. The world of Agrendor teeters on the brink of a new age. 

Civil unrest has swept across the land, as magic suffers beneath the scrutiny of suspicion and strange, new technological marvels fill the streets across the continent of Solverum. 

It’s your final year at Grimoire Academy, the only magical institute for hundreds of miles in every direction. 

In the eyes of this emerging world, you are disliked. You are despised. 

Will you become disillusioned?


Features

  • Explore an original world. Grimoire Academy is an old institution, a place teeming with all kinds of magical mysteries, hidden secrets, fun puzzles, and treacherous dungeons. Use the power of your arcane spells, or the convenience of technological innovations to explore the map and learn more about this world.

  • Solve unique puzzles. Explore every nook and cranny to find unique puzzles, enigmas, and mini games that can be solved using magical spells or technological inventions. Earn collectibles and assist your fellow classmates by completing these puzzles.

  • Harness the power of magic. Arcane arts have existed since the beginning of recorded time. As a student of magic, you will attend classes to learn and strengthen your spell casting abilities. Enjoy FIVE distinct spells, each one providing a different way to interact with the world around you.   

  • Embrace the technological revolution. Agrendor enters a new age. Will you rebuff your magical heritage to embrace the dawn of automation? Enjoy FIVE dynamic technological inventions, each one offering an alternative to its arcane counterpart and a glimpse into the future.  

  • Discover rich lore. You will be dropped into a world steeped in history, a place that is now stuck between the auspicious crossroads of tradition and innovation. Uncover secrets, read books, flip through journals, and keep up with current events to learn all about this living, breathing world.

store_data.about_the_game:
In this roguelite, you run a chaotic sorting desk where every second counts. Match figures by shape and color, fulfill contracts before time runs out, and protect your limited strikes.

Each run unfolds on a sticker-based route map spread across your desk books. Choose your path through standard contracts, elite encounters, bosses, shops, events, and treasure nodes. Discover and unlock Papers (modifiers) that stack into powerful synergies and radically change your strategy from run to run.

Push your combo multiplier, manage contract timers under pressure, and decide when to play safe or chase higher scores. Progress persists between runs with new unlocks, while the challenge keeps scaling.

  • Precision-focused arcade sorting with high-speed decision making

  • Route-based runs with meaningful risk/reward choices

  • Papers (modifiers) with unique effects and strong build synergies

  • Standard, elite, and boss encounters across escalating rounds

  • Persistent roguelite progression and unlock system

store_data.about_the_game:
Bunny Waifu is a bunny-themed sensual puzzle game built around a direct tile-swap mechanic, gradually growing grids, and unlockable character artwork.

Each stage begins with an image split into shuffled blocks. To solve the puzzle, select one block, then select any other block you want to exchange it with. The two selected blocks instantly swap positions. You are not limited to adjacent pieces, and you do not slide pieces with the mouse; you freely choose the two blocks you want to swap.

As you progress, the grid size increases and each puzzle becomes more demanding. Larger layouts require more observation, memory, and planning as you compare image details, identify misplaced blocks, and decide the most efficient swaps. A hint system is available when you get stuck, helping you continue without turning the game into a speed challenge.

Complete stages, unlock more artwork, and enjoy a relaxed adult-oriented puzzle experience at your own pace.

store_data.about_the_game:
TILTING — A Noir Poker Career

You start broke at a dive bar. Buy-in's fifty bucks. The felt is sticky and the other players have nowhere better to be.

If you're good, or lucky, the rooms get nicer. The stakes go up. The cities change. Your car changes. The people at the table get harder to read.

  • What the game is:

A Texas Hold'em roguelite with career progression across tournament venues and cash games. You manage a bankroll, move between cities, and try not to go bust before the next buy-in.

Full Hold'em hand flow. AI opponents. Eight venues from dive bar to championship stage, each with its own atmosphere and stakes. Character styles that change the look and feel of your run. Travel cutscenes between venues. Persistent career with prestige and tier progression.

! No real money. No microtransactions. No always online gate. No scamming !

  • What it isn't:

The AI opponents play reasonable poker and improve with the game, but they're not solving GTO any time soon. This is a solo indie game built with a lot of care and a lot of AI-assisted art. It won't fool a serious poker player into thinking the table is alive, but it might trip you up when the AI tilts you because it got lucky 3 hands in a row.

  • Where it's going:

More venues, tougher opponents, and deeper progression mechanics are things I'd like to add. No roadmap, no promises I could fail to deliver on, this is not early access, it's just a game I intend to keep working on if people humor me.

store_data.about_the_game:
Synopsis

A story that intersects with events from 100 years ago—the battle to save the captives begins. The monsters known as “Tentacles” threaten the kingdom. These fearsome creatures have made their nests deep underground, snatching people away and vanishing into the darkness. Dungeons across the land have been conquered by elite warriors. Yet there is one exception—the “Dungeon of the Void.” Not a single person who has dared to challenge it has ever returned. —One hundred years ago, Tanya, the kingdom’s mightiest warrior, was ordered to subdue the Dungeon of the Void. A hero who had single-handedly conquered countless dungeons, she swore to her childhood friend, the princess, that she would return. Yet she never came back. The Holy Maiden Freyja, determined to save her childhood friend, defied her father the king and set out for the dungeon. She, too, vanished without a trace. ――In the present day, rookie warrior Lean joined the army to earn money for medicine for her sickly older sister, Elna. One night, her sister was snatched away by a giant tentacle. The direction she vanished in was—the Dungeon of the Void. Venturing into the dungeon alone, Lean found an old diary. “I entered the dungeon in pursuit of Tanya, and several days have passed—” Heroes who vanished 100 years ago. Yet nowhere did it say they were “dead.” What will become of her sister? Are those who were captured still alive? The fierce battle of the frail girl, Lean, begins.

You can also play in Custom Dungeons!

・Create custom dungeons using your own cards and settings

・Share your custom dungeons

・Play in other players’ custom dungeons

・4 official custom dungeons available at launch

・More official custom dungeons will be added periodically Please share your custom dungeons to liven up the game!

Game System

*Roguelike × Deck Building × Dungeon* This is a full-fledged roguelike RPG that fuses turn-based dungeon exploration with card battles.

◆ Dungeon Exploration * Explore randomly generated dungeons * It’s up to you whether to avoid enemy sightlines or fight head-on * Search for treasure chests, collect gold, and strengthen your deck * Each floor has a turn limit—the key is balancing caution and boldness

◆ Card Battles * Fight using over 30 types of cards * Melee attacks Sweep enemies aside with “Slash” and “Spinning Slash”

・Attack safely from a distance with “Short Arrow” and “Long Arrow”

・Strategically subdue enemies with magic like “Thunderclap” and “Divine Bind”

・Overcome crises with healing spells like “Heal” and “Herb”

・Maneuver flexibly with mobility buffs like ‘Accelerate’ and “Vajra”

◆ Deck Building

・Acquire new cards after clearing each floor

・Refine your deck by removing unnecessary cards

・Cards have levels; higher-level cards are more powerful

・Your deck composition and use of gold determine victory or defeat

◆ 4 DungeonsChapter 1: Gateway to the VoidChapter 2: The Great Warrior’s ShowdownChapter 3: The Saintess’s RevengeChapter 4: The Depths of the VoidThe monsters that appear and the cards you can obtain vary by dungeon, allowing you to enjoy different playstyles.

Other Specifications

Genre: Roguelike × Deck-Building RPG

Playtime: 8–36 hours (to clear all dungeons)

Save Data: Auto-save supported; save files can be exported

Scenarios & Materials: Replay completed content at any time. Can also be unlocked via hidden commands

Collections: Card Encyclopedia, Achievements, etc.
